If you need assistance to withdraw your application, please contact the Certification Section at certific@cdtfa.ca.gov For all other questions regarding your CalCareer account, please contact CalHR’s CalCareers Unit at (866\) 844\-8671 or CalCareer@calhr.ca.gov. For more information on the recruitment process please email Recruitment@cdtfa.ca.gov ### **Equal Opportunity Employer** The State of California is an equal opportunity employer to all, regardless of age, ancestry, color, disability (mental and physical), exercising the right to family care and medical leave, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, political affiliation, race, religious creed, sex (includes pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and related medical conditions), and sexual orientation. It is an objective of the State of California to achieve a drug\-free work place. Any applicant for state employment will be expected to behave in accordance with this objective because the use of illegal drugs is inconsistent with the law of the State, the rules governing Civil Service, and the special trust placed in public servants.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description: ***New as of 01/01/2026:*** **Your well\-being matters from the start — benefited new hires are eligible for up to 40 hours of advanced annual leave and 40 hours of advanced sick leave.** **Position Description** ------------------------ Catawba County is recruiting a highly self\-motivated engineer for an entry\-level Staff Engineer position designed to introduce the individual to the field of civil and environmental engineering, particularly in solid waste, stormwater, water and wastewater, infrastructure, and air quality. The Staff Engineer will work in a team environment and report directly to the Engineering Supervisor. This collaborative approach will help the new graduate become familiar with basic concepts, including fieldwork and testing, erosion and sedimentation control inspections and plan review, modeling, and engineering reporting. **Expected hiring range is $65,541\.42 \- $81,926\.77 based on qualifications.** **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Project construction oversight (landfill, and/or water/sewer) * Perform scheduled field inspections for sedimentation and erosion control small site permits * Record inspection results from the field into the SmartGov or similar software system * Provide communication and guidance to owners/contractors as needed for compliance * Perform field work associated with Landfill State permitting compliance * System Modeling of water and sewer infrastructure * Prepare technical memoranda, electronic deliverables, and/or reports * Evaluate concrete and street paving conditions * Calculate material quantities and generate cost estimates **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a specifically related field **Additional Requirements** --------------------------- * Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) Certification or ability to obtain during probationary period * Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record (Driving is an essential function of this position) * Understanding of construction means, methods, and best practices * Excellent writing and oral communication skills * Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills; ability to communicate with the public and other internal and external professionals in a tactful, positive way * Ability to exercise independent judgment in applying standards * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills * This position is considered light work; ability to lift up to 20 pounds on a regular basis; sitting most of the time with ability to walk during onsite inspections/investigations. **Preferences:** * Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) Certification * Certified Professional in Erosion and Sedimentation Control (CPESC) **As of 7/1/****2025:** You will find that Catawba County has one of the best benefits packages around. Our Human Resources staff are dedicated to keeping in touch with trends in benefits on both a local and national level, listening to employees' suggestions regarding benefits, and continually reviewing to ensure our benefits package is of good quality and meets the needs of both our employees and our organization. Available benefits include: **Health Care** * **Health:** For a small bi\-weekly premium, employees may choose between a traditional (co\-pay) health plan and a high deductible health plan coupled with a Health Savings Account (HSA). Coverage may also be purchased for spouse, child(ren), or family. * **Dental Insurance:** At no cost to full\-time employees, the County covers preventive, routine, and non\-routine care. Coverage for the same benefits may also be purchased for spouse, child(ren), and family. In addition, a $2,000 benefit toward orthodontia coverage is provided for children up to age 19\. * **Vision Care:** Coverage is available, at group rates, for employee and dependents,with 2 plan options to choose from. * **Supplemental critical care and accident insurance plans:** These optional coverage plans are available at a nominal cost. * **Flexible Spending Accounts:** Pre\-tax accounts that can be used to pay for qualified out\-of\-pocket medical, dental, and vision expenses. **Employee Wellness** * **Employee Health Clinic (EHC):** An employee medical clinic, available to all County employees, which operates 40 hours a week. Services provided include acute care, first aid, evaluation and care for workers' compensation injuries, pre\-employment screenings, health education, and behavioral health referrals. Services are offered both in person and through telehealth. Acute care is available to employee’s children ages 3\-17, regardless of health insurance coverage, and for employee’s adult children (ages 18\-26\) or employee’s spouse if covered on the county’s health insurance. * **Wellness:** The County recognizes the importance of our health and well\-being. We maintain a very proactive and effective Wellness Program, including reimbursement and discounts for gym membership, incentives for physical activity, on\-site nutrition counseling, free exercise opportunities, wellness education, and more. * **Employee Assistance Program:** Counseling services are available to all County employees and immediate family members in the home. Services are provided in a private and confidential setting (in\-person or virtually). The County provides coverage for the first six visits. **Work Life Balance** * **Annual Leave:**Full\-time employees earn from 10\-24 days annually based on years of service. Service credit from other NC and Local Governments in the retirement system may be transferred to the County. + To help new employees settle in, up to 40 hours of annual leave is advanced upon hire, with first\-year accruals adjusted to align with established annual limits. * **Sick Leave:**Full\-time employees earn one day (8 hours) of sick leave per month. Sick leave from other NC and Local Governments in the retirement system may be transferred to the County. + New hires are advanced up to 40 hours of sick leave, with first\-year accruals adjusted to align with established annual limits. * **Holiday Leave:** Throughout the year, 11 days of paid leave are provided in recognition of holidays. * **Flexible** work schedules. * **Time off** for activities that support our local schools. * Continuing **educational assistance.** * **Discount tickets** to recreational venues. * **Employee appreciation** days/activities. * Tax\-free **flexible spending account** to pay for dependent care. **Financial Security** * **Local Governmental Employees Retirement System:** For employees assigned to work 20 hours per week or more in a benefitted position, participation in this program is automatic. Employees contribute 6% of their salary, which is tax\-deferred. After (5\) years of creditable service, you become fully vested in the retirement system. Employees may also take advantage of individual and group retirement counseling through the Human Resources department. * **401K:** The County provides a 2% contribution plus an additional 1% match (up to 3% total contribution by the County). Our sworn law enforcement officers receive a flat 5% contribution to their 401k. * **Other Tax Deferred Programs:** Other tax\-sheltering programs are available through IRS Code 125 (Cafeteria Plan), and a 457 supplemental retirement plan (Deferred Compensation). * **Longevity Pay:** After 5 years of creditable service, employees receive an annual longevity payment that is paid every year thereafter. This lump sum payment rewards employees for their length of service to Catawba County. The amount is based on years of service. * **Life Insurance:** Death benefit equal to one times the employee’s annual salary, with a minimum coverage amount of $25,000\. Optional supplemental life insurance coverage is also available for both employee and dependents through payroll deduction at group rates. * **Short Term Disability:** Available at no cost to employees, benefits are available after a 55\-day waiting period. * **Long Term Disability:** Available through payroll deduction at group rates. * **Eligibility for membership and financial services** at State Employees Credit Union (SECU)/Local Government Federal Credit Union (LGFCU).

jobs.title: QA/QC Technical Reviewer- Structural – Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description: **QA/QC Technical Reviewer\- Structural – Los Angeles, CA** Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| Los Angeles, California **Why Join Our Team** Join a dynamic team supporting the planning, design, construction, and modernization of educational facilities throughout California. As a QA/QC Technical Reviewer\- Structural, you will play a key role in providing technical review and quality assurance/quality control for structural engineering plans, specifications, and construction projects. Working alongside District personnel, commissioned architects and engineers, consultant staff, Owner Authorized Representatives, Inspectors, Design Managers, and public agency representatives, you will help ensure projects meet applicable codes, standards, District requirements, and quality expectations. **About Your Role** The QA/QC Technical Reviewer\- Structural will perform technical review of proposed structural plans and specifications submitted by District personnel, consultant staff, or commissioned architects and engineers for construction projects. This role involves reviewing structural design and documentation for adherence to District standards, quality, constructability, coordination with other disciplines, building codes, and technical requirements. The position will also provide technical comments and recommendations, support the development and maintenance of District design guidelines and standards, review proposed product substitutions and deviations from District standards, and provide structural technical advice to Owner Authorized Representatives, Inspectors, Design Managers, and A/E teams. **Education Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Structural Engineering or a related field from a recognized college or university required. * Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for up to two (2\) years of the educational requirement, on a year\-for\-year basis. **What You'll Need to Get the Job Done** * Ten (10\) years of full\-time paid professional experience in structural engineering planning, design, and construction of educational facilities. * Valid California Professional Engineer (PE) license by the State Board for Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors. * Knowledge of architecture and structural engineering practices applied to repairs, modernizations, and new construction of K\-12 school building planning, design, and construction. * Knowledge of architectural and structural engineering specifications and related contract documents. * Knowledge of state and local building codes and construction industry standards and their application to school construction, including the jobs.description: **About Care Access** Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. **With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world\-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.** We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, **and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.** With programs like *Future of Medicine*, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and *Difference Makers*, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all. To learn more about Care Access, visit www.CareAccess.com. ### **How This Role Makes a Difference** The **Senior Engineer, Test Automation** is responsible for designing, implementing, and advancing the automated testing infrastructure that supports Care Access's regulated software platforms. This position develops and maintains scalable test automation frameworks, with a strong emphasis on Playwright\-based end\-to\-end testing, to ensure the quality, reliability, and compliance of software solutions throughout the development lifecycle. The role applies expertise in GxP validation principles and computerized system validation to support software quality within a regulated environment. The Senior Engineer collaborates closely with cross\-functional product, engineering, and quality teams to integrate automated testing into development and deployment processes, promote quality engineering best practices, and continuously improve testing strategies. This position also evaluates and implements emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted testing approaches, to expand test coverage, improve efficiency, and strengthen software validation while ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory and organizational requirements. ### **How You'll Make An Impact** * Build, maintain, and improve the end\-to\-end test automation framework, with Playwright as the primary toolchain across UI, API, and integration layers. * Author and maintain release validation documentation, in support of 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP compliance. * Evaluate and apply AI\-assisted testing techniques, such as LLM\-based test generation and intelligent failure triage, to extend coverage and reduce toil. * Integrate and maintain quality gates across CI/CD pipelines, balancing speed with the rigor required for a regulated environment. * Partner with engineers during active development to shift quality left — writing tests alongside features and surfacing risk early. * Contribute to QA process improvements and share knowledge with teammates; you're a resource others lean on without being responsible for managing them. ### **The Expertise Required** * Strong proficiency with Playwright and experience building automation frameworks that are reliable and easy to maintain. * Exposure to GxP validation practices — you have contributed to or authored traceability matrices and validation summary reports. * Familiarity with 21 CFR Part 11, GCP, or similar regulatory frameworks as they apply to software systems. * Curiosity about AI tooling in testing — you've experimented with or are eager to explore LLM\-assisted test generation and failure analysis. * Solid engineering fundamentals: you can read production code, debug across the stack, and build test infrastructure engineers actually want to use. * Clear communication: you can explain test strategy and risk tradeoffs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. ### **Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience** * Minimum Education: + Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience * Minimum Experience: + 5\+ years of software or QA engineering experience, with meaningful depth in test automation. ### **How We Work Together** * **Location**: Remote within the United States. jobs.title: Principal Architect, Infrastructure
jobs.description: The Principal Architect, Infrastructure leads the design of infrastructure solutions to support the strategic objectives of Carnival Cruise Line. This role involves technically leading and creating detailed designs and documentation to support the development, implementation, and operations of enterprise\-class systems used globally across ship and shore locations. The Principal Architect role serves both as the architecture lead and mentor to other architects and engineers. **Essential Functions:** * Design: Lead collaboration with key stakeholders to design and implement secure, robust, and scalable infrastructure solutions aligned with business objectives. Perform engineering function on projects as required. Collaborate with various teams, including networking, facility, and applications, to ensure solutions meet requirements and comply with Carnival Corporation policies and processes. Lead the design, plan, document, and support the configuration of logical and physical system layouts with a focus on reducing operating costs or increasing guest and crew experience. Provide cost estimates (i.e. labor, hardware, software, etc.) for capital and project planning. Lead collaboration with the engineering teams to adjust designs, intake as\-built documents, and make appropriate adjustments to documentation and designs. Educate team members on Carnival’s infrastructure strategies, tools, and frameworks. * Compliance and Security: Ensure that infrastructure solutions adhere to security policies, and compliance requirements. Lead the definition of best practices and ensure they are documented and implemented. Lead Disaster Recovery and Business continuity planning, testing, and execution. * Operations: Ensure consistent and reliable operations across infrastructure platforms through oversight of managed service providers, contractors, and other stakeholders. Ensure the optimization of the enterprise infrastructure architecture to achieve high availability and performance for various business applications. Collaborate with vendors for implementation and remediation efforts. Ensure automation and monitoring. Recommend and implement solutions to ensure operational efficiency and system reliability. Lead independent platform assessments and develop procedures to confirm or establish that standards are implemented correctly and are effective. * Review postmortem document and make changes to architecture and planning for the solution. Lead the resolution of challenging problems on availability, scalability, and performance to prevent critical applications outages. * Support: Collaborate with CCL Service Delivery Managers on production issues. Act as level 4 escalation for managed service provider, diagnose and resolve production issues as required. Ensure that changes made to production are reflected design documentation. Mentor and lead technical and tactical teams when necessary. * Governance: Develop, document, and maintain architectural standards and policies that improve the resilience and performance of the company’s IT infrastructure. Ensure internal processes are followed (i.e. CAB, PRRB, ATR). Design and implement security and disaster recovery strategies. Provide project guidance and direction to project teams, ensuring proper practices are followed and risks are mitigated. * Research and Innovation: Function as a SME for Infrastructure design. Stay abreast of emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices. Research new tools, frameworks, and methodologies that can enhance solution designs and delivery. Evaluate and recommend solutions. Develop and communicate technology roadmaps. Review and improve tools, methods, processes, and procedures. Collaborate to develop and document next generation systems. Lead the development of system solution standards. * Leadership: Coach, review, and delegate work to less experienced staff. Sought out by other technicians and leaders for expertise. Collaborates directly with business leaders. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** * Scope: \- Partner with Shipboard personnel, Collaborate with both Shoreside and Shipboard, Global Responsibilities (All Brands). Provides enterprise\-wide technical leadership for the architecture, design, and evolution of the organization's infrastructure platforms, including cloud, data center, compute, storage, networking, virtualization, identity, endpoint services, and foundational technologies. Establishes architectural standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps that support business growth, cybersecurity, operational resilience, and digital transformation initiatives. Leads the most complex infrastructure modernization efforts, evaluates emerging technologies, and ensures infrastructure investments align with enterprise strategy, compliance requirements, and operational excellence. Serves as the organization's highest\-level infrastructure technical authority, partnering with executives, security, application arch gement via various SDLCs (i.e. Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid, etc.) * 5\+ years’ Experience informally leading cross\-functional technology teams. * 1\+ years In the cruise and/or travel industry. Travel: Less than 25% with shipboard travel likely Work Conditions:Work primarily in a climate\-controlled environment with minimal safety/health hazard potential. Physical Demands:. Must be able to remain in a stationary position at a desk and/or computer for extended periods of time. This position is classified as “remote.” As a remote role, it allows employees to work full\-time from their home. It may also require regular travel to Carnival headquarters in Miami, FL for in\-office collaboration. At Carnival, your total rewards package is much more than your base salary. All non\-sales roles participate in an annual cash bonus program, while sales roles have an incentive plan. Director and above roles may also be eligible to participate in Carnival’s discretionary equity incentive plan. Plus, Carnival provides comprehensive and innovative benefits to meet your needs, including: * Health Benefits: + Cost\-effective medical, dental and vision plans + Employee Assistance Program and other mental health resources + Additional programs include company paid term life insurance and disability coverage * Financial Benefits: + 401(k) plan that includes a company match + Employee Stock Purchase plan * Paid Time Off + Holidays – All full\-time and part\-time with benefits employees receive days off for 8 company\-wide holidays, plus 2 additional floating holidays to be taken at the employee’s discretion. + Vacation Time – All full\-time employees at the manager and below level start with 14 days/year; director and above level start with 19 days/year. Part\-time with benefits employees receive time off based on the number of hours they work, with a minimum of 84 hours/year. All employees gain additional vacation time with further tenure. + Sick Time – All full\-time employees receive 80 hours of sick time each year. Part\-time with benefits employees receive time off based on the number of hours they work, with a minimum of 60 hours each year. * Other Benefits + Complementary stand\-by cruises, employee discounts on confirmed cruises, plus special rates for family and friends + Personal and professional learning and development resources including tuition reimbursement + On\-site Fitness center at our Miami campus \#CCL \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-LS1 About Us At Carnival Cruise Line, our mission is to consistently deliver safe, fun, and memorable vacations at a great value. jobs.title: Coherent DSP Applications Engineer
jobs.description: Principal Applications Engineer Irvine, CA or San Jose, CA About the Role Celero is seeking a hands\-on, highly motivated Coherent DSP Applications Engineer to help bring next\-generation coherent optical DSP solutions from the lab to customer deployment. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment, enjoys solving complex technical challenges, and wants to make a direct impact on both products and customers. As a key member of the team, you will work closely with DSP, ASIC, hardware, firmware, and product engineering teams, while partnering directly with hyperscale customers and strategic partners to integrate, validate, debug, and optimize coherent DSP\-based optical solutions. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence product direction, contribute to customer success, and help shape the future of high\-speed optical connectivity for AI infrastructure and cloud networking. What You'll Do Customer Integration and Technical Leadership * Serve as the technical owner for customer integration and deployment of coherent DSP\-based optical modules and systems. * Work directly with hyperscalers, network equipment manufacturers (NEMs), and strategic partners to support: * System design and architecture discussions * Platform integration and bring\-up * Interoperability and qualification testing * Field trials and early customer deployments * Configure, tune, and optimize coherent DSP parameters to maximize performance and reliability. Debug and System Validation * Troubleshoot complex issues spanning multiple disciplines, including: * DSP algorithms and signal processing * Optical impairments, including chromatic dispersion (CD) and differential group delay (DGD) * Host electrical interfaces, including 200G/400G/800G PAM4 and beyond * Module management and control interfaces, including CMIS and telemetry * Analyze system performance metrics, including BER, Q\-factor, SNR, and debug logs, and drive issues to root cause. * Support interoperability testing in multi\-vendor environments. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Partner closely with DSP, ASIC, hardware, firmware, and systems engineering teams to resolve issues and improve product performance. * Contribute to technical documentation, application notes, validation reports, and customer\-facing materials. * Provide direct feedback to engineering and product teams on feature prioritization, product requirements, and roadmap decisions. What You Bring * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Optical Engineering or Applied Physics Related technical discipline * 8\+ years of experience" and "ability to travel up to 25–40% to customer sites as needed * Strong fundamentals in digital signal processing, telecommunications theory, and optical communications. Hands\-on experience with: * Coherent modulation techniques, including QPSK and 16\-QAM * Forward Error Correction (FEC) and framers * DWDM optical systems and coherent transceivers * Experience debugging complex hardware and software interactions in a laboratory environment. * Ability to independently solve ambiguous, cross\-functional technical problems. * Ability to generate technical documentation, such as Applications notes, Data sheets, Product requirement Documents, etc. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with customers and internal engineering teams. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting coherent optical module products, including: * 400ZR * 800ZR * Coherent Lite * Familiarity with QSFP\-DD and OSFP coherent modules. * Knowledge of high\-speed host electrical interfaces, including CEI\-112G, PAM4, and next\-generation standards. * Experience using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for analysis, automation, and data processing. * Experience working with hyperscalers, network equipment manufacturers (NEMs), or cloud infrastructure providers. * Exposure to open networking environments and multi\-vendor interoperability testing. How You'll Succeed * You are comfortable working in ambiguous environments and can make progress without perfect specifications. * You take ownership and drive issues to resolution from initial discovery through deployment. * You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. * You enjoy learning quickly and contributing beyond a narrowly defined role. * You are excited to help shape not only a product, but also a company and its culture. Why Join Celero? * Work on cutting\-edge coherent DSP technology powering next\-generation AI infrastructure and optical networking. * Make a direct impact on product direction and customer success. * Collaborate with a small, highly experienced engineering team. * Gain exposure across DSP, optics, ASICs, firmware, systems, and customer applications. * Grow your career quickly in a dynamic startup environment with significant opportunities for leadership and ownership. Annual Base Salary Range: $175,000 \- $225,000 (The final offer will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location.)

jobs.description: The Systems/Integration Engineer is responsible for integrating complex hardware, software, and subsystems into cohesive, reliable solutions that meet defined technical and mission requirements. The Systems/Integration Engineer collaborates closely with software, hardware, cybersecurity, test, and systems engineering teams to ensure components function together as intended and that integrated solutions meet customer and program requirements. Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Business Services, Health, Infrastructure and Engineering, Mission Optimization, Technology and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long\-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical \- Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays. As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug\-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act. **ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS** The ability to obtain, maintain and access classified information at the Public Trust level. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. system architectures, functional models, interface definitions, and technical documentation. * Integrate hardware, software, network, and other system components into cohesive operational environments. * Define, document, and manage interfaces and dependencies between systems, subsystems, applications, and external systems. * Plan and execute system integration activities, including integration sequencing, configuration, troubleshooting, and technical issue resolution. * Support system\-level testing, verification, and validation to demonstrate compliance with technical and customer requirements. * Analyze system behavior and performance to identify integration risks, defects, dependencies, and potential design issues. * Troubleshoot complex integration problems and coordinate with engineering teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions. * Participate in technical reviews, design reviews, integration planning sessions, and customer meetings. * Develop and maintain system integration plans, test procedures, interface documentation, and other engineering artifacts. * Support configuration management and change control activities to ensure system components and interfaces remain properly synchronized. * Collaborate with software, hardware, network, cybersecurity, test, and other engineering disciplines throughout the system lifecycle. * Track technical issues, integration risks, and dependencies and communicate status, impacts, and recommended actions to program leadership. * Support the development and maintenance of requirements traceability from system requirements through implementation, integration, and verification. * Apply systems engineering and integration methodologies to support the development, deployment, and sustainment of mission\-critical systems. * Support Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and digital engineering activities, where applicable. * Use engineering and requirements\-management tools to document system architectures, requirements, interfaces, and integration activities. Ensure engineering deliverables and integration activities comply with applicable customer, program, and organizational standards. * **EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE** Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline; or the equivalent combination of education, technical training, or work/military experience. A minimum of four (4\) years’ of prior relevant experience **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job. Work is primarily performed in an office/warehouse setting. Regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel. Regularly required to reach with hands and arms, occasionally above head. Regularly required to twist at the waist, climb and descend stairs while carrying objects. Ability to speak and hear. Frequently required to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Occasionally required to sit and climb or balance. Regularly lifts and/or moves up to twenty\-five pounds and occasionally lifts and/or moves up to fifty pounds. Works near moving mechanical parts. Regularly exposed to general office and general office machinery noise. May be exposed to warehouse, truck or forklift noise. EOE including Disability/Vet The estimated pay range for this role is $95,000 to $115,000, with the final offer contingent on location, skillset, and experience. engagements when needed, for example a 90\-day push with a business team to take an entire workflow agentic, and turn what worked into platform capability. * Represent the work credibly to product owners, architects, security, executives, and client stakeholders. **Requirements** * 10\+ years of engineering experience, including designing and owning a platform or shared system used by many teams, and setting technical standards that other senior engineers adopted. * Has built platform infrastructure end to end: runtime and deployment, identity and access, multi\-tenant services, and observability. * A strong track record of designing and shipping agentic systems into production for real users. * Deep production fluency with at least one major agent orchestration framework: Google ADK, LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, Claude Agent SDK, or similar. * Production experience across multiple model families, with clear judgment on when to reach for which. * Production experience on at least one major cloud AI stack. * Integration depth: has connected platforms to enterprise systems of record, including legacy ones. * Command of the agentic development lifecycle: specs as source of truth, evals as continuous integration, prompt and tool versioning, trace\-driven debugging, and sandboxed execution of agentic workloads at scale. * Daily fluency with agentic coding tools; Claude Code preferred. * Communication that lands at every altitude: engineers, domain experts, and senior executives alike. **Preferred** * Has built or led AI\-driven software delivery: coding agents in CI, automated review, spec\-to\-deploy pipelines, developer platforms. * Prior forward deployed or field engineering experience at an AI or data company. * Public artifacts: talks, open source, technical writing. * Consumer goods, retail, or large\-scale measurement data background. **Tech Stack \& Tools** Experience with any of the platforms and frameworks below is relevant; skills transfer readily between them. * Platforms: GCP Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, on\-prem * Orchestration: Google ADK, LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, Claude Agent SDK * Models: Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, open\-weight families * Retrieval: embeddings, vector stores, RAG pipelines * Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Argo, or similar) * Protocols: MCP, A2A, OpenAPI, OAuth 2\.0, SSE, gRPC * Engineering: Python, TypeScript, Claude Code * Delivery: evaluation harnesses as CI, tracing and observability tooling, sandboxed agent execution, CI/CD integration jobs.title: Data Analytics Engineer (Snowflake/DBT) (1042) - Controller's Office - (168329)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Appointment Type:** Permanent Exempt (PEX), Category 18\. This position is excluded by the City Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process and shall serve at the discretion of the Appointing Officer. Duration of this appointment shall not exceed 36 months. * **Application Opening:** 9/25/2026 * **Application Deadline:** May close anytime but no sooner than Friday, 10/16/2026 at 5:00PM (PDT). * **Salary Range:** $143,572 \- $180,596 annually (click here to learn more) **Controller’s Office** The Controller is the City’s chief financial officer. Our team includes financial, technology, analytical, and other professionals who work hard to secure the City’s financial integrity and promote efficient, effective, and accountable government. We hold ourselves to high standards and strive to be a model for good government. We value the diverse backgrounds, perspectives and lived experiences of our teams and clients in everything we do. We work in a collaborative and inclusive environment, promote equal opportunity, and invest in the professional development and well\-being of our team members. You can expect to work alongside colleagues who are committed to serving the public with integrity and want to see positive impacts from their work. We are looking for smart, motivated individuals who want to make a difference and use government to play a role in solving our City’s issues, including addressing long\-standing and harmful disparities in our communities. For a career with purpose and professional growth, join us in the Controller’s Office! **Systems Division of the Controller’s Office:** The Systems Division of the Controller’s Office manages the City and County of San Francisco’s Enterprise Oracle and PeopleSoft Applications, which include Oracle Interaction Hub, PeopleSoft Human Capital Management (HCM), PeopleSoft Financials and Supply Chain Management (FSCM), PeopleSoft Enterprise Learning Management (ELM), and Oracle Business Intelligence. These applications are branded locally as our SF Employee Portal, SF People \& Pay, SF Financials, SF Procurement, SF Learning, and SF Reports and Analytics systems. Collectively, these applications provide a robust, integrated platform that delivers mission\-critical services to 55 City Departments, eliminating the need for hundreds of independent legacy systems and customized applications. The division serves over 35,000 active City employees, 75,000 retirees and 25,000 City vendors (bidders and suppliers). Peripheral and legacy applications also leveraged by the division include Oracle Identify \& Access Management, Sherpa Budget Formulation \& Management, Phire Architect, Control\-M, and FreshWorks. The technology implemented and maintained by the Systems Division provides standardization, transparency, and efficiency for the City’s crucial business processes. Users are fully supported to ensure adoption of these interconnected systems. **Job Description** **Business Intelligence Platform Change Project** The Controller’s Office is working in a multi\-year project to migrate the Reports and Analytics solution into a unified Snowflake\-based platform. The BI Platform Change will provide departments with secure, streamlined access to PeopleSoft data, improving efficiency, governance, and standardizing data sharing citywide. By replacing outdated processes, this modern framework supports transparency, accountability, collaboration, better service delivery, strategic growth, and public trust. **Job Description:** This IS Engineer position will be part of the BI Platform Change project and will work with members of the SF Reports \& Analytics Team, Functional Teams and other City and County staff to support the project. The analyst will perform both functional (business process and systems analysis) and technical (report, query and dashboard development, data extract, load and transformation, metadata modeling, tuning, and troubleshooting) tasks. This position will be supporting the current Oracle BI platform, but it will also collaborate in the building of the new business intelligence platform using tools such as dbt, SQL, and other tools with a Snowflake data warehouse source and target. **Essential duties include but are not limited to:** * Analyze the interrelationships of business processes, complex financial data, human resources data, and systems to develop reporting requirements and data structures. * Perform fit/gap analysis to evaluate reporting and data needs. * Develop and maintain OBIEE/OAS dashboards, analyses, and BI Publisher reports. * Design and enhance RPDs (Physical, BMM \& Presentation Layers). * Support Subject Areas, Logical Table Sources (LTS), and metadata models. * Develop ETL solutions using ODI, perform query optimization, cache management, and performance tuning, support production issues, enhancements, and troubleshooting activities * Write business and system process and technical documentation. * plating to support reusable transformations across multiple datasets and environments * Hands\-on experience in GitHub for code change management and collaboration with other team members * Experience in building and deploying data pipelines using orchestration tools * Understanding the process to build and deploy data pipelines using orchestration tools * Deep understanding of data warehouse concepts, data modeling, and modern ETL principles * Understanding of data governance, data security, and data privacy principles * Understanding of PeopleSoft applications such as PeopleSoft Financials and Supply Chain Management (FSCM), PeopleSoft Capital Human Resources (HCM) experience performing data analysis, design and testing. * Working with DBAs, BI Development team, PeopleSoft, and Security teams to improve performance and data quality using Agile sessions * Working knowledge of business process flows used to support a complex accounting system, and experience in developing and executing application test plans. **Collaboration and Communication Skills** * Strong problem\-solving skills with ability to design practical and effective data solutions * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * A collaborative mindset with enthusiasm to work across diverse, cross\-functional teams **Mission alignment** * Commitment to equity, transparency, and ethical data use * Passion for public service using data to improve government services **Additional Information** **Selection Procedures** The selection process will include evaluation of applications in relation to minimum requirements. Candidates whose qualifications most closely meet the needs of the Department will move forward in the recruitment process. **Additional Information Regarding Employment with the City and County of San Francisco:** * Information About the Hiring Process * Conviction History * Employee Benefits Overview * Equal Employment Opportunity * Disaster Service Worker * ADA Accommodation * Right to Work * Copies of Application Documents * Diversity Statement **Where to Apply** All job applications for the City and County of San Francisco must be submitted through our online portal. Please visit https://careers.sf.gov/ to begin your application process. Computers are available for the public (9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Monday through Friday) to file online applications in the lobby of the Dept. of Human Resources at 1 South Van Ness Avenue, 4th Floor and at the City Career Center at City Hall, 1 Dr. Carlton B. Goodlett Place, Room 110\. Ensure your application information is accurate, as changes may not be possible after submission. Your first and last name must match your legal ID for verification, and preferred names can be included in parentheses. Use your personal email address, not a shared or work email, to avoid unfixable issues. Applicants will receive a confirmation email from **notification@smartrecruiters.com** that their online application has been received in response to every announcement for which they file. Applicants should retain this confirmation email for their records. **Failure to receive this email means that the online application was not submitted or received.** If you have any questions regarding this recruitment or application process, please contact the Nancy Giang at nancy.giang@sfgov.org. Recruitment ID: RTF0168328\-01159490 The City and County of San Francisco encourages women, minorities and persons with disabilities to apply. Applicants will be considered regardless of their sex, race, age, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition (associated with cancer, a history of cancer, or genetic characteristics), HIV/AIDS status, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, military and veteran status, or other protected category under the law.

jobs.title: SCADA System Analyst I - Software Specialist
jobs.description: **City Utilities Engineering** **Hours:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; hours may vary ***Do you enjoy using programming, data, and automation to solve real\-world problems? Join City Utilities Engineering and help support the software and control systems that keep Fort Wayne's essential water, sewer, and stormwater operations running.*** **What You'll Do** As the SCADA System Analyst I – Software Specialist, you will help develop, support, and improve the software behind City Utilities' industrial control systems. You will work alongside engineers and operations staff to maintain SCADA applications, databases, process historians, dashboards, data pipelines, and virtualized operational technology infrastructure. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys programming and troubleshooting but also wants to see how their work directly supports critical public infrastructure. **Key Responsibilities** * Configure and support SCADA applications, HMIs, graphical interfaces, and industrial control platforms, with an emphasis on Inductive Automation Ignition. * Create, maintain, and document custom scripts and software integrations using Python, SQL, C, C\+\+, or related programming languages. * Maintain SQL databases, process historians, dashboards, reports, historical trends, and data collection or migration pipelines. * Support control\-system servers, virtual networks, telemetry systems, and industrial communications, including Ethernet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, and LAN/WAN connectivity. * Troubleshoot SCADA connections to PLCs and field devices using alarms, event logs, historical trends, and communication\-analysis tools. * Partner with engineering and operations teams to identify control\-system needs, develop solutions, document completed work, and support automation projects. * Train employees on SCADA interfaces and custom or newly implemented software solutions. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled software, and assist with their responsible implementation and long\-term management. **What You Bring** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical or Computer Engineering Technology, or another approved engineering discipline from an accredited college or university; **or** * An equivalent combination of education and hands\-on experience. * At least two years of experience in an industrial environment involving industrial control systems, programming, instrumentation, database management, or process automation. **Technical Skills** * Knowledge of industrial control and SCADA platforms; Inductive Automation Ignition experience is preferred. * Experience with SQL databases, queries, and custom database solutions. * Ability to read, modify, create, and document scripts using Python, SQL, C, C\+\+, or related languages. * Understanding of process historians, dashboards, reporting tools, virtual infrastructure, and PLC interfaces. * Knowledge of industrial communications, including Ethernet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, gateways, routers, and wireless systems. * Basic understanding of industrial instrumentation used to measure level, flow, pressure, and other process conditions. * Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and teamwork skills. * Ability to explain technical information clearly to engineers, operations employees, and vendors. **Preferred Certifications** * Inductive Automation Ignition Core or Gold Certification. * Candidates without these certifications must have the interest and ability to pursue them during employment. * A valid Indiana driver's license is required when operating a City vehicle. **Work Environment** This position includes a combination of office\-based computer work and occasional work within active utility facilities. Employees may encounter industrial equipment, electrical systems, chemicals, weather conditions, elevated areas, and moderate noise. The position may occasionally require climbing, kneeling, crouching, or lifting up to 50 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Why Work for the City of Fort Wayne?** Your work will support the systems that help deliver safe, reliable utility services to the Fort Wayne community. The City offers meaningful work, opportunities to strengthen your technical skills, professional development, paid time off, health benefits, and participation in Indiana's public retirement program. ***The City of Fort Wayne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.***

jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cleerly** We're Cleerly – a healthcare company that's revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world's leading cardiologists and are a growing team of world\-class engineering, operations, medical affairs, marketing, and sales leaders. We raised $223M in Series C funding in 2022 which has enabled rapid growth and continued support of our mission. In December 2024 we received an additional $106M in a Series C extension funding. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on\-site in a location. Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value\-based, AI\-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly's solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world's largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person's risk of heart attacks. At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description. While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time. *Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle. Understanding this role's relevance and importance is critical to achieving Cleerly's quality objectives.* **Job Description** Our Security team is growing and we have an immediate opening for a Cloud Security Engineer with a strong focus on cloud\-native security architecture and design. In this role, you will lead the effort to design, build, and secure our cloud infrastructure, establish robust cloud architecture security standards, and implement infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) security controls directly across our cloud environments. Reporting to the Director of IT and IS, this role will be a multi\-faceted function that assists in maintaining cloud posture, executing core cloud security functions, and acting as a technical expert in architecting secure, scalable cloud systems. The ideal candidate is a self\-motivated individual that is great at task and time management, and is excited to build cloud security directly into our infrastructure from the ground up. **What would I be doing?** As a key member of the Security team, you will collaborate closely with engineering and security leadership to design, build, and maintain secure cloud architecture. You will drive cloud\-native security initiatives by embedding infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) security controls, automated compliance scanning, and cloud configuration hardening across all environments, serving as a cross\-functional partner to ensure robust security throughout our cloud ecosystem. On any given day you could be: * Monitor and analyze cloud\-specific threat landscapes; proactively identify and mitigate risks related to public cloud service misconfigurations. * Maintain cloud security posture by monitoring and triaging alerts from CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management) and cloud\-native security tools; conduct forensic investigations. * Work in a cross function capacity with our DevOps team to automate security monitoring and alerting solutions directly into the CI/CD pipeline using Infrastructure\-as\-Code. * Integrate automated vulnerability scanning and security testing directly into the development lifecycle to ensure continuous security feedback for engineering teams. * Coordinate cross\-functional teams for vulnerability remediation efforts. * Design and audit cloud\-native security controls to ensure continuous compliance and adherence to regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC). * Proactively monitor and evaluate security configurations of systems and applications for continuous improvement and compliance. * Participate in the full security incident response lifecycle, including containment, eradication, and recovery. * Partner with software engineering teams to provide security design consultation, embedding secure\-by\-design principles into cloud architecture and application features. **Qualifications** * 5 to 8\+ years of dedicated Security Engineering experience with a strong focus on AWS security, cloud\-native architecture, and DevSecOps * Demonstrated experience building and architecting security infrastructure from the ground up, serving as the primary architect and functional owner of the security domain * Proven track record implementing cloud\-native security tooling (e.g., CSPM, CWPP) and embedding automated security controls into CI/CD deployment pipelines * Proficiency in Python, Terraform, and Containerization strategies such as Kubernetes and Docker * Strong understanding of SaaS risk management and hardening processes as well as experience in DLP implementations and management * Previous experience working within a startup environment, with excellent verbal and written communication skills to address security concerns across internal stakeholders **Impress us more** * CISSP, CNAPP, or related certifications * Experience in development or implementation of new tooling using the latest available resources or technologies * Experience implementation or use of CSPM tools such as Wiz, Orca, or AWS security tools suite * Experience with implementation and tuning of SIEM and event management tools * Experience in the digital healthcare industry The base salary range for this role varies by location and is aligned to market benchmarks. * Candidates located in **higher\-cost labor markets**, including California, Washington, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts, and Washington, DC represent the middle to high end of the range, while candidates located in **all other U.S. locations** represent the low to middle end of the range. * Final compensation is determined based on location, experience, skills, and internal equity. This role is eligible for a 10**% target annual bonus**, resulting in the following **base salary** and **Total Target Compensation (TTC)** ranges: * **Base Salary:** ***$125,000 \- $175,000*** * Total Target Compensation (TTC): Total Cash Compensation (including base pay, variable pay, commission, bonuses, etc.) Additionally, stock options, paid benefits, and employee perks are part of your total rewards. **Working at Cleerly takes HEART. Discover our Core Values:** * **H: Humility**\- be a servant leader * **E: Excellence**\- deliver world\-changing results * **A: Accountability**\- do what you say; expect the same from others * **R: Remarkable**\- inspire \& innovate with impact * **T: Teamwork**\- together we win Don't meet 100 percent of the qualifications? Apply anyway and help us diversify our candidate pool and workforce. We value experience, whether gained formally or informally on the job or through other experiences. *Job duties, activities and responsibilities are subject to change by our company.* ***OUR COMPANY IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.*** *We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.* For more information see our Privacy Policy (https://cleerlyhealth.com/privacy\-policy). All official emails will come from @cleerlyhealth.com email accounts. \#Cleerly

jobs.title: Forklift Operator
jobs.description: At Clopay Corporation, we are more than just North America’s largest residential and commercial garage door manufacturer, we are a powerhouse of innovation, safety, and design. Through our premier brands, we lead the industry in providing groundbreaking high\-performance closure solutions for both the places people call home and the spaces where the world does business. Headquartered in Mason, Ohio, and operating state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in Troy, Ohio, Mountaintop, Pennsylvania, and Goodyear, Arizona, we are a proud American\-owned company and a wholly\-owned subsidiary of Griffon Corporation. Our reach extends across 55\+ distribution centers and thousands of retail locations in the U.S. and Canada ensuring that we deliver the right door for every opening – from homes to businesses and beyond. By joining our team, you become part of a legacy that blends the residential elegance of Clopay, known as "America’s Favorite Garage Doors," with the industrial strength and 180\-year heritage of our rolling brands, Cornell and Cookson. Together, we secure everything from family garages to the world's most iconic stadiums and skyscrapers. We currently have openings for Forklift Operators / Material Handlers in our Troy, Ohio location. The starting pay for a Forklift Operator is $19\.40 plus $1\.00 shift differential. Wage increases up to $25\.61 after 24 months. Shift Schedule: * 2nd shift hours Monday – Friday 3pm\-11pm. * 3rd shift hours Monday – Friday 11pm\-7am. * Weekends (Friday, Saturday, Sunday) 7am\-7pm. Responsibilities include: * Unload incoming shipments off trucks. * Compare incoming shipments against bills of lading, invoices, or other records to verify accuracy of order. * Unpack and examine incoming product for damage; move materials to correct storage area or department. * Maintain accurate inventory records by scanning materials moved in and out of warehouse, and completing sub inventory transfers. * Convey incoming materials from receiving platform to storage or work areas by using forklift, tow motor, hand trucks or other devices. * Perform inventory as required; inform supervisor of any shortages. * Follow prescribed safety regulations. * Maintain the work area and equipment in a clean and orderly condition. * Perform other job\-related duties and activities as needed. Qualifications: * Qualified candidates must possess a High School diploma or equivalent, must be able to lift 50lbs, and have the ability to work at a quick pace. * Proven experience in warehouse operations. * Forklift operation certification. * Proficient in using RF scanners. * Strong organizational and multitasking abilities. Why Choose a Career With Us? We don't just manufacture doors; we engineer the "front door" of the American dream and the security of global commerce. At Clopay, we believe our strength lies in our people. From our design engineers to our manufacturing associates and delivery drivers, every member of the team plays a vital role in our success. Our team members thrive because we prioritize: * Unrivaled Scale: Work for a market leader with a massive manufacturing footprint and a reputation for excellence that spans nearly two centuries. * A Culture of "What’s Next": We invest heavily in automation, sustainable materials, and smart\-home integration to stay ahead of the curve. * Commitment to People: As a Griffon Corporation company, we provide the stability of a large organization with the tight\-knit, collaborative feel of a specialized craft team. * A Legacy of Expertise: Join our "Pioneer Club"—a group of over 440 employees who have been with us for 20 years or more. We offer the stability of a market leader and a place where you can truly grow a lifelong career. * Commitment to Innovation: We aren’t just keeping up with industry trends; we’re setting them. Whether it’s our exclusive WINDCODE® technology or our award\-winning designs, we provide the tools for you to do your best work. * Community Focused: Our success is linked to the well\-being of our neighbors and communities. Through our partnership with Habitat for Humanity, Clopay employees help provide homes and security to families in the communities where we live and work. Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Telecom Infrastructure Network Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Who We Are** Our purpose at CloudHQ is to provide flexible, efficient and resilient data center solutions to businesses of all sizes. Our growing organization was founded by the pioneer of data center REITs. CloudHQ has state\-of\-the\-art data center sites located on two Northern Virginia campuses, as well as London, Frankfurt, Paris, and São Paulo, and we anticipate exponential growth over the next several years both in the US and abroad. **What The Role Entails** Based in Ashburn, Virginia, the Telecom Infrastructure Network Engineer at CloudHQ develops and maintains the physical\-layer engineering for fiber\-optic connectivity across inside\-plant and outside\-plant environments. The role manages routes, mapping, construction drawings, technical coordination, and utility interfaces from concept through as\-built record completion. **What You Will Get to Do** * Develop physical fiber route concepts and detailed designs for campus, metro, long\-haul, building, and data center connectivity. * Prepare and review route maps, construction drawings, conduit and pathway plans, handhole and manhole details, rack elevations, cable schedules, splice plans, and labeling schemes. * Coordinate proposed routes with utilities, civil teams, property stakeholders, permitting authorities, carriers, and construction contractors. * Perform site surveys and field validation to confirm constructability, pathway availability, access constraints, hazards, and existing conditions. * Create engineering scopes, technical specifications, bills of material, design packages, and installation requirements. * Review contractor submittals, requests for information, design changes, redlines, test plans, and as\-built documentation. * Maintain accurate GIS, CAD, fiber\-management, and asset records, including cable segments, strands, splices, terminations, pathways, and capacity assignments. * Support construction and commissioning by resolving field conflicts, evaluating proposed changes, and documenting approved deviations. * Define and review acceptance testing requirements, including applicable optical loss, continuity, and reflectometry records. **Success Measures** * Design packages are accurate, buildable, coordinated, and issued on schedule. * Field changes and engineering decisions are documented and reflected in final records. * Fiber, pathway, splice, and termination records remain complete and traceable. * Installed systems meet approved design and acceptance requirements. Requirements: **What you Bring to the Role** * 3\+ years of technical infrastructure management experience * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, telecommunications, network engineering, civil engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. * Demonstrated experience designing or engineering physical fiber\-optic infrastructure. * Ability to read and produce route plans, construction drawings, schematics, schedules, and as\-built records. * Knowledge of fiber cable, pathways, splice closures, panels, termination hardware, testing concepts, and outside\-plant construction methods. * Experience coordinating with utilities, civil construction teams, carriers, vendors, and field technicians. * Strong analytical, documentation, and technical communication skills. **Our Ideal Candidate Will Also Possess** * Experience with GIS, AutoCAD or similar drafting tools, and fiber\-management or network\-inventory platforms. * Experience integrating inside\-plant and outside\-plant records across multiple facilities, regions, or countries. * Familiarity with data center pathways, meet\-me rooms, carrier entrances, diverse routing, and critical\-environment change controls. **What We Offer** CloudHQ’s people and culture are the most enriching aspects that make us a great place to work. We are strengthened by industry experts who bring extensive knowledge, skill, and experience; leaders who bring vision, innovation and commitment to our people; and an expanding team of individuals who believe in that vision, and bring their best to support their customers and team. Our employees enjoy competitive compensation and rewarding incentives, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability), 401(k) with match, 12 paid holidays, generous PTO, development opportunities, and the ability to closely impact and contribute to the growth of an exceptional organization. **Equal Employment Opportunity** CloudHQ is an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Cloud Software Engineer (Azure)
jobs.description: **Cloud Software Engineer (Azure)** **About the role** As a Cloud Software Engineer, you will make an impact by architecting and building cloud\-native, API\-driven solutions on Microsoft Azure that move, transform, and orchestrate data securely across enterprise systems. You will be a valued member of the engineering team and work collaboratively with product owners, architects, and cross\-functional Agile delivery teams. *\*Please note that this position is not eligible for visa transfer or sponsorship now or at any time in the future\** *\*\*Please note: A few of our roles may require in\-person interviews at Cognizant offices or client locations, depending on project or client needs. \*\** **In this role, you will** * Architect and develop solutions on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, and related services for data movement, transformation, and orchestration between systems. * Own the full API lifecycle using Azure API Management, including API design (REST, OpenAPI/Swagger), development, versioning, security, analytics, monitoring, and deprecation. * Implement API security, including authentication and authorization with Azure Active Directory, and develop and manage custom API security policies, mTLS, and API throttling. * Develop APIs using GraphQL as well as Java, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Boot. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Git and GitHub Actions while working within Agile/Scrum teams. **Work model** At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.description: Color is revolutionizing cancer care with the nation’s first Virtual Cancer Clinic, delivering high\-quality, physician\-led multidisciplinary care across all 50 states. Our innovative, guideline\-based approach spans cancer screening, risk assessment, prevention, diagnosis, treatment support, and survivorship. In addition to personalized direct medical care, our services include cancer genetics risk assessment, nutrition, mental health support and at\-home cancer screening diagnostics. Using technology\-driven, patient\-centric solutions, Color is transforming how employers, unions, health plans, and governments address cancer. Color’s goal is to close critical cancer care gaps, improve cancer outcomes, and guide patients with empathy through their healthcare journeys. **The Team:** The **AI Platform Team** explores how rapidly evolving AI capabilities can create meaningful impact for patients, clinicians, and Color teams. We are a small, highly collaborative, cross\-functional team of engineers, product managers, designers, and clinical partners. We build AI applications, experiment with emerging models, tools, techniques and interaction patterns, and turn what works into durable patterns and capabilities that can be used across Color. We embrace rapid experimentation, learning quickly from new technologies and real\-world use, and bringing the most promising ideas into production. Given the pace at which AI is advancing, our goal is not simply to adopt the latest AI technology, but to identify where it creates meaningful value in cancer care and deliver AI experiences that are safe, reliable, and impactful. **The Role:** We’re hiring a **full\-stack Senior Software Engineer** to build AI products and the platform that powers them across Color. This new role will report to the Senior Director of AI Platform and work across the stack \- from intuitive clinician and patient\-facing AI experiences to the backend services and infrastructure that power them. This is a full\-stack role and we’re looking for candidates with senior level experience across frontend, backend and systems engineering. We seek a hands\-on builder with strong product instincts and deep curiosity about AI. You should be someone who experiments constantly, follows advancements in models and tooling, and translates emerging capabilities into reliable products. You will also raise Color’s AI fluency by sharing insights and demonstrating effective building patterns. **How You’ll Contribute:** * Build full\-stack AI applications for Color’s care teams and patients, owning features from user experience through backend services, AI orchestration, data access, and production deployment. * Explore where emerging AI capabilities can meaningfully improve cancer care and how Color works, moving rapidly from ideas to prototypes to shipped experiences. * Experiment rapidly with emerging AI capabilities, turning promising models, tools, and techniques into prototypes and incrementally evolving the best ideas into production systems. * Develop reliable LLM\-powered systems, including retrieval and knowledge systems, citations and grounding, prompt management, structured outputs, tool use, agentic workflows, and evaluation. * Develop the evaluation, observability, and safety practices needed to understand AI quality, compare approaches, identify regressions, and confidently evolve successful experiments into durable products. * Design privacy\- and security\-conscious systems appropriate for sensitive healthcare data and clinical workflows. * Partner closely with product, design, clinical, and engineering teams to understand problems, prototype solutions, learn from users, and ship improvements quickly. * Raise Color’s AI fluency by sharing experiments, emerging techniques, lessons learned, and strong patterns for building with AI across the company. * Mentor others and raise the technical and product quality bar. **Possible Projects To Contribute To:** * **Healthbook:** Build and evolve an internal AI application that helps our care and clinical teams understand patients’ longitudinal health histories, synthesize records, answer grounded questions with citations, and draft documents using an AI agent. * **AI Platform:** Build shared capabilities that enable teams across Color to develop reliable AI applications quickly, including knowledge bases and retrieval, citations and grounding, prompt management, evaluation, observability, and reusable agentic patterns. * **What’s next:** Explore the next generation of patient\-facing AI experiences, and turn what we learn into platform capabilities that enable teams across Color to build with AI. **Our Ideal Candidate Will Have**: * 5\+ years of experience building and shipping production software, with strong full\-stack skills across React/TypeScript, Python, APIs, data integrations, and cloud infrastructure. * Hands\-on experience building production AI products with modern LLMs, including patterns such as RAG, structured outputs, tool calling, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. * Experience turning complex, heterogeneous data into useful product experiences and taking systems from prototype through production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration. * Strong product judgment and the ability to balance speed, technical quality, reliability, and user impact in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments. * A bias toward tinkering, rapid experimentation, and learning. You start small, prototype quickly, measure what works, and recognize when new AI capabilities create opportunities for a larger leap. * An informed point of view on how AI is changing software engineering and product development. You regularly experiment with new models, frameworks, coding tools, agent architectures, and interaction patterns—and communicate what you learn. You are someone others at Color look to for what’s new in AI, what works in practice, and how we should apply it. **Nice to Have:** * Experience building AI platforms or shared infrastructure that empowered multiple teams to ship AI applications. * Experience developing healthcare technology involving sensitive clinical data. *We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.* **What We Offer:** * Competitive salary * ✨ Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits * 401k match * Monthly phone and wifi stipend for employees, annual ergonomic stipend * Generous vacation policy, paid holidays and company\-wide recharge days * Equal paid parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Free cancer screening and prevention resources for employees and their adult dependents **Base Salary Range:** $175,000 \- $230,000 *The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: work experience, market data, skills, geographic location, and business need. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for equity and benefits.* Color prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Color conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities in our recruitment process.
