We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** We're hiring a Senior Engineering Manager for the team that owns the financial core of our revenue cycle product. That's three things: the ledger that records every financial event, the reports that billing managers and CFOs close their books on, and the analytics that tell a practice how it's doing. You'll manage 6 to 8 engineers, from early\-career to Senior Staff, own the roadmap with your product partner, and be accountable for financial correctness across the platform. We're partway through rebuilding this surface: moving a decade of report logic onto a drift\-free ledger and a modern OLAP layer, while customers keep closing their books on the old one. **What You'll Do** * Manage and grow a team of 6 to 8 engineers. Hiring, performance, career growth. Build people who can each run a customer escalation, a data migration, or an incident end\-to\-end without you in the room. * Set the roadmap with your product partner. The goal is to get from building whatever report a customer asked for to customers building their own reports and closing their books without us involved. * Own financial correctness. For this team, wrong numbers are a worse failure than a slow page. You'll own the systems that catch silent errors: shadow parity harnesses, cross\-report tie\-out checks, drift monitoring, and correctness SLOs next to the uptime ones. * Lead multi\-quarter migrations (ledger report migration, OLAP golden views) incrementally, with parity checks at each step, without breaking anyone's close. * Own the customer relationship at the top of the stack. Sit with comptrollers, CFOs, and RCM directors at our largest sites during month\-end. Turn their definition of "correct" into software, and turn recurring escalations into roadmap. * Run cross\-team execution with the payments/posting team, data infrastructure, and ops so upstream changes don't quietly break downstream numbers. **What You Have** * 5\+ years managing software engineers, including senior and staff\-level ICs. You've grown engineers into leads and staff engineers, and you can name them. * You've shipped financial, reporting, or data\-intensive systems in production where the numbers had to tie. You know how a report can be technically correct and still wrong to the person reading it. * Backend and data fluency. You can review a query plan, push back on a ledger design, and debug a parity failure yourself. Staff engineers will take you seriously because you engage with the substance. * You've set direction for a product surface and can say what it should look like in 12 months. * You're comfortable across the table from a CFO explaining why a number moved. * Operational discipline: on\-call, SLOs, and monitoring for correctness as well as availability. * You move fast on incomplete information and reset timelines honestly when the work turns out bigger than expected. ### **Nice to Have** * Healthcare RCM, billing, practice management, or clearinghouse background. Or fintech experience with ledgers, close automation, or reconciliation (BlackLine, FloQast, Numeric, Stripe, Modern Treasury). * OLAP stores (StarRocks, ClickHouse, Druid) run alongside PostgreSQL. * Double\-entry accounting, append\-only ledgers, or audit\-trail requirements. * Leading a platform re\-architecture while keeping the existing system shipping. * Shipping LLM features to production. We run an AI report builder that handles thousands of custom reporting requests. Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis. Compensation Range: $240K \- $275K

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description: Overview: Complete Building Services (CBS) is a company that is passionate about the operation and maintenance of buildings/facilities in the commercial and government sectors. CBS is the largest division of The Donohoe Companies, Inc. \- Washington DC's most established real estate company. At CBS, we celebrate and empower our talented employees \- and it shows as we have been ranked by the Washington Business Journal as the Best Place to Work multiple times. Perks \& Benefits We offer a full slate of benefits, including competitive salaries, medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverages, FSA, flexible vacation, commuter benefits, and a 401k plan with a match. And...we offer some not\-so\-standard, extra great benefits, including tuition reimbursement for education/certifications, employee discounts programs (including hotels and our vendor's products), and an Employee Assistance Program that offers free financial consultants, therapists, and lawyers. We value diversity and believe in forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is the key to our success. Come join us, and find out what the best work of your career could look like for you. Responsibilities: Complete Building Services is looking for an Assistant Project Manager (APM) in Martinsburg, WV. The APM shall provide assistance and daily coordination for building\-related infrastructure and tenant alteration projects, as well as regularly interface both verbally and in writing with Tenants, Tenant Representatives, Property Management, Engineering Staff, construction professionals, and other vendors. Must be flexible with time and schedule as needed. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Obtain cost estimates and prepare quotes for TWO’s and IRO’s * Assign projects to subcontractors or design professional consultants and subcontractors, as needed, as determined by the Government * Coordinate and schedule projects, including pricing, estimating costs, and processing BSR, TWO, or IRO * Administer BSR, TWO, and IRO including issuing Contractor purchase orders for subcontractors or design professional consultants and subcontractors as required * Provide technical review of projects in advance of submission for AOC Technical Review, to ensure compliance with AOC Standards and to ensure that work fully meets tenant requirements * Provide oversight and supervision of all Contractor staff to ensure on\-time completion of PM’s, BSR’s, TWO’s, and IRO’s * Provide on\-time Deliverables, to the COR * Ensure timely invoice submission of TWO and IRO work efforts * Maintain and administer the CMMS * Conduct Facility Management Services Quality Control, and inspections and thence coordinate CM repairs as required * Maintain professional and effective relationships with the tenants, COR, AOC employees, Security Manager, and Contractor employees * Daily, communicate and coordinate with the on\-site Security Manager employed by the Security Contractor * Ensure all Contractor and subcontractor employees supporting this contract have received the necessary and required training * Ensure all Contractor and subcontractor employees supporting this contract have received necessary Government background checks and badging before reporting on\-site * Ensure all Contractor and subcontractor employees supporting this contract have read and understand the Building Rules and Regulations Salary: $80,000 to $104,000 Hours: 7:00 am to 3:30 pm M\-F ***\*Contingent upon contract award\**** Qualifications: **The Assistant Project Manager shall possess the following minimum qualifications:*** Not less than three (3\) years of previous experience within the last five (5\) years serving in the role of Assistant Project Manager, or Project Manager, at a facility of comparable size, comparable function, with similar infrastructure including (1\) chilled water and steam systems; (2\) UPS Systems; (3\) security surveillance systems; (4\) security physical barrier systems; (5\) fire alarm and fire suppression life safety systems; (6\) generator systems; and (7\) building automated controls systems. Demonstrated experience providing facility management and operation and maintenance management is required. Previous experience managing federal or state office buildings is desirable * Completion of post\-secondary school training in facilities management and supervision, at minimum possess an associate degree in a field related to facility management and operation and maintenance * Demonstrated ability to plan, organize and meet project deadlines * Demonstrated ability to work on several projects simultaneously and prioritize work as required * Demonstrated working technical expertise in engineering and building infrastructure systems * Ability to read and understand blueprints * Proficiency with word processing, spreadsheet, and project tracking software * The Project Manager shall be available for emergency contact via cell phone twenty\-four (24\) hours a day, seven (7\) days a week * The Project Manager shall have availability to work flexible hours as required in response to emergencies * Demonstrated ability to provide error\-free written correspondence (e.g. progress and status reports, notifications, memoranda, executive summaries) in an on\-time manner * Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with a positive and cooperative attitude, orally and in writing, to all audiences; prepare and conduct briefings; make public announcements; coordinate and facilitate meetings * Demonstrated ability and experience managing and coordinating emergency events involving a multitude of parties including tenants, law enforcement and other officials, and several agencies and organizations * Previous experience as Chief Engineer is desirable, but not a requirement * Demonstrated experience managing building reconstitution efforts after building closure due to damage or an emergency event *EOE, including disability/veterans*

jobs.description: Overview: **Who We Are** As the largest private\-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Now integrated with Calpine, our portfolio includes 55 gigawatts of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities, with the generating capacity to power the equivalent of 27 million homes. Our culture and employee experience make it clear: We are powered by passion and purpose. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow. **Total Rewards** Constellation offers an extensive selection of benefits and rewards to help our employees thrive professionally and personally. We provide competitive compensation and a wide\-range of benefits that support both employees and their families, helping them prepare for the future. In addition to highly competitive salaries, eligible employees are offered a bonus program, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase program; comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, including robust wellbeing programs; disability and life insurance benefits; paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick days; and much more. Expected salary range of $145,800 to $162,000, varies based on experience, along with comprehensive benefits package that includes bonus and 401(k). Responsibilities: **Primary Purpose of Position** Lead activities relating to designing, building, testing, implementing and maintaining AI solutions, products and processes. Provide IT teams and business personnel with technology solutions by evaluating technology standards, market availability of products, risks and benefits of technology to deliver solutions that meet business/IT needs. Coordinate the tasks of less experienced engineers and collaborate across teams as needed. Independence level: Works independently with minimal guidance. Works closely with scrum masters, project managers, QA, Creative, and UX team members to ensure compliance with project needs. Your role will be centered on the development and improvement of new and existing features. Additionally, you will be reviewing the code of your peers, advocating for standard development methodologies, and participating in an inclusive, energetic and highly cross\-functional team. The role encompasses architect, design, implementation, and testing to ensure building products right and to release them with high quality. Maintain deep knowledge of technology and its application across our business areas or for our customers, promote knowledge via seminars, presentations and publications within IT and Constellation. Participate in technological innovation to drive new business opportunities and solve complex business problems. Shape and advance core team processes to increase operational efficiency and quality. Coach and lead other engineers assigned to their product or project team. Considered highly skilled and proficient in discipline. Conducts complex, important work under minimal supervision and with wide latitude for independent judgment. **Primary Duties and Accountabilities** * Produce high\-quality, secure, and maintainable code/configurations * Learn and understand business processes with limited guidance * Work collaboratively as a member of the development team to build solutions in an agile environment * Support and research issues across all application layers and database * Identify areas to improve and scale our Azure architecture and design * Ensure code can be deployed using Azure DevOps * Design and query database tables, views, functions, stored procedures and batch processes * Develop, implement, and support interfaces that connect our websites, back\-end systems, and various 3rd party cloud solutions, vendors and customers. * Engage with business partners to gather information, analyze requirements and deliver practical, efficient and cost\-effective solutions that satisfy business needs. * Design, develop and/or review complex code or configurations to ensure AI solutions meet the requirements of functional and technical specifications. * Write product specifications and design documentation for assigned system components. * Design and build large\-scale AI data platforms/products \& frameworks for processing high volumes of data, in real\-time as well as batch, that will be used by teams across the organization * Develop complex data algorithms for AI/ML, data analytics, machine learning, or scientific computing * Utilize indicators to scope and respond proactively to emerging threats * Lead team members and provide oversight for less experienced engineers; Stay on top of the latest technologies and trends. * Support development of version control principles (e.g. Git and working within an agile environment) * Enhance knowledge of and compliance with preferred technologies, methodologies, standards and policies. * Assist in the development of white papers, conducting presentations as needed to explain why a technology is being recommended by IT. * Maintain technical knowledge and business acumen within own discipline or function. * Provide IT teams and business personnel with technology solutions by weighing advantages of technology trends, market availability of products, risks and benefits of technology to meet business/IT needs. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills; lead peer code reviews. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Accounting with 5\-years experience, in lieu of degree 9\-years experience * Experience with private and public cloud architectures, pros/cons, and migration considerations * 5\-years of RDBMS experience * Experience with JSON, JSON\-LD, XML data structures * Experience implementing data pipelines using latest technologies and techniques * Experience with Azure DevOps, Copado, GitHub, Heroku, ServiceNow or similar tools * 3\-years of hands\-on experience in programming languages such as Java 8, c\#, node.js, python, SQL, Unix shell/Perl scripting * 5\-years of industry experience data engineer, with involvement in the data component of the AI/ML lifecycle, and a solid understanding of applied machine learning topics * 3\-years of consulting or client service delivery experience on Azure * Experience handling Structured and unstructured datasets * Strong t\-SQL skills with experience in Azure SQL DW * Experience in data modeling and advanced SQL techniques * Cloud migration methodologies and processes with tools like Azure Data Factory, Event Hub, etc. * Analytical skills, attention to detail, critical thinking, problem solving and independent decision making * Knowledge of ETL tools * Experience with cloud\-native Azure technologies like Azure Functions, Event Grids, Service Bus Queues, Cosmos DB, Azure Data Factory, or related is a plus * Experience designing integration applications, both upstream and downstream applications * Experience with git, Azure DevOps, build pipelines, code branching/merging, code management * Experience writing technical reports and procedures * Knowledge of Event driven architecture Qualifications: **Preferred Qualifications*** Advanced hands\-on experience with **Databricks** and **Spark (PySpark preferred)** for building and optimizing workflows and pipelines. * Hands\-on proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining **ETL/ELT pipelines** using **Python, PySpark, and related tools**. * Strong **SQL** skills and experience with **data warehousing**. * Hands\-on experience with **cloud platforms** such as **AWS, Azure, or GCP**, including cloud\-native data tools. * Expertise in **big data systems** and integrating data from diverse sources such as APIs, flat files, and databases. * Experience configuring **secure external data connections** (e.g., Azure Data Lake Storage, On\-prem SQL Server) using: + Service Principals + SAS Tokens + OAuth + Mounting techniques * jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI Solutions
jobs.description: *Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.* **About The Opportunity** ------------------------- Contentful is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Applied AI product line with a primary focus on Marketplace. In this role, you will help build, maintain, and grow the systems, apps, and workflows that expand what customers can do with Contentful. You will work across the Marketplace surface area and adjacent Applied AI tooling, helping us deliver high\-impact apps, improve the contribution and review pipeline, and scale the ways internal and external developers build on top of Contentful. While Marketplace is the primary focus, this role should also be able to contribute across adjacent Applied AI areas like Extensibility and Developer Experience when priorities call for it. This role is ideal for an engineer strong in front\-end product work but not limited to it: someone comfortable moving between React surfaces, Node.js services, APIs, developer tooling, and production operations as needed. We are looking for a product\-minded full\-stack engineer who enjoys strong cross\-functional collaboration and taking growing ownership of software through its full lifecycle in production. We are also evolving how we build software. We increasingly use AI\-assisted development workflows to accelerate delivery, reduce menial workload, and improve leverage across the software development lifecycle. We are looking for an engineer who is genuinely excited to experiment with these tools — not just adopt them passively, but bring strong engineering instincts to getting the most out of them. **This is a hybrid role, with office attendance in Denver expected 2 days per week (Tuesday, Thursday).** **What To Expect?** ------------------- * Design, build, and maintain Marketplace features, apps, and supporting services that improve the experience for both app builders and app installers. * Contribute to the systems and tooling that help Contentful teams and partners bring new apps and integrations to market faster. * Contribute across adjacent Applied AI problem spaces, including extensibility workflows, developer tooling, internal platform capabilities, and backend services that support developers building on Contentful. * Improve contribution workflows, trust and safety checks, maintainability, and operational quality across Marketplace and Applied AI surfaces. * Partner closely with product, design, and engineers across Applied AI to shape solutions that solve meaningful customer and business problems. * Help generalize, polish, and productionize internally built apps and Applied AI contributions so they can be supported long\-term by Marketplace Engineering. * Own software in production, including debugging issues, improving observability, strengthening reliability, and participating in support and operational responsibilities. * Use AI\-assisted workflows across planning, implementation, debugging, and documentation where they create real leverage. * Help the team improve how we use AI in engineering by sharing practices, refining workflows, and contributing to a healthy engineering culture around quality and speed. **What You Need To Be Successful** ---------------------------------- * Roughly 4\-7 years of relevant software engineering experience * Solid professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production systems. * Strong experience with TypeScript and Node.js, plus solid experience building user\-facing product surfaces in React or similar front\-end frameworks. * Clear strength in front\-end engineering, paired with real comfort contributing to backend services, APIs, and developer\-facing tooling rather than working exclusively in the UI layer. * Experience designing and evolving APIs, integrations, and services used by other engineers, partners, or customers. * Good judgment around reliability, maintainability, security, and technical tradeoffs in a product environment. * Comfort working across the stack and across boundaries, from user experience to backend behavior to operational concerns. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience working cross\-functionally and asynchronously across teams and time zones. * A product mindset and real empathy for developers, partners, and customers. * Practical experience using AI tools to improve engineering productivity, with the ability to evaluate outputs critically and maintain a high quality bar. #### **Nice to Have** * Experience with developer platforms, SDKs, app frameworks, marketplaces, extensibility products, or integration ecosystems. * Experience with AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Cloudflare, or related cloud infrastructure. * Experience maintaining or contributing to public or shared developer tooling. * Familiarity with AI\-native product surfaces, agentic workflows, or systems that connect software to external tools and services. **What's In It For You?** ------------------------ onal annual education budget to improve your skills and grow in your career * Enjoy a full range of virtual and in\-person events, including workshops, guest speakers, and fun team activities, supporting learning and networking exchange beyond the usual work duties * An annual wellbeing stipend to care for your physical, financial, or emotional health * A monthly communication stipend and phone hardware upgrade reimbursement. * New hire office equipment stipend for hybrid or distributed employees. Get the gear you need to work at your best. *At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. The typical base salary range for this position is $117,200\-$161,200 annually.* *Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process. The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.* This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work without the need for visa sponsorship by the start date of employment. **Contentful is now officially part of Salesforce.** **Unleash Your Potential** -------------------------- When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what's possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. *If you need reasonable accommodations at any point during the application or interview process, please let your Recruiter know.* **Equal Opportunity Statement** ------------------------------- Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. *Please be aware of scammers who may fraudulently claim to be from Contentful. These types of fraud can occur through copycat websites, fake email addresses claiming to be from our company, or social media. We do not ask for your personal information, such as bank account numbers, identification numbers, etc., through social media or chat\-based apps, nor do we request or send money to purchase business equipment. If you suspect fraud, please report it to your local authorities and contact us at* *security\-esk@contentful.com**with any information you may have.* By clicking "Apply for this job," I acknowledge that I have read the "Contentful's Candidate Privacy Notice" and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **AI Engineer – .NET \& Generative AI \| Houston Hybrid** **Location:** Houston, TX **Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Direct Hire **Work Arrangement:** Hybrid – Minimum 2 Days Onsite / Client Sites as Needed **Please Read Before Applying** This is a **Houston\-based hybrid position and is not a fully remote opportunity.** Candidates must **currently reside in the Greater Houston area** and be available to work onsite a minimum of **2 days per week**, including at client locations as needed. **We are not considering relocation candidates for this opening.** This role is designed for a **hands\-on software engineer** who combines strong application\-development fundamentals with experience building or integrating modern AI solutions. This is not a data science, research, prompt\-engineering\-only, or purely ML\-modeling position. Candidates should have professional **C\#/.NET development experience** and be comfortable working directly with business stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into working technical solutions. **Employment sponsorship is not available now or in the future.** **About the Role** You'll be embedded on client teams as the technical builder responsible for turning scoped use cases into working systems. That means hands\-on, full\-stack implementation—including RAG pipelines, context management, agentic workflows, APIs, enterprise integrations, and applications that connect with clients' existing infrastructure. You'll work closely with client stakeholders to understand their business processes and translate those needs into technical solutions, but your primary output is the **build itself**. **What You'll Do** * **Build AI Solutions:** Architect and develop production\-ready AI solutions, including RAG systems, agentic workflows, and full\-stack applications. * **Integrate With Existing Systems:** Connect AI capabilities into established client infrastructure without requiring wholesale system replacement or data migration. * **Translate Business Problems:** Work directly with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and translate them into technical requirements and system designs. * **Develop Hands\-On:** Serve as the core technical builder on cross\-functional client delivery teams. * **Design Context \& Retrieval Systems:** Build and manage context pipelines, retrieval systems, vector search, and data flows that keep AI outputs accurate and grounded. * **Deliver Production Systems:** Build, test, integrate, and ship solutions against client engagement timelines. * **Communicate Technical Decisions:** Explain architecture, technical tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * **Enable Client Teams:** Document systems and provide knowledge transfer so client teams can maintain and extend what has been built. **Required Qualifications** Candidates should meet the following requirements: * Professional, hands\-on **C\#/.NET software development experience** * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building applications, APIs, integrations, or enterprise systems * Experience working **directly with clients or business stakeholders** to understand business problems and translate them into technical solutions * Ability to operate in ambiguous environments where requirements may not already be fully defined * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Ability and willingness to work onsite in Houston at least **2 days per week**, including at client locations as needed * Currently located in the **Greater Houston area** * Authorized to work in the United States **without current or future employer sponsorship** **Strongly Preferred** * Modern **.NET 8 or .NET 10** * Professional experience building or implementing **Generative AI / LLM applications** * RAG systems * Vector databases and embeddings * Retrieval pipelines and context management * Agentic AI frameworks * Tool/function calling and orchestration * Blazor * Full\-stack application development * Enterprise system integration * Technical consulting or client\-delivery experience **What We're Looking For** We're especially interested in engineers who can operate at the intersection of **software engineering, AI, and business problem\-solving**. You should be comfortable moving between conversations with business stakeholders and hands\-on technical implementation. You don't need to have worked with every AI framework or tool listed above, but you should have a strong software engineering foundation, the ability to learn quickly, and experience delivering real technical solutions. This position may be a strong fit if you've spent your career building enterprise software in C\#/.NET and have recently begun implementing Generative AI capabilities, or if you're already building production AI applications within enterprise environments. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Do you currently reside in the Greater Houston, Texas area? * Are you able to work onsite in Houston at least two days per week, including at client locations as needed? * How many years of professional experience do you have developing applications using C\#/.NET? * Do you have professional experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions? Work Location: Hybrid remote in Houston, TX 77007

jobs.title: Sr. Product Reliability Engineer - MV Transformers
jobs.description: If you like being the person who makes a good design even better once it’s out in the field — chasing a field failure until you know exactly why it happened, tightening a tolerance that’s been costing installers time, or turning a one\-off fix into a documented standard — this role is worth your full attention. CORE Transformers manufactures dry\-type, pad mount, and substation transformers from 15 kVA to 30 MVA, up to 230 kV. We supply critical electrical infrastructure to AI\-driven data centers, large\-scale construction, and industrial operations nationwide. We’re tracking 3x annual revenue growth, which means more units in the field, more installers depending on our designs working the first time, and a real need for someone who owns the gap between a good design on paper and a good design in the field. **Your Mission** You are joining as our first dedicated **Sr. Product Reliability Engineer \- MV Transformers**. Where our R\&D team builds tomorrow’s product line, you own what’s already shipped and what’s in production today: field performance, installation issues, quality escapes, and the steady stream of engineering changes that keep our standard designs current and our manufacturing partners aligned to spec. You’ll work closely with our quality team, our overseas manufacturing partners, and our sales organization to close the loop between what customers experience in the field and what actually gets built. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering, with this role positioned to grow — and to grow a team — as CORE scales. **A Day in the Life** Your morning starts with a field report: a pad mount unit installed on a data\-center campus tripped during commissioning. You pull the test records, talk through the symptoms with the customer’s electrical contractor, and narrow it down to a CT wiring convention that’s easy to get backwards in the field. You open a corrective action, and before lunch you’ve drafted a one\-page field bulletin and flagged the accessory drawing for an update. In the afternoon you join a call with our quality team and our overseas manufacturing partner to review last month’s incoming inspection data. Two recurring nonconformances trace back to a tolerance that’s tighter on paper than it needs to be in practice — you work through the fix and issue the engineering change. Sales calls with a question from a contractor about an installation detail on a unit shipped last quarter; you walk them through it directly. You close the day updating the standard design library: the CT wiring fix gets folded into the master drawing, the installation guide gets a clarifying diagram, and the change gets logged so R\&D can see the pattern if it shows up again. Every day looks a little different. What stays constant is that your work shows up in transformers already in the field. **Who You Are** You are hands on and detail oriented, and you get real satisfaction from closing the loop between a field issue and a permanent fix. You have working knowledge of both inside\-the\-tank transformer fundamentals and outside\-the\-tank systems — switchgear integration, protection devices, CT configurations — and you’re comfortable being the technical point of contact when a customer’s engineer or an installer has a question. You’re organized enough to run a disciplined change and documentation process, and you don’t mind being the person who has to say “this needs to change” to a design that already shipped. You’re looking to build a sustaining/quality engineering function almost from scratch, not to inherit one that’s already fully staffed. **What You’ll Be Doing** * Serve as the primary engineering owner for field issues, warranty claims, and quality escapes on units already in production — root cause investigation, corrective action, and closure. * Manage the engineering change process for existing standard designs: evaluate requests from quality, manufacturing, and the field, and issue updated drawings and specifications. * Partner with our quality team and overseas manufacturing partners to translate real field experience into tighter incoming inspection, in\-process, and outgoing test criteria. * Provide installation and field support for sales, contractors, and customers, including on\-site troubleshooting when needed. * Maintain and improve technical documentation for standard designs: drawings, spec sheets, installation guides, and accessory configurations. * Manage product and company certifications with oversight agencies to maintain customer confidence in delivered products. * Track field\-defect trends and report them back to Quality so recurring issues get designed out of future standard designs, not just patched in the field. * Support third\-party testing and validation follow\-up whenever a field issue calls a result into question. * Help build out CORE’s quality\-support function as the team grows — today this is one person; it will not stay that way. **What You’ll Need to Succeed** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience in medium\-voltage transformer or power systems engineering. * 5\+ years of engineering experience in power systems, medium\-voltage electrical equipment, or transformer manufacturing, with real exposure to what happens after a unit ships. * Working knowledge of liquid\-filled and/or dry\-type transformer design fundamentals: core and coil, winding configurations, insulation systems. * Comfort with outside\-the\-tank systems: switchgear integration points, protection devices, CT configurations, and accessory hardware. * Experience with root\-cause analysis and corrective\-action processes (8D, 5\-Why, or similar) in a manufacturing environment. * Ability to read and markup engineering drawings, and to write clear, field\-usable documentation. * Willingness to travel occasionally for on\-site installation or field support. * Willing and able to work on\-site in Seneca, SC. **Bonus Points If You Have...** * Experience coordinating quality or engineering specs with an overseas manufacturing partner. * Experience in data center, hyperscale, or large\-scale construction power systems. * Familiarity with UL, IEEE, IEC, or NEC standards relevant to transformers. * A quality\-engineering background (CQE or equivalent experience). * Experience at a fast\-growing or PE\-backed manufacturer where the org is still being built. *CORE Transformers is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

jobs.title: Garden Center Associate

Our headquarters are in Miami, Florida, where we were founded in 1961\. Costa Farms started on just 30 acres, and over the last 60 years, we’ve grown to more than 5,000 acres around the world. We have farms in North and South Carolina, Central and South Florida, and the Dominican Republic, plus an office in China. Costa Farms now employs nearly 6,000 people: engineers, marketers, accountants/analysts, human resources professionals, and of course, growers and plant scientists! and Go Spot Check missions correctly and promptly. * Track and report inventory levels using designated systems. * Arrive to set location(s) to meet with the team as needed and consistently complete assigned schedule. * Prepare stores for tours, meetings, and other events as required. * Build and maintain strong, respectful relationships with store personnel. * Ensure that consumers are treated well by projecting a cheerful, helpful, and friendly persona. * Perform additional duties as required. **QUALIFICATIONS** * High School Diploma or Equivalent * Previous retail, merchandising, or garden center experience preferred * Basic knowledge of plant care is a plus **Physical Demands** * **Heavy Work**: Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, **Work Environment:** * The Garden Center Merchandiser role is a physically active, hands\-on position based in the garden centers of retail locations, such as The Home Depot. Team members will work outdoors or in semi\-covered environments, exposed to varying weather conditions including heat, humidity, rain, and cold. * This role requires frequent standing, walking, bending, lifting, pushing racks, and reaching, and team members must be able to lift and move plant products or displays up to 50 lbs. safely. Merchandisers are expected to work independently and manage their time effectively while meeting merchandising and operational expectations. * A reliable mode of transportation is necessary, as team members may be assigned to multiple retail locations within a designated territory. **SKILLS** Ensures plants are merchandised to Costa Farms' standards, displays are clean and organized, and product presentation is consistent and appealing. Acts as a positive representative of Costa Farms while engaging with store staff and customers in a friendly, respectful manner. Comfortable working in changing conditions (weather, seasonal product changes, or shifting schedules) and adjusting priorities as needed. Works well both independently and collaboratively; supports peers and fosters a culture of shared success and accountability. Able to use a smartphone or tablet to submit reports, photos, and updates through company platforms (e.g., Teams, internal apps). **COMPETENCIES** * Collaborates * Communicates Effectively * Time Management * Accountability * Customer Focus * Dependability All applicants must be work\-authorized. Costa Farms will not sponsor any visa for this position. After applying, follow us on LinkedIn to stay up to date on what’s happening around Costa Farms and to start becoming part of our family. Come Grow with Us™! Costa Farms offers competitive wages and benefits, including: * 401(k) Plan * Company 401(k) Matching Contributions * Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, and Dependent Care * Telemedicine/ Mental Health Services * Health Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Pet Insurance * Supplemental Insurance (Aflac) * Growth Opportunities * Challenging and exciting work environment * Costa Farms Scholarship * Employee discounts on plants Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Application Review **Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review** As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process.AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate’s qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description: Description: **Technical Project Manager****DataPerk \| Birmingham, Alabama \| In\-Person****25 Years of Technology. 25 Years of Relationships. And We're Building What's Next.** DataPerk is celebrating 25 years in business, and we're looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager to help lead us into our next chapter. We were recently recognized among the Top 3 Best Places to Work by the Birmingham Business Journal, and we believe that recognition reflects something important about who we are: great technology starts with great people working together. We're a collaborative, client\-focused IT Managed Services Provider where people genuinely support one another, take pride in their work, and care about delivering an exceptional experience for our clients. Now, we're looking for someone who can help us take our project management organization to the next level. Our Technical Project Manager needs to understand the technology behind the projects and services that we are delivering. You should be comfortable discussing IT infrastructure, networking, cloud services, cybersecurity, Microsoft technologies, systems implementations, managed services, and the realities of deploying technology in a client environment. You will be working directly with our technical teams and sales team to provide what needs to happen, who needs to do it, how long it should take, what could go wrong, and what it will take to successfully deliver the project. You'll need to recognize when a technical dependency hasn't been addressed, challenge an unrealistic timeline, identify resource constraints before they become problems, and translate technical requirements into a clear plan that everyone from technicians to clients to leadership can understand. **If you don't have a strong IT foundation, this position will not be the right fit, regardless of your project management experience.** **What You'll Own** As our Technical Project Manager, you'll serve as the central point of coordination between clients, sales, technical teams, vendors, Project Coordinators, scheduling, and leadership. You'll be responsible for ensuring that projects are properly planned, resourced, communicated, executed, and completed. * Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, and success criteria. * Develop and maintain Statements of Work, project plans, schedules, and resource requirements. * Lead project planning sessions with engineers, technical resources, sales, clients, and other stakeholders. * Review and validate project estimates, labor requirements, sequencing, and dependencies. * Identify technical risks, resource constraints, missing requirements, and potential delivery issues before they become problems. * Coordinate and assign project activities across our technical and project management teams. * Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining visibility into priorities, deadlines, budgets, and resources. * Monitor project financial performance, labor consumption, profitability, and scope. * Manage change requests, scope changes, budget impacts, and schedule adjustments. * Lead project kickoffs, status meetings, stakeholder reviews, and project closeouts. * Communicate project status, risks, decisions, accomplishments, and recommendations to clients and internal leadership. * Serve as an escalation point for project\-related issues. * Coordinate clients, engineers, vendors, sales, scheduling, and internal departments to keep projects moving. * Maintain accurate project documentation, reporting, and project records. * Conduct project reviews and identify lessons learned and opportunities for improvement. **You'll Lead People, Not Just Projects** This position is also a leadership role within our Project Management organization. You'll help lead, develop, and mentor our Project Coordinators and play a key role in helping build the next generation of project management talent at DataPerk. * Assign projects and workloads based on skills, capacity, and priorities. * Provide coaching, mentoring, and day\-to\-day guidance to Project Coordinators. * Help develop Project Coordinators into stronger project managers. * Establish expectations for communication, organization, accountability, and client service. * Train team members on project management principles, systems, processes, and best practices. * Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation resource. * Develop standards, workflows, templates, and documentation. * Identify opportunities for employee growth and professional development. * Help create a culture of accountability, consistency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. **We Want You to Transform Project Management** This may be the most exciting part of the role. We're not looking for someone to simply step into an existing process and maintain the status quo. We want you to make it better. Our ideal candidate sees project management as an opportunity to create processes and procedures, metrics, workflows, templates, eliminate inefficiencies, improve communication, maximize our technical resources, and ultimately deliver a better experience for internal teams and our clients. **Join DataPerk and help us build the next 25 years!** Requirements: * Education: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems or Computer Information Systems. * 5\+ years of project management experience. * Experience managing client\-facing technology projects. * Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, cloud, cybersecurity, managed services, or related technologies. * Experience coordinating technical resources and project schedules. * Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring abilities. * Excellent communication and organizational skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities. * Strong understanding of project scope, budgets, timelines, risks, and resource management. * Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Must live in the Birmingham, Alabama area or be willing to relocate. * Must be available to work in our Birmingham office on a full\-time, in\-person basis. **Preferred:** * Previous MSP experience. * PMP, CAPM, Scrum Master, or similar certification. * Experience with Microsoft 365, infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, cloud migrations, or systems implementations. * Previous experience leading or supervising project management personnel. * Experience developing project management processes, standards, and methodologies.

jobs.title: ETL Developer / HPCC Data Engineer
jobs.description: ##### **Role Summary** DataSeers is looking for experienced ETL Developers / Data Engineers with HPCC Systems and ECL experience to build and maintain large\-scale financial data pipelines. A significant portion of DataSeers' data ingestion, normalization, transformation, linking, enrichment, and analytical processing is performed using HPCC Systems and Enterprise Control Language (ECL). This is not a traditional SQL\-only ETL position. You will work with large and complex financial datasets and develop ECL\-based data workflows that transform disparate source data into standardized, reliable datasets used across DataSeers products. You will work with data from banks, credit unions, fintechs, payment processors, core banking systems, and other financial platforms. ##### **What You Will Do** * Develop, maintain, and optimize ETL workflows using **HPCC Systems and ECL**. * Build ECL datasets, records, transforms, joins, rollups, deduplication processes, and data validation logic. * Ingest structured and semi\-structured financial data from multiple sources. * Develop data mappings from client source formats into DataSeers canonical data structures. * Normalize inconsistent customer, account, business, signer, beneficial\-owner, transaction, and counterparty data. * Build complex entity\-linking and relationship logic. * Develop large\-scale joins and matching processes across financial datasets. * Troubleshoot incorrect joins, duplicate records, missing relationships, data\-shifting issues, malformed files, and inconsistent identifiers. * Build reusable ECL components and data\-processing patterns. * Optimize HPCC jobs for performance and scalability. * Analyze Thor and Roxie workloads where applicable. * Develop validation and reconciliation routines to ensure data completeness and accuracy. * Work with MySQL, Elasticsearch, Kafka, APIs, and other components of the DataSeers ecosystem. * Support both batch and near\-real\-time processing requirements. * Work closely with customer implementation teams to understand source data and integration requirements. * Investigate data\-quality issues before they propagate into compliance, fraud, reconciliation, or reporting systems. * Participate in code review, testing, deployment validation, and production troubleshooting. ##### **Required Experience** * 3\+ years of ETL, data engineering, or large\-scale data\-processing experience. * Hands\-on experience with **HPCC Systems**. * Strong experience developing in **ECL**. * Strong understanding of ECL concepts including datasets, records, transforms, joins, normalize, denormalize, rollups, deduplication, and distributed processing. * Strong SQL skills. * Strong understanding of data structures, relationships, and data modeling. * Experience troubleshooting complex joins and data relationships. * Experience working with large datasets. * Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, referential integrity, and exception handling. * Experience with Git or equivalent source control. * Strong analytical and debugging skills. ##### **Preferred Experience** * Banking, fintech, payments, or financial services experience. * Experience working with ACH, wires, cards, RTP, FedNow, checks, or other payment data. * HPCC Thor and Roxie experience. * Experience optimizing large ECL jobs. * Elasticsearch experience. * MySQL experience. * Kafka or event\-driven processing experience. * Experience with AML, fraud, KYC/KYB, or transaction monitoring. * Python, JavaScript, Node.js, or Java experience is useful, but secondary to HPCC/ECL expertise. ##### **What Success Looks Like** Within the first several months, you should be able to receive a new client dataset, understand its relationships, build or modify the necessary HPCC/ECL ingestion and transformation logic, identify data\-quality issues, correctly link related entities, and produce validated datasets for downstream DataSeers applications.

jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Founding Forward Deployed Engineer** -------------------------------------- **New York City · On\-site · Full\-time** **Compensation:** $180K–$250K base \+ competitive equity ### **About the Company** Our client is a well\-funded, seed\-stage AI company building the revenue execution platform for B2B enterprises. Their product pairs LLMs with structured customer data to tell post\-sales teams which accounts to prioritize, why, and what to do next, automating work that account management and customer success teams have long done by hand. They are already live with Fortune 500 customers and have meaningful contracted revenue. Founded 2025 · Small founding team · Industry: AI, B2B, Enterprise ### **The Role** As the first Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own the technical deployment of the platform into enterprise customer environments. You will sit between messy customer data warehouses and production agent workflows, turning each customer's business knowledge into verified data models that drive measurable revenue outcomes. You will work directly with the founding team and report to the CTO. **What you'll be doing** * Leading new customer onboardings from start to finish: scoping data access, exploring undocumented warehouses, and mapping complex schemas to business concepts like churn, expansion, and ARR * Building and validating the semantic layer by working with customer stakeholders, reconciling conflicting definitions, and encoding them as verified SQL * Deploying workflows and agent pipelines into customer instances, then monitoring them to make sure they deliver results * Running 2–3 customer engagements at a time in shared channels with customer data and engineering teams (roughly a quarter of your time customer\-facing, the rest hands\-on data work) * Using the internal agent tooling daily and shaping how the team improves evals, validation, and the agent harness **Tech stack:** SQL, dbt, data warehousing, Python, LLMs, AI agents, signal engineering, eval frameworks ### **Requirements** * 2–5 years in a forward deployed, data science, or customer\-facing engineering role * A track record of personally leading technical customer deployments, including data access, schema mapping, stakeholder alignment, and demonstrating value * Experience building and shipping production data pipelines or systems on your own, from writing the code through debugging and deployment * Strong SQL and data warehouse skills, including working confidently in poorly documented or legacy schemas and producing output you have validated yourself * A daily AI\-first workflow: you use tools like Claude or Cursor and have built or tailored your own agent\-based workflows * Solid applied statistics sense, such as understanding distributions, seasonality, and validation design, and knowing when a result is noise * A background along one of these paths: forward deployed, customer, or solutions engineering at a leading data or AI company; analytics engineering or data science followed by customer\-facing delivery; or consulting, PE, or banking paired with a genuine CS and engineering foundation * The confidence to hold a technical position when customers push back, while staying open to changing your mind based on evidence * Comfort with detailed, repetitive data verification, which makes up most of the role * A bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, statistics, or another quantitative STEM field from a top\-tier university * Based in or willing to relocate to New York City and work in the office five days a week ### **Nice to Haves** * Experience at an early\-stage startup (seed through Series B); large tech company experience is most relevant when combined with startup or founder experience ### **Why Join** * Join as a founding engineer at a company that already has real enterprise traction and strong investor backing * Above\-market base salary plus meaningful equity, with flexibility for exceptional candidates * Own the most important technical path in the business, since every customer deployment runs through this role * Attack a large, underserved market in post\-sales execution with one of the first purpose\-built platforms * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, parental leave, a monthly wellness stipend, daily lunches, flexible vacation, and up to $10K in relocation support for out\-of\-state hires ### **Details** * **Location:** New York City, NY * **Work policy:** On\-site 5 days a week * **Compensation:** $180,000–$250,000 \+ equity * **Visa sponsorship:** Open to visa transfers (e.g. OPT, H\-1B transfers) * **Employment type:** Full\-time

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist/Installation Engineer
jobs.description: Job description: **Technical Support Specialist / X\-Ray Installation Engineer** **Del Medical \| Bloomingdale, IL \| Full\-Time** **Launch Your Career in Medical Imaging Technology** Del Medical is a leading manufacturer of advanced medical imaging systems dedicated to improving patient care through innovative X\-ray technology. We are seeking an ambitious **Technical Support Specialist / X\-Ray Installation Engineer** to join our growing Technical Service team. This role is designed as a **career development opportunity** for a technically driven individual who enjoys troubleshooting, working with technology, and building hands\-on engineering skills. The successful candidate will begin by developing expertise in Del Medical’s digital radiography and X\-ray systems through technical support, training, and equipment preparation. As skills and knowledge grow, this individual will transition into **installation, commissioning, and field service support** of medical imaging equipment throughout North America. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate, early\-career engineer, technician, or military\-trained technical professional looking to build a rewarding career in medical technology. **What You’ll Do** **Technical Support \& Training** * Learn and troubleshoot Del Medical X\-ray and digital imaging systems. * Provide technical support to customers, distributors, dealers, and Field Service Engineers. * Diagnose electrical, mechanical, software, and system\-related issues. * Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation. * Document troubleshooting activities and recommend corrective actions. * Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to improve products. **Installation \& Field Service Development** * Progress into installing, configuring, and commissioning X\-ray systems at healthcare facilities. * Perform mechanical assembly, electrical connections, system testing, and calibration. * Train customers on equipment operation and basic maintenance. * Travel throughout North America alongside experienced engineers. **Qualifications** **Preferred Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, Robotics, Physics, Biomechanical Engineering or related technical field. * Associate degree candidates or individuals with relevant technical experience will also be considered. **Preferred Experience:** * Electronics troubleshooting * Mechanical assembly * Electrical systems * Technical support * Manufacturing equipment * Field service * Robotics or automation **Technical Skills:** * Ability to read electrical schematics and wiring diagrams. * Familiarity with digital/analog electronics and electrical testing equipment. * Basic computer and networking knowledge. * Strong mechanical aptitude and problem\-solving skills. **The Ideal Candidate** We are looking for someone who is: * Curious and eager to learn. * Hands\-on and technically motivated. * A strong problem solver. * Customer\-focused and professional. * Comfortable working independently and as part of a team. * Interested in building a long\-term engineering career. **Career Growth Opportunities** This role provides a structured career path into: * Technical Support Specialist II * X\-Ray Installation Engineer * Field Service Engineer * Senior Field Service Engineer * Technical Trainer * Technical Service Manager **Why Join Del Medical?** At Del Medical, you will not just support equipment — you will help deliver technology that impacts patient care around the world. We offer: * Competitive salary * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) * LTD, STD, Life and AD\&D Insurance * Paid time off and holidays * Hands\-on technical training * Mentorship from experienced engineers * Career advancement opportunities * Collaborative team environment **Start your career with Del Medical and grow into a highly skilled medical technology professional.** Benefits: Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bloomingdale, IL 60108

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization. **Work you'll do** * Design and deploy Azure services, ensuring compliance with best practices for security, scalability, and availability. * Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates. * Configure Azure services such as Azure Virtual Machines, App Services, Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, Storage Accounts, etc. * Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to provide visibility into application, infrastructure performance, security, reliability and cost. * Manage identity and access using Microsoft Entra ID and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC). * Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and audits to identify and remediate vulnerabilities and misconfigurations. * Automate routine tasks and workflows using Azure Automation and develop Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments. * Provide technical support for cloud\-based applications and infrastructure. Troubleshoot and resolve performance, scalability, and availability issues. This includes Windows and Linux VM support. * Hands\-on experience in integrating cloud platforms with other cloud\-based systems, ensuring data consistency and availability. * Participate in assessments and audits of existing Azure deployments to ensure compliance with organizational standards. * Ensure operational activities are completed within the required SLAs. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements and support tailored Azure solutions. * Develop and maintain documentation, including technical guides and operational procedures. * Stay updated on emerging Azure services and technologies, integrating them where applicable. * Use DevOps practices, including Github for version control, to manage cloud. * Working knowledge of Azure AI services (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services, Microsoft Foundry) and how they integrate with core Azure infrastructure (VNets, Private Endpoints, Key Vault, etc.) **The team** Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience * 3\+ years of experience working with Microsoft Azure, including architecture, configuration, and management. * Familiarity with Azure services, including Azure Virtual Machines, Azure App Services, Azure Storage, Azure Policy, AKS, Azure Databases, Azure Network etc * Strong experience with PowerShell Scripting. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) such as ARM templates, Terraform, or Bicep. * Relevant active Azure certifications, such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ \- 104\), Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\), Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ \- 400\), are preferred. * Full stack development experience is an advantage. * Strong understanding of Agile methodologies. Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

jobs.title: Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation
jobs.description: Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. **Work You'll Do** As a Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation on the Customer Strategy and Design team, you will be responsible for... * Support product management activities for rapid prototyping client solutions, including backlog upkeep, prioritization support, and delivery coordination * Refine business and functional requirements and translate them into user stories with clear acceptance criteria * Coordinate defect triage, track issue resolution, and support release readiness activities across product increments * Partner with stakeholders, designers, and delivery team members to align product needs, testing activities, and implementation priorities * Support user acceptance testing by preparing materials, tracking outcomes, and documenting decisions and next steps A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The Team** Deloitte's Government \& Public Services (GPS) practice \- our people, ideas, technology and outcomes \- is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, \& local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise. Our Customer Strategy \& Design team discovers, designs, and prototypes customer growth strategies and innovation portfolios. **Qualifications** Required**:** * Bachelor's degree * 2\+ years of experience supporting product management, business analysis, or digital product delivery * 2\+ years of experience refining requirements, writing user stories, and managing product backlogs in an Agile environment * 1\+ years of experience supporting user acceptance testing, defect triage, and release readiness activities * 1\+ years of experience documenting functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and process workflows * Ability to travel 0\-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Experience supporting Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), human services, or eligibility system initiatives * Experience working with federal, state, local government, or public higher education clients * Experience using Jira for backlog, defect, or sprint management * Experience supporting rapid prototyping, minimum viable product, or service design efforts The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $82,600 to $162,800\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. Information for applicants with a need for accommodation: https://www2\.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/careers/articles/join\-deloitte\-assistance\-for\-disabled\-applicants.html

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description: Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization. **Work you'll do** We're hiring a hands\-on Solution Architect who will design and evolve both the high\-level and detailed architecture for new product features while supporting and improving existing capabilities. You'll lead with code and architecture pairing with engineers, producing reference implementations, and ensuring robust, scalable, cost\-efficient solutions in Azure using .NET/C\#, React/Node/TypeScript, and modern data\-processing patterns. Primary Responsibilities: * Define HLD/LLD for new features and complex refactors (context \& container diagrams, sequence diagrams, deployment views, data flows). * Author and steward Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), validate decisions via experiments and load tests. * Build reference implementations/PoCs in C\#/.NET and React/Node to de\-risk patterns, performance, and operability. * Review and merge PRs, provide actionable feedback, and pair with engineers on tricky problems. * Design event\-driven and streaming architectures leveraging Azure Service Bus, Functions, App Services, AKS, and API Management. * Engineer for high throughput and low latency: concurrency, async I/O, caching (Redis), partitioning, idempotency, back\-pressure, and circuit\-breaking. * Model data across Azure SQL and Cosmos DB, including indexing, partitioning, consistency, and query optimization. * Guide modern React (TypeScript) architecture: component design, state management, performance profiling, accessibility, SSR/BFF patterns with Node.js. * Ensure clean API contracts (REST/JSON, GraphQL where appropriate), schema governance, and sound error semantics. * Drive observability: distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), metrics and logs (App Insights), and actionable dashboards/alerts. * Bake in security: OIDC/OAuth2 (Entra ID), secrets management (Key Vault), OWASP ASVS, threat modeling. Define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and ensure production readiness* on\-call participation and RCA for major incidents. * Champion CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), IaC (Bicep/Terraform), repeatable environments, and golden paths/templates. * Optimize for cost and performance (FinOps): right\-sizing compute, data tiering, caching, and workload scheduling **While this position is posted in the US, we can only accept applications from those performing aDeloitte Global (DTTS) role at this time.** **The team** Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived. **Qualifications** **Required:** * At least 7 years experience building production software, 3\+ years as a hands\-on architect or principal engineer. * Deep proficiency in C\#/.NET (7/8\), ASP.NET Core, WebAPI, async/concurrency, performance profiling. * Strong React (18\+) \+ TypeScript and Node.js experience, testing with Jest/Cypress. * Azure expertise: App Services, Functions, AKS, API Management, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Storage, Key Vault, App Insights. * Proven delivery of data\-processing\-intensive systems (batch/stream, resiliency, throughput, cost). * CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions), IaC (Bicep/Terraform), containers (Docker, Kubernetes). * Solid understanding of architecture trade\-offs, DDD, integration patterns, and secure design. **Preferred:** * Experience with Databricks / Data Lake, Tableau or PowerBI. * Multi\-region active\-active design, disaster recovery (RPO/RTO), OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL. * Certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, DevOps Engineer Expert. Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
