jobs.title: Vice President, Sales Executive - Products/Zora AI - C_MAT
jobs.description: The Innovation \& Delivery Transformation (I\&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI native platforms and products The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I\&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future. A core focus of this role is Zora AI by Deloitte, Deloitte's Agentic Platform for the modern business. Zora AI by Deloitte enables enterprise organizations across all industries to make faster, more precise, and more customer\-obsessed decisions aided by AI. The platform combines enterprise grade concepts with leading edge AI capabilities in a subscription\-based AI platform to support repeatable, scalable decisions across Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, Information Technology and other enterprise activities. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/21/2026\. **Work you'll do** Deloitte Consulting is seeking a high\-performing VP Sales Executive to drive new client adoption and growth of product revenue for Zora AI by Deloitte as a product suite. This leader will be responsible for originating, shaping, and closing product\-led engagements across the portfolio. This role is also critical for feedback to shape and improve the products in the portfolio. The VP Sales Executive role requires a commercially driven executive with a strong background in enterprise data sales, competitive data environments, consultative solution selling, and executive\-level relationship development. **Sales Leadership** * Shape and sell annual recurring revenue deals across the Zora AI product suite. * Serve as a leader for feedback to shape product development, product marketing, and pricing the Zora AI portfolio. * Develop and execute account\-based sales strategies aligned to priority Zora AI by Deloitte accounts. * Expand sales opportunities for Zora AI products. * Lead end\-to\-end sales cycles: origination, qualification, shaping, pricing, negotiation, and close. **Market Expansion** * Identify whitespace opportunities within existing Deloitte accounts. * Open new logo opportunities. * Position Zora AI as a strategic transformation platform, not just a point solution. **Executive Engagement** * Build C\-suite and SVP\-level relationships. * Collaborate with Partners, Market Makers, Product Leads, and Pursuit Teams to align offerings with priority client opportunities and growth agendas. * Articulate ROI, value realization, and measurable business outcomes. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Zora AI by Deloitte leaders, industry account teams, and product teams. * Provide structured pipeline visibility and forecast accuracy. * Find, secure and direct talent internally or externally to produce compelling content like product demos, PowerPoint overviews, and other sales collateral. * Coach and support team members on effective client engagement and market maker interactions. * Increase Offering Portfolio, Industry, and field awareness of Zora AI by Deloitte product capabilities and differentiation through targeted enablement efforts. * Capture field insights, client feedback, and market learnings and feed them into ongoing product improvement cycles. **The successful candidate will possess:** * Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across both business and technical audiences, including senior executives, Partners, product leaders, and engineers. * Proven communication and storytelling skills, including experience presenting to executive audiences and structuring complex ideas into clear, actionable narratives. * Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with experience managing multiple workstreams simultaneously. * Demonstrated interest in developing deep expertise in Zora AI by Deloitte products or prior experience working with Zora AI or similar Enterprise grade platforms. * Demonstrated willingness and ability to contribute to both strategic planning and hands\-on execution. * Demonstrated track record of client leadership, selling, and deal shaping **The Team** The I\&DT team collaborates closely with Industries, Offering Portfolios, Growth, and Delivery Transformation to curate and scale the Zora AI by Deloitte portfolio, drive Strategic Growth Offerings, and translate differentiated product capabilities into compelling client outcomes. The team also plays a central role in incubating next\-generation technologies through Deloitte's Technology Offices and leading the firm's Tech Talent Transformation. Innovation \& Delivery Transformation is part of Deloitte Consulting Services and brings an engineering\-, product\-, and platform\-oriented mindset to everything it does. The team helps Deloitte organize for rapid innovation, expand how technology is built and commercialized, and support clients as they navigate disruption in an increasingly data\- and AI\-driven consumer economy. **Qualifications** Required: * 10\+ years of professional experience in data or product selling, solution development, product commercialization, or related roles within enterprise software, analytics platforms, data provider, or management consulting. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4\+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree. * Ability to travel 0\-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Demonstrated commercial experience with technology products or platforms, including product marketing, go\-to\-market strategy, sales enablement, pricing and packaging, or commercialization of analytics, data, or AI\-driven products. * Familiarity with enterprise systems and platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, and supply chain, merchandising, or marketing technology platforms The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $171,600\.00 to $338,300\.00\. You may also be eligible to participate in a sales incentive program, whereby you may be eligible to receive certain incentive compensation amounts based on achievement of certain sales goals set forth each year, subject to the terms and conditions of any applicable program document.

A core focus of this role is Zora AI by Deloitte, Deloitte's Agentic Platform for the modern business. Zora AI by Deloitte enables enterprise organizations across all industries to make faster, more precise, and more customer\-obsessed decisions aided by AI. The platform combines enterprise grade concepts with leading edge AI capabilities in a subscription\-based AI platform to support repeatable, scalable decisions across Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, Information Technology and other enterprise activities. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/21/2026\. **Work you'll do** Deloitte Consulting is seeking a high\-performing VP Sales Executive to drive new client adoption and growth of product revenue for Zora AI by Deloitte as a product suite. This leader will be responsible for originating, shaping, and closing product\-led engagements across the portfolio. This role is also critical for feedback to shape and improve the products in the portfolio. The VP Sales Executive role requires a commercially driven executive with a strong background in enterprise data sales, competitive data environments, consultative solution selling, and executive\-level relationship development. **Sales Leadership** * Shape and sell annual recurring revenue deals across the Zora AI product suite. * Serve as a leader for feedback to shape product development, product marketing, and pricing the Zora AI portfolio. * Develop and execute account\-based sales strategies aligned to priority Zora AI by Deloitte accounts. * Expand sales opportunities for Zora AI products. * Lead end\-to\-end sales cycles: origination, qualification, shaping, pricing, negotiation, and close. **Market Expansion** * Identify whitespace opportunities within existing Deloitte accounts. * Open new logo opportunities. * Position Zora AI as a strategic transformation platform, not just a point solution. **Executive Engagement** * Build C\-suite and SVP\-level relationships. * Collaborate with Partners, Market Makers, Product Leads, and Pursuit Teams to align offerings with priority client opportunities and growth agendas. * Articulate ROI, value realization, and measurable business outcomes. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Zora AI by Deloitte leaders, industry account teams, and product teams. * Provide structured pipeline visibility and forecast accuracy. * Find, secure and direct talent internally or externally to produce compelling content like product demos, PowerPoint overviews, and other sales collateral. * Coach and support team members on effective client engagement and market maker interactions. * Increase Offering Portfolio, Industry, and field awareness of Zora AI by Deloitte product capabilities and differentiation through targeted enablement efforts. * Capture field insights, client feedback, and market learnings and feed them into ongoing product improvement cycles. **The successful candidate will possess:** * Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across both business and technical audiences, including senior executives, Partners, product leaders, and engineers. * Proven communication and storytelling skills, including experience presenting to executive audiences and structuring complex ideas into clear, actionable narratives. * Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with experience managing multiple workstreams simultaneously. * Demonstrated interest in developing deep expertise in Zora AI by Deloitte products or prior experience working with Zora AI or similar Enterprise grade platforms. * Demonstrated willingness and ability to contribute to both strategic planning and hands\-on execution. * Demonstrated track record of client leadership, selling, and deal shaping **The Team** The I\&DT team collaborates closely with Industries, Offering Portfolios, Growth, and Delivery Transformation to curate and scale the Zora AI by Deloitte portfolio, drive Strategic Growth Offerings, and translate differentiated product capabilities into compelling client outcomes. The team also plays a central role in incubating next\-generation technologies through Deloitte's Technology Offices and leading the firm's Tech Talent Transformation. Innovation \& Delivery Transformation is part of Deloitte Consulting Services and brings an engineering\-, product\-, and platform\-oriented mindset to everything it does. The team helps Deloitte organize for rapid innovation, expand how technology is built and commercialized, and support clients as they navigate disruption in an increasingly data\- and AI\-driven consumer economy. **Qualifications** Required: * 10\+ years of professional experience in data or product selling, solution development, product commercialization, or related roles within enterprise software, analytics platforms, data provider, or management consulting. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4\+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree. * Ability to travel 0\-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Demonstrated commercial experience with technology products or platforms, including product marketing, go\-to\-market strategy, sales enablement, pricing and packaging, or commercialization of analytics, data, or AI\-driven products. * Familiarity with enterprise systems and platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, and supply chain, merchandising, or marketing technology platforms The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $171,600\.00 to $338,300\.00\. You may also be eligible to participate in a sales incentive program, whereby you may be eligible to receive certain incentive compensation amounts based on achievement of certain sales goals set forth each year, subject to the terms and conditions of any applicable program document.

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Turn Business Problems into Smart Data \& Technology Solutions Are you the person who naturally asks,*"Why are we doing it this way?"* and then finds a better solution? At **Merkle**, we're looking for a **Business Systems Analyst** who can bridge the gap between business strategy and technical delivery. In this role, you'll work directly with clients and cross\-functional teams to uncover business needs, define solutions, and help bring innovative data, marketing technology, and AI\-driven initiatives to life. This is not a role where you simply document requirements and move on. You'll be a trusted advisor, collaborator, and problem solver, helping clients navigate complex challenges while partnering with architects, engineers, and business leaders to drive meaningful outcomes. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Partner with Clients** * Lead discovery workshops and requirements sessions that uncover business needs and drive decisions. * Ask thoughtful questions, identify gaps, and help stakeholders clarify their goals. * Translate business challenges into actionable requirements, use cases, and solution recommendations. * Contribute to pre\-sales conversations and solution design discussions. ### **Connect Business and Technology** * Turn complex technical concepts into clear, business\-friendly language. * Create requirements documentation, process flows, user stories, and solution summaries. * Help clients understand how data, technology, and AI can support their goals. * Build alignment across stakeholders with different priorities and perspectives. ### **Drive Solution Delivery** * Own workstreams and collaborate closely with engineers, architects, and project teams. * Manage priorities, dependencies, and delivery milestones. * Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, testing, and user acceptance activities. * Identify risks early and help teams navigate challenges before they impact delivery. ### **Embrace AI and Innovation** * Use AI tools to improve requirements gathering, documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency. * Explore new technologies and recommend smarter ways of working. * Stay current on trends across customer data, marketing technology, analytics, and AI platforms. **What Makes You a Great Fit** ------------------------------ You might be a strong fit if you: * Have experience in business analysis, consulting, solutions delivery, product, or technology\-focused roles. * Enjoy working directly with clients and facilitating conversations that drive outcomes. * Can comfortably communicate with both technical teams and business stakeholders. * Have experience with platforms such as Adobe, Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar technologies. * Understand data flows, integrations, customer data, and marketing technology ecosystems. * Are organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities. * Regularly use AI tools to improve how you work and solve problems. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Clients leave meetings with clear decisions, next steps, and confidence in the path forward. * Delivery teams receive complete, actionable requirements that help them move quickly. * Business stakeholders understand the value and impact of technology solutions. * Projects stay organized, focused, and on track. * You continually introduce new ideas, efficiencies, and innovations that improve outcomes. **Why Merkle?** --------------- At Merkle, you'll work with leading brands to solve challenging business problems at the intersection of **data, marketing technology, customer experience, and AI**. You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple industries, collaborate with talented experts, and help shape the future of customer engagement and digital transformation. **If you're curious, consultative, technically minded, and passionate about helping businesses solve complex challenges, we'd love to meet you.** At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in\-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. jobs.title: Senior Data Science Manager, Developer Platform
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.Discord is where the world's gamers hang out, and increasingly, it's the platform game developers build on. We're seeking a Senior Data Science Manager to lead Data Science for our Developer Platform: the SDKs, identity systems, and developer tools that connect games and their players to Discord. What makes this role distinctive is the two\-sided value equation at the heart of the platform. For game developers, we build tools that help studios grow player engagement and revenue, including data products that give them deeper insight into their players and communities. For players, we use signals from those same tools to make it easier to play and hang out with friends, deepen engagement across Discord, and deliver more relevant ads. Your team's job is to make both sides of that exchange demonstrably valuable. That means proving the platform's worth to developers with rigorous evidence, and ensuring the signals it generates create outsized, responsible value for Discord users. If helping make Discord an even better place to hang out with your friends and communities sounds like an exciting challenge \- we'd love to chat with you! What you'll be doing Manage, mentor, and develop a mission\-driven team of Data Scientists embedded across the Developer Platform's core areas: identity, signals, and developer tools. Own the vision and roadmap for data\-driven decision\-making across the Developer Platform org, and shape company strategy on how the platform creates value for both developers and Discord. Strengthen the developer side of the value equation by shaping developer\-facing data products, including metric definitions, benchmarking methodologies, and insight quality. Strengthen the Discord side of the value equation by partnering with Ads, Engagement, and Growth to identify, validate, and productize platform\-derived signals, and by measuring their incremental value through experimentation. Drive platform adoption by partnering with Product, Engineering, and Business Development to measure integration health, forecast growth, and surface insights that help the org land and deepen integrations with the world's largest game developers. Serve as a trusted analytical partner to top game developers, designing joint studies with partner data science teams to uncover business value from the developer tech stack. Partner with Data Engineering, Product, and Legal on data governance: ensure platform signals are documented, discoverable, and governed well across Discord. Set clear priorities and nimble operating models, and build a team known for rigorous methods and decision\-ready work. Partner with other Data leaders to shape the direction and culture of Discord's Data organization.. What you should have 8\+ years of experience in applied data science and advanced analytics, ideally including both consumer product and B2B or platform contexts. 3\+ years managing and developing teams of Data Scientists, with a track record of growing ICs and raising the team's technical bar. Strong expertise in experimentation and causal inference, including quasi\-experimental methods (propensity matching, synthetic controls, diff\-in\-diff) for settings where randomized experiments aren't feasible. Experience designing novel, interpretable metrics for a new or fast\-evolving product area, and building the measurement systems around them. Proficiency in SQL and at least one data programming language (Python or R). Clear communication and influence. You can translate complex technical work into crisp narratives for executives, engineers, and external partners, and use data to shape strategy and roadmaps alongside Product and Engineering leadership. Bonus points Experience with gaming, game platforms, or developer\-facing (B2B2C) products, especially working directly with external partners' data or analytics teams. Experience building or shaping customer\-facing data products such as analytics dashboards, benchmarking tools, or measurement offerings. Familiarity with advertising signal ecosystems (event pipelines, identity resolution, targeting and measurement, lookalike modeling) and with ML applications for signal enrichment, forecasting, or personalization. Experience with cloud data platforms like BigQuery, very large datasets, and modern BI tools (e.g., Hex, Mode, Looker, Tableau). Understanding of data governance, privacy, and responsible data use, particularly for signals shared across product and revenue systems. Interest in Discord, gaming, and the communities we serve. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $342,000 to $380,000 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.Why Discord?Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know. Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clickingHERE.

jobs.title: Senior 5G MAC Software Engineer
jobs.description: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E\-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper\-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly\-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space\-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. ### **What you will do:** * Own the software architecture, redesign, implementation, and integration of MAC\-side software for a new 5G NR physical layer, including PHY integration, emulation, and test capabilities. * Define a portable, layered architecture that separates MAC behavior, the MAC\-PHY interface, platform transport, and operating\-system services. Support host\-based simulation, execution on a simulated ARM processor, and deployment on FPGA and ASIC platforms. * Define and evolve the MAC\-PHY interface, including message sequencing, timing, buffer ownership, compatibility, versioning, and error handling. Coordinate changes with PHY and protocol\-stack engineers. * Implement and debug real\-time control and data flows for terrestrial 5G NR, including PDCCH, PDSCH, PUSCH, PUCCH, PRACH, SRS, HARQ, CQI, timing advance, and measurements. * Design low\-power communication between ARM software and PHY firmware using shared memory, mailboxes, interrupts, and efficient data movement. Address concurrency, cache coherency, memory ordering, backpressure, timeouts, and recovery. * Extend the SystemC TLM virtual platform, with guidance from system designers, and carry the software through FPGA and ASIC integration. Debug system\-level failures on simulated and physical SoCs. * Build automated regressions, test\-vector flows, traces, and KPI checks that correlate behavior across simulation and hardware. * Review architecture and code, coordinate dependencies across software, firmware, systems, verification, and hardware teams, and gradually expand into production MAC development. ### **What you bring to this role:** * Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering embedded C/C\+\+ software for a wireless modem, baseband, or comparable real\-time, resource\-constrained system. * Practical knowledge of 5G NR MAC and relevant 3GPP specifications, including terrestrial operation, scheduling, HARQ, random access, and MAC\-PHY interactions. * Hands\-on experience debugging heterogeneous SoCs and hardware\-software interfaces involving shared memory, mailboxes, interrupts, DMA or similar data movement, cache coherency, and multicore synchronization. * Experience developing embedded Linux software and working with an RTOS. * Working knowledge of digital communications and DSP sufficient to understand PHY processing constraints, timing, and data flow. * Ability to decompose complex systems into clear components and interfaces, make sound architectural tradeoffs, diagnose integration failures, and collaborate effectively across software and hardware teams. * A track record of independent technical ownership, supported by reproducible tests, version control, and clear design documentation. * Typical background: BS with 7\+ years, MS with 5\+ years, or PhD with 3\+ years of relevant experience in wireless communications, embedded software, computer engineering, or a related field. Equivalent demonstrated expertise is also welcome; these are guidelines rather than mandatory minimums. ### **Bonus points for the following:** * Experience modifying SystemC TLM virtual platforms or integrating production software with virtual hardware models. * Experience taking embedded modem software through FPGA prototyping, pre\-silicon verification, ASIC bring\-up, and hardware correlation. * Experience designing or extending a MAC\-PHY interface such as FAPI, nFAPI, or a proprietary equivalent. * Experience with Zephyr, FreeRTOS, vector DSPs, or heterogeneous ARM and DSP SoCs. * Experience optimizing modem or baseband software for low power. * Experience with 5G NR non\-terrestrial networks, including propagation delay, timing advance, Doppler\-related coordination, or NTN scheduling and HARQ. * Experience contributing to production protocol\-stack software, including MAC, RLC, RRC, or a MAC\-PHY adaptation layer. ### **Additional Requirements** This is a fast\-paced, high\-impact environment \- flexibility to occasionally work extended hours or weekends during critical periods is expected. $140,000 \- $200,000 a year This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Santa Clara office. The target base pay for this position is $140,000 \- $200,000 annually. The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used—so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in\-orbit activities. If that’s your experience – then we’ll be immediately wow\-ed. E\-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role. **Why E\-Space is right for you:** As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success. Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals. In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high\-growth industry. We want you to make the most of your journey at E\-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well\-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E\-Space:* An opportunity to really make a difference * Sustainability at our core * Fair and honest workplace * Innovative thinking is encouraged * Competitive salaries * Continuous learning and development * Health and wellness care options * Financial solutions for the future * Optional legal services (US only) * Paid holidays * Paid time off We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

reports, including test results, relay settings verification, and system performance. * Ensure completion of all project deliverables, including as\-built drawings, relay settings validation, and commissioning documentation. * Ensure all documentation meets customer and industry standards. **Team Development \& Customer Interface** * Train and qualify Relay Technician I, II, and junior This hands\-on role is ideal for experienced field service professionals as well as skilled technicians from the semiconductor, HVAC, automotive, industrial maintenance, military, or other electromechanical industries who have strong mechanical and electrical aptitude and are looking to transition into the high\-tech semiconductor industry. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** * Service equipment and/or products at customer sites or service center to include all contracted preventative maintenance, unscheduled maintenance, consumable changes, installations, and start\-ups. Strong time management skills. jobs.title: Data Analyst II-Business Analyst Focus
jobs.description: Description: Education Analytics (EA) is a nonprofit organization that partners with states, school districts, and education organizations to improve student outcomes through data, analytics, and technology. We believe better data systems and collaborative technology can help education leaders make more informed decisions that positively impact students. EA is seeking a Data Analyst II (Business Analyst Focus) to join our team. In this role, you’ll connect partner and user needs to data, analytics, and technical solutions. You’ll work to understand the questions education leaders are trying to answer, translate those needs into clear data definitions and analytic requirements, and help ensure that reports, dashboards, and data products provide meaningful and useful information. You’ll work closely with education partners, analysts, engineers, and other technical teams throughout the analytic process. Depending on project needs, you may conduct partner discovery, define and document analytic requirements, map source data to reporting concepts, investigate data quality, develop technical specifications, mock up reports or dashboards, and help guide projects from initial problem definition through delivery. This is a newer role type at EA that builds on our existing technical analytics work with greater emphasis on user needs, data definitions, analytic requirements, and the connection between data systems and how information is ultimately used. People in this role will have opportunities to help shape how this work develops at EA. EA will consider candidates with a range of experience and qualifications for placement at the Data Analyst I, Data Analyst II, or Senior Data Analyst level. The level and responsibilities will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and demonstrated capabilities. This position is based on\-site at EA’s downtown Madison, WI office. Remote work may be considered for candidates with substantial relevant experience. Candidates may come from a variety of professional backgrounds. We encourage applicants with experience as Business Analysts, Data Analysts, BI Analysts, BI Developers, Data Scientists, education data specialists, or in similar roles that combine technical data work with understanding and translating user needs to apply. Requirements: * Experience turning broad or ambiguous requests into clear questions, data definitions, analytic requirements, and technical specifications, and communicating those needs across technical and non\-technical audiences. * Experience investigating complex data sources, assessing data quality, and determining how data should be mapped, combined, transformed, and interpreted for reporting and analytics. * Working proficiency with SQL, including the ability to write, interpret, and debug complex queries in a cloud data warehouse environment, such as Snowflake. * Familiarity with education data standards such as Ed\-Fi, or demonstrated ability to learn and apply complex data standards, definitions, and reporting rules. * Experience working with business intelligence, reporting, or data visualization tools and engaging in the mockup phase, with Apache Superset and Figma experience preferred. * Experience using a statistical programming language to investigate, process, or validate data, with R or Python preferred. * Experience using Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development. * Comfort working in an evolving technical environment and adopting new tools, including AI\-assisted technologies, to improve the efficiency and quality of analytical work. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced environment with limited direction. **Qualifications** * Minimum bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, Information Systems, Public Policy, Education, or a related field. * At least one year of relevant professional experience, including progressively independent work with data, analytics, technical requirements, or data products. * Familiarity with K–12 education data, state or district reporting, or education data standards is helpful but not required. **Compensation and Benefits** The base salary range for the Data Analyst II position is $72,000–$84,000, depending on experience and qualifications. EA may also consider candidates for placement at the Data Analyst I or Senior Data Analyst level; compensation would be adjusted accordingly based on the level at which the candidate is hired. EA's benefits include: * A 12% non\-elective contribution each payroll from EA to your 401k retirement plan, once eligible per plan rules. * Up to a 3% salary deferral match each payroll by EA to your 401k, once eligible and contributing, per plan rules. * 26\.5 days of paid vacation annually (accrued at the rate of 17\.67 hours per month). * 40 hours of paid sick time provided on date of hire plus 8 hours of paid sick time that accrued monthly. * 9 paid holidays, including EA\-designated holidays or the option to swap holidays of your choosing. * 85% of health insurance premium paid for by EA, 50% of dental premiums paid for by EA. * Paid parental leave, after one year of employment and if all other eligibility requirements are met * Employer\-Paid Short\-Term Disability. Employer\-Paid Long\-Term Disability. * Employer\-Paid Group Life Insurance: Coverage equal to 2x your annual salary, up to $200,000\. * Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential support and resources available to you and your eligible family members.

Whether you're launching your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside industry\-leading experts, collaborate across disciplines and borders, and contribute to projects that transform the way people live, move, and connect. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for incentive compensation, where applicable, and a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes health benefits, retirement savings, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and other employee programs. ***Equal Employer*** Egis is proudly committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse and inclusive workforce. Egis provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. You follow through on commitments and make sure others do the same. jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Architect
jobs.description: About Evergreen Goodwill Evergreen Goodwill of Northwest Washington is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization founded in 1923 that helps people get jobs across Northwest Washington by offering high\-quality free job training, education and job placement. Goodwill empowers individuals to overcome barriers to working, by providing comprehensive support and connecting them with life changing job opportunities, ensuring they are career\-ready and can support themselves and their families. The organization employs over 2,000 people, operates five job\-training centers, 23 nonprofit retail stores and more than 27 donation sites in King, Snohomish, Skagit, Whatcom and Kitsap Counties. Every day, Evergreen Goodwill connects people with the jobs, services and skills they need — because Jobs Change Lives. We are committed to creating and sustaining a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion (DEI) and are focused on creating a joyful, inclusive and successful organization. Enterprise Solutions Architect **Reports to:** VP of Technology **Supervises:** None **Job Site:** Evergreen Goodwill Administration Office, Hybrid 3 days required in office **Band:** $145,000 – $155,000 Position Summary Translates technology strategy into enterprise architecture and technical standards. Accountable for the coherence and long\-term consequences of architectural decisions within the direction established with the VP of Technology. Sets technical planning, architecture review, and release coordination practices across engineering. Advises leadership on sequencing, dependencies, capacity constraints, and technical risk. Evergreen Goodwill is seeking an Enterprise Solutions Architect. This is an internal\-facing, hands\-on architecture role — not a pre\-sales or customer\-facing position. Technology direction is set with the VP of Technology. Your work is to turn that direction into an architecture the organization can actually build against: the target state, the integration patterns, the standards, and the sequence to get there. **We are in the middle of a substantial platform transformation:** automating sort and warehouse operations, migrating identity and productivity platforms, integrating finance systems, and building software in\-house where commercial products do not fit how we operate. These initiatives share dependencies. A decision made in identity constrains what is possible in the warehouse; a decision made in finance integration constrains reporting. You are accountable for making those decisions compose — and for their consequences three years out, not only at deployment. You will write the architecture and the standards down so they outlast any individual, including you. You will be senior enough to say no with a reason, and close enough to the work to be credible when you do. **You will also set how engineering plans and ships:** technical planning practice, architecture review, the DevOps pipeline, and release coordination — the air traffic control function for what reaches production and when, across teams running concurrent, interdependent initiatives. Where that work surfaces sequencing conflicts, capacity constraints, or technical risk, you bring it to leadership early enough to act on. Key Responsibilities Architecture and technical direction * Rationalize and articulate the target\-state architecture across infrastructure, applications, integration, and data — and the sequenced path from current state to it * Develop and document platform selection and exit recommendations against explicit criteria — total cost, integration burden, exit cost, security posture, and organizational fit — and own the resulting architecture once the direction is set * Define integration patterns and interface contracts between systems so teams are not negotiating them case by case * Maintain architectural decision records stating what was decided, what alternatives were considered, and why — with enough reasoning that a future engineer can tell whether the decision still applies * Build security, privacy, and compliance requirements into the architecture — PCI scope, data handling, retention, and the access model — rather than bolting them on after a system is built Engineering standards and practice * Set and own development, deployment, and lifecycle standards across all three engineering families: source control, environments, release process, configuration management, testing, and operational handoff * Define what "production\-ready" means for internally built software, and hold work to it * Build the reusable patterns, templates, and reference implementations that let teams move quickly inside the standards rather than around them Quality, DevOps, and change management * Own the quality bar for engineering work across the organization: what gets reviewed, what "done" means, and what is allowed to reach production * Own the build and deployment pipeline — source control practice, branching strategy, automated testing, environment  lassification patterns, and a clear view of where these approaches fail * Experience running change review or a comparable forum where sequencing and risk get arbitrated between teams with competing deadlines * Hands\-on software development experience current enough to be credible with practicing engineers — able to read and write production code, not only review architecture * Experience making build\-versus\-buy decisions and living with the consequences of both * Clear technical writing, plus the ability to explain a technical tradeoff to a non\-technical executive audience without flattening it * Experience in an environment where the architecture is partly inherited and cannot be replaced wholesale Other / Preferred Qualifications * Retail, logistics, warehouse operations, or another environment with physical operations and frontline staff * Organizations running internal software development alongside commercial platforms * Nonprofit, public sector, or mission\-driven experience, or comparable experience under real budget constraint * Identity and access architecture, point\-of\-sale or payment systems, ERP integration, or data platform architecture — depth in one with working knowledge across the others is more useful here than breadth alone * Contribution to security and compliance standards, including PCI * Experience with change control in an environment with seasonal freeze periods or revenue\-sensitive release windows * Familiarity with delivery and quality metrics — change failure rate, lead time, rollback frequency — used to drive practice rather than to report upward What we are deliberately not asking for * People management experience. No direct reports; not a step toward management. This is the top of the individual contributor track * Specific vendor certifications. Platforms in our current environment are examples, not requirements — we are replacing several of them * Pre\-sales or customer\-facing solution architecture. Different discipline; this role is entirely internal Minimum Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field. Demonstrated architectural work carries more weight than credentials. Minimum Years of Relevant Experience 12\+ years, including 5\+ in an architecture\-accountable role. Everyone Is Welcome When you join Evergreen Goodwill, you join a truly vibrant community. We value the things that make us different and unique. From diverse international and ethnic backgrounds, to languages, identities, ages, orientations, and beyond, Evergreen Goodwill celebrates individual and cultural diversity. Why work at Evergreen Goodwill? jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Ezee Fiber, our success is built on delivering **Speed, Simplicity, and Service** in everything we do. Guided by our core values of **Integrity, Compassion, Accountability, and Collaboration**, we empower our employees to do the right thing, support one another, take ownership of their work, and work together to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers and the communities we serve. The Senior Data Engineer designs, builds, optimizes, and supports scalable data infrastructure and business logic that enable network performance analysis, customer insights, operational reporting, and enterprise analytics. Building on Ezee Fiber's Data Engineer scope, this senior\-level role owns complex data engineering solutions, establishes technical standards, improves data reliability and performance, and provides technical guidance across data initiatives. The role partners with technical and business stakeholders to ensure data is accessible, secure, accurate, well\-governed, and actionable in a fast\-paced, fiber\-focused environment.* Design, develop, and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines integrating data from CRM, OSS/BSS, GIS, network monitoring tools, REST APIs, and other enterprise platforms. * Write efficient, reusable, production\-quality Python and SQL code to process, transform, validate, and serve large and complex datasets. * Lead the design and implementation of automated data\-quality controls, anomaly detection, monitoring, alerting, and remediation processes. * Design and optimize data models, data lakes, data warehouses, and related architecture to support business intelligence, analytics, and operational use cases. * Own and enhance data infrastructure across cloud and on\-premise environments, including platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, MS SQL, and PostgreSQL. * Evaluate pipeline and platform performance, identify scalability or reliability risks, and implement technical improvements that increase resiliency and efficiency. * Establish and promote engineering standards for data pipelines, schemas, documentation, testing, deployment, observability, and version control. * Partner with Engineering, Field Operations, Customer Experience, Finance, Marketing, and other stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable data solutions. * Provide technical leadership on data initiatives, including solution design, architecture decisions, code reviews, troubleshooting, and guidance to less\-experienced engineers or technical partners. * Define and maintain trusted datasets and data products that support dashboards, performance metrics, forecasting, and executive decision\-making. * Ensure data solutions comply with Ezee Fiber standards for security, privacy, compliance, access controls, and data governance. * Support data lineage, metadata, documentation, and data\-integrity practices across systems and applications. * Lead or support integration of real\-time or near\-real\-time data using technologies such as Kafka, Spark, APIs, or comparable tools. * Identify opportunities to automate manual data processes, reduce technical debt, and improve the quality, speed, and reliability of data delivery. * Independently diagnose and resolve complex production data issues and communicate risks, impacts, and recommended solutions to technical and business stakeholders

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer, Level 3
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** We build insurance software for complex, highly regulated healthcare environments, where a defect doesn't just fail a test, it can mean a denied claim, a coverage gap, or a compliance failure for the organizations that rely on us. We partner closely with clients to evolve these systems in their real operating environments, not in isolation. **THE OPPORTUNITY** Join a high\-impact engineering team where you'll play a key role in designing, automating, and optimizing the cloud infrastructure and delivery platforms that power our products and services. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll help shape secure, scalable, and reliable solutions across AWS and Azure while driving automation, platform modernization, CI/CD excellence, operational readiness, and cloud best practices. This role combines technical leadership with hands\-on engineering. You'll partner closely with software developers, security, and technology teams to improve system performance, strengthen reliability, streamline deployments, and enhance the overall developer experience. Success requires balancing scalability, security, maintainability, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness while delivering practical solutions aligned with business priorities. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, continuously improving systems and processes, and leveraging modern cloud, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to deliver measurable business value, this role offers an opportunity to make a significant impact across the organization. **OUR DEVOPS ECOSYSTEM** You'll work in a modern cloud\-native environment supporting innovative healthcare technology solutions. Our platform spans AWS and Azure cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and Docker container orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, and automated CI/CD pipelines. Partnering closely with software engineering teams, you'll help build and evolve scalable microservices\-based platforms while driving automation, reliability, security, observability, and operational excellence. Technologies include: AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Ansible, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Python, Java, React, Prometheus, Datadog, ELK, Jira, and Confluence. **WHAT MAKES SOMEONE GREAT HERE** * **Ownership over task completion.** You take responsibility for outcomes, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and operational impacts while driving initiatives through implementation and production support. * **Systems thinking.** You understand how applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, security, deployment pipelines, and business objectives connect, and you make decisions accordingly. * **Automation with purpose.** You use Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, and automation to improve reliability, scalability, consistency, and efficiency while avoiding unnecessary complexity. * **Judgment in ambiguity.** You navigate complex problems, competing priorities, and evolving requirements with practical decision\-making and a focus on business outcomes. * **Reliability mindset.** You measure success not only by delivery speed, but by stability, observability, security, recoverability, and long\-term maintainability. * **Team\-first leadership.** You share knowledge, mentor others, and help elevate engineering practices through collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. **EDUCATION** High School Diploma or equivalent is required. A degree in computer science, software engineering or related field is preferred. **PROFESSIONAL BACKGROUND** Minimum 7 years of professional experience, including: * DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related experience supporting software delivery, infrastructure, and operational environments. * AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms, including deployment, administration, monitoring, security, reliability, and operational support activities. * CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, release management, and software delivery tooling such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or comparable platforms. * Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, and environment automation using Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies. * Containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or comparable platforms. * Monitoring, logging, observability, incident response, operational support, system reliability, and platform performance management. * Scripting, automation, and tooling using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Groovy, or comparable technologies. * Collaboration with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security, Quality Assurance, and other stakeholders to support delivery, reliability, and operational objectives. * Large, complex software implementation, integration, enhancement, modernization, or platform initiatives within distributed, cloud\-hosted, and highly collaborative environments. * Security, compliance, governance, and operational igration Reform and Control Act (IRCA), and does not discriminate based on citizenship or national origin. **EMPLOYMENT ELIGIBILITY \& PRE\-EMPLOYMENT SCREENING NOTICE** Our Company participates in E\-Verify as part of certain client contractual requirements. In accordance with federal law, all new hires must complete Form I\-9 and provide documentation acceptable to the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to verify their identity and authorization to work in the United States within three (3\) business days of their start date. For more information on employment eligibility verification and acceptable documentation, visit the DHS website at: https://www.uscis.gov/i\-9\-central/form\-i\-9\-acceptable\-documents As a condition of employment, all candidates and employees are subject to a background check and drug screening. These screenings are required by Company policy and by client contractual obligations and are conducted in compliance with the federal Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) and all applicable federal, state, and local laws. The scope of drug testing may vary by state, depending on applicable state and local laws. **WORK LOCATION** **This position is designated as hybrid and requires regular in\-office work in one of the following offices: Boca Raton, FL or Denver, CO or Midtown New York City. This is not a remote role**. On\-site attendance and the ability to meet minimum in\-office requirements, as well as additional in\-office time based on business needs, are essential functions of the role. In\-office requirements are determined by the Company and may vary based on team, project, or operational needs Relocation assistance is not provided for this position **HIRING PAY RANGE \- ANNUALIZED** Boca Raton, FL: 116,000 – 145,000 Denver, CO: 132,000 – 165,000 Midtown NYC: 140,000 – 175,000 The stated hiring pay range is our good faith belief at the time of this posting. Final compensation placement will vary based on multiple factors such as position level placement, experience, knowledge, geographic location, competencies, and skill level as well as internal equity. **DISCRETIONARY BONUS COMPENSATION** The Company may, in its sole discretion, determine whether to provide discretionary bonus payments. Any discretionary bonus opportunity, eligibility for consideration, bonus determination, and bonus amount are determined solely by the Company and are not guaranteed. The Company reserves the right to modify, discontinue, or decline to offer discretionary bonuses at any time, with or without notice. **BENEFITS** In accordance with this position, hired individuals may be eligible to participate in Company benefit plans and programs, including paid time off benefits (vacation, holiday, and sick time); group medical, dental, and vision insurance programs; life insurance benefits; the Company’s 401 (k) retirement plan, in accordance with and subject to the eligibility and other provisions of such plans and programs. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. The Company provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs, as required by law. **JOB POSTING DISCLAIMER** The information provided in this posting is intended to describe the general nature and level of work expected for this role. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Job duties and requirements may change based on business needs, consistent with applicable law. Employment with the Company is at will, meaning either the employee or the Company may end the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice or cause, as permitted by law.
