jobs.title: Controls Engineer 1
jobs.description: **WHAT CAN WE OFFER YOU FOR ALL YOUR HARD WORK?*** Competitive Salary * PTO Program * Nine (9\) Paid Holidays!! * Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance * Short and Long\-Term Disability Coverage **AT NO COST TO EMPLOYEE!!** * Tuition Assistance * Pet Insurance * Flexible Spending Plans * Health Spending Plans * Comprehensive Online Learning Center \- houses thousands of training resources available to learn at your own pace!! * 401(k) Retirement Savings \- **with a generous company 30% match!** (100% vested after six years) **GET TO KNOW US:** FM Industries can promise you an environment that not only encourages your best, but also rewards it with plenty of room to grow. FM industries is a premier manufacturing solutions provider. We specialize in build to print, precision machined components, anodizing and engineered thermal spray coatings. We provide customers leading edge support from protype to production. **SUMMARY OF POSITION****:** This technical professional reports to the Engineering Manager. Responsibilities: apply standard engineering techniques to design, develop and maintain instrumentation or controls systems. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES:** * Multi\-disciplinary position responsible for design, operation, installation. * Electrical understanding of valves, limit switches and general hardware. * Automates manufacturing processes through use of instrumentation or controls systems * Develops new or modifies existing systems, interfaces or embedded controls * Participates in setup and commissioning or new equipment or upgrading of current equipment * Troubleshoots and resolves malfunctions and makes recommendation of improvements * Can build and layout electrical components. * Provide continuous improvement to controls systems throughout plant * Support engineering and maintenance for advanced troubleshooting * Operate, upgrade and maintain data acquisition system hardware * Create Schematics for new instrumentation * Write procedures to address both routine tasks as well as off nominal troubleshooting steps **EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:** * Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline or 2\+ years of professional experience with instrumentation and controls systems with manufacturing in semi\-conductor industry * Experience in the following fields, robotics, automotive, communication systems or process type industrial systems * Experience with one or more of the following electrical test equipment: oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies * Experience with Equipment sustainability and troubleshooting * Experience with programmable logic controllers (PLC) * Experience with Electrical Panel builds, troubleshooting, installations * Ability to interpret a variety prints and technical drawings. * Experience designing test and automated systems * Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS WHILE PERFORMING THE JOB:** * Standing or sitting for extended periods of time, sitting or standing, walking, pushing, pulling, stooping, kneeling, or bending to the floor; use hands to finger, handle or feel parts and materials; reach with hands and arms and overhead; and talk and/or hear instructions and equipment sounds. * Occasionally sitting or standing. * Lifting and/or moving items up to 40 pounds. * Close vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. * Ability to differentiate shades and color to identify coating defects. * Near acuity or accommodation required for reading instrumentation and documentation, dial and digital gauges, blueprints, and precision measuring instruments used in the inspection of coating operations. * Ability to handle delicate parts. **WORKING ENVIRONMENT OF THE JOB:** * Regularly exposed to moving equipment, mechanical parts, ovens, and risk of burns. * Occasionally exposed to toxic or caustic chemicals and risk of electrical shock. * High noise levels from operating machines. * The employee will be required to use personal protective equipment (PPE) to prevent exposure to hazardous materials commonly used in a manufacturing environment (i.e., safety glasses and shoes, gloves, ear plugs/covers, mask, cleanroom suit). * Approximately 80/20 office and shop floor environment. * Low noise levels in office environment. * High noise levels while working near operating machines. * Physical hazards while working near moving equipment and mechanical parts. * Possible breathing of fumes, odors, dust, and mist. **CULTURE:** At FM Industries our success is powered by people and technology. Our culture is what makes FM a fun and rewarding place to work. We champion diversity and we are always seeking new ways to amaze our customers. Success is celebrated and integrity is the core of who we are at FM Industries. **FM Industries Values:** * **CUSTOMER FOCUS** \- Partnering to deliver excellence and innovation * **SAFETY \-** Prioritizing the wellbeing of our people * **INTEGRITY** \- Achieving our best through mutual respect and teamwork * **QUALITY** \- Investing in our People, Processes, and Products * **ACCOUNTABILITY** \- Taking ownership of our words, actions and results ***Give us your best and we’ll give you ours!***

jobs.title: 2027 IT Summer Intern - Software Developer (Raleigh, NC)
jobs.description: Overview: This role is onsite at FCB's Data Center, located at 100 East Tryon Road Raleigh, NC 27603\. There will be some work from home opportunities, but in\-office days are required weekly. The Information Technology organization at First Citizen’s Bank has established a summer internship program to invest in our future workforce. The program is designed to provide an opportunity for you to apply classroom knowledge in a corporate IT environment while delivering tangible value to the organization. In addition, each Intern will be given the following opportunities: * Assigned to a manager who can help guide you through the program on a daily basis. * Assignment of a mentor to help facilitate a broader view of the Information Technology function. * Additionally, a peer advisor team is there to assist the Intern in being successful with navigating organization, political, and cultural landscapes. * Participation in unique technology or banking related training events. * Involvement in networking and team\-building events. * A project designed to improve a defined process within the Bank’s Information Technology function will be assigned to each Intern to plan and execute during the internship. * A wrap\-up presentation will be prepared by the Interns to be shared with the Chief Information Officer and other key leaders in the company to outline their accomplishments and experience during the internship. Responsibilities \& Qualifications: In this role, you will:* Be part of a dynamic team with interesting projects. * Accountabilities can and may include areas such as research, analytics, projects, strategy, process review and improvement, as well as technology enhancements and support. * Attend professional development sessions, informational sessions, networking and community service events. * Have a dedicated manager and program manager to help you navigate the bank and the internship program. * Be assigned a project, designed to improve a specific process or solve a problem that you will present at the close of the internship. * Prepare a wrap\-up presentation to be shared with the division leader and other key stakeholders in the company to outline your accomplishments and experience during the internship **Internship Dates:** 5/24/27 \- 7/30/27 Position Specific Skills:* Critical thinking skills * Ability to multitask * Ability to adapt and adjust priorities based on business needs * Ability to take direction and absorb information quickly * Strong verbal and written communication skills Qualifications * Minimum Required Education and Experience: High School Diploma or GED and 1 years' experience * Currently enrolled at an accredited collegiate institution (during time of summer program: 5/24/27 \- 7/30/27\) Preferred qualifications:* Pursuing a Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Systems Engineer, or related area of study * 3\.0 minimum GPA * Strong desire to learn and grow * Possess a positive attitude, naturally curious and enjoys collaborating with others Additional Information: Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits.

jobs.title: Engineer- Development III USA
jobs.description: *First Solar reserves the right to offer you a role most applicable to your experience and skillset.* **Basic Job Functions:** * Perform computer\-aided analyses of materials, tools, and processes to enhance thin film solar cell performance and stability and to reduce manufacturing cost. * Responsible for projects or functions that are complex, require significant innovation, and are critical to department objectives. * Plan, execute and characterize development engineering experiments in the laboratory and manufacturing environment with strategic foresight. Drive actions with strategic foresight. * Apply statistical and engineering methods to optimize organizational effectiveness. Improve methods for use by others. **Education/Experience:** * Associate’s Degree in an engineering discipline or similar technical discipline and 20 years of relevant technical experience or 2 years of experience as a Development Engineer II at First Solar. * Bachelor’s Degree in an engineering discipline or similar technical discipline and 10 years of relevant technical experience or 2 years of experience as a Development Engineer II at First Solar. * Master’s Degree in an engineering discipline or similar technical discipline and 8 years of relevant technical experience or 2 years of experience as a Development Engineer II at First Solar. * Ph.D. in an engineering discipline or similar technical discipline and 5 years of relevant technical experience or 2 years of experience as a Development Engineer II at First Solar. **Required Skills/Competencies:** * Technical expert and innovator in one area computer\-aided analysis (thermal, multi\-species gas flow, and chemical reaction preferred); experience on photovoltaic processes and/or equipment development is a plus. * In\-depth knowledge of process engineering, with special emphasis on transport phenomena, as well as chemical reaction engineering. Expertise in materials engineering and photovoltaic device theory is a plus. * Working knowledge of CFD, CAD, meshing, and post\-processing software. Programming experience is required, especially for implementation of numerical analyses of industrial applications. Experience with AI\-assisted coding is highly desirable. * Working knowledge of statistical software and its applications (JMP preferred) is highly desirable. * Firsthand expertise in laboratory or manufacturing environments. * Keen sense of project ownership, with a hands\-on, can\-do attitude. * Effective communication skills across organizations. **Essential Responsibilities:** * Identify and grasp opportunities for improvement in solar cell efficiency, material selection, and process/equipment design through engineering, scientific, or empirical methods. The core focus is on thermal equipment and processes where heat transfer by radiation, convection, and conduction are all playing a role, as well as gas flow and chemical reactions in the gas and solid phases. * Improve state\-of\-the\-art techniques and applications for computer\-aided analysis, statistical analysis of data, or execution planning of experiments. Develop work plans even when there are unclear solution paths. * Will be responsible to determine and evaluate thermal tool/equipment specifications. May be responsible to determine and evaluate material specification for improved performance. * Effective communicator with internal and external partners and customers. Effective team members that can support cross\-functional projects and take ownership of sub\-deliverables. * May train, mentor and manage junior and peers on specific subject matters. * Comply with Company's Environmental, Quality, Safety or any other policies that have been enforced. Contributes to continuous improvement of said policies. * Other duties as assigned. * Job description subject to change at any time. **Reporting Relationships:** * Reports to Development Manager. * May have direct reports. **Travel:** * 5% \- 10% **Estimated Salary Range:** * $84,200 \- $120,000 annually **US Physical Requirements:** **Hybrid Physical Requirements:** * Will sit, stand or walk short distances for up to the entire duration of a shift. * Will climb stairs on an occasional basis. * Will lift, push or pull up to 37 pounds on an occasional basis. * Required to use hands to grasp, lift, handle, carry or feel objects on a frequent basis. * 20/40 vision in both eyes together, with or without correction, is required. * Must be able to comply with all safety standards and procedures. * May reach above shoulder heights and below the waist on a frequent basis. * May stoop, kneel, or bend, on an occasional basis. * Ability to wear personal protective equipment is required (including but not limited to; steel\-toed shoes, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, protective jacket or apron and arm guards, and a condition of employment and continued employment (requires little or no facial hair) for those requiring respirator use. Potential candidates will meet the education and experience requirements provided on the above job description and excel in completing the listed responsibilities for this role. All candidates receiving an offer of employment must successfully complete a background check and any other tests that may be required. Equal Opportunity Employer Statement: First Solar is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that diversity and inclusion is a driving force in the success of our company.

jobs.title: Senior Pega Engineer/Developer
jobs.description: **Description** The Senior Pega Engineer/Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining Pega\-based applications and solutions. The role involves working closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software that meets business needs. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Pega development, deployment automation, test automation, and general SDLC and DevOps practices. Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. * Design, develop, and test features and functionality for new and existing applications or solutions as part of an Agile Scrum team. * Build and configure applications and business processes using the Pega Platform, ensuring alignment with business requirements and performance standards. * Communicate effectively with business stakeholders to gather requirements, provide updates, and ensure that development work aligns with business goals. * Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, QA, DevOps, and operations teams, to deliver high\-quality solutions. * Ensure Pega solutions are configured according to best practices, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and performance. * Conduct peer reviews of configurations and contribute to the development of best practices and standards. * Become a subject matter expert on one or more areas of functionality within the Pega environment, providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members. * Stay current with Pega technology updates, industry trends, and best practices, and advocate for their adoption. * Accurately document configurations, rules, and any changes made within the Pega environment, ensuring that documentation is kept up\-to\-date and accessible. * Provide regular development updates and status reports to teams and stakeholders, highlighting risks, issues, and progress. * Perform unit and integration testing of Pega configurations as part of the SDLC process, ensuring that they meet functional and performance requirements before deployment. * Collaborate with QA teams to define test strategies, automate testing where possible, and ensure comprehensive test coverage. * Participate in the deployment of Pega applications to production environments, ensuring that deployments are smooth and without issues. * Support and maintain Pega applications, applying patches, fixes, and enhancements as required. * Implement and maintain security best practices within the Pega environment, ensuring compliance with relevant standards and regulations. * Conduct regular security reviews and vulnerability assessments to identify and mitigate potential risks. * Continuously seek opportunities to improve development processes, tools, and practices within the team. * Actively participate in retrospectives and other team activities to drive process improvements. **Education and Experience Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, software engineering, or mathematics. * 6\+ progressive years of experience in building and implementing model\-driven, enterprise\-level business solutions and applications in Pega * Must possess a Pega Certified Senior System Administration (CSSA) certification * Big plus if prior/current .NET development experience * Experience in automating deployment processes within Pega environments using tools like Jenkins, Pega Deployment Manager, or other CI/CD pipelines. * Familiarity with Pega’s DevOps capabilities and best practices, including the use of branch\-based development, product rulesets, and automated packaging and deployment. * Proficiency in creating automated test cases within Pega, using tools like PegaUnit, Selenium, or similar frameworks. * Ability to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous quality. * Understanding of DevOps principles, including infrastructure as code (IaC), continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and continuous monitoring. * Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their services as they relate to Pega environments. * Experience in identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks within Pega applications. * Understanding of proactive monitoring and alerting strategies to ensure high availability and reliability of Pega applications. * Experience with integrating Pega with external systems using REST, SOAP, JMS, or other integration technologies. * Familiarity with data transformation and mapping using Pega’s integration rules and connectors. * Knowledge of API management and governance within a Pega environment. * Experience in version control and branching strategies for managing Pega application changes. **Location:** Marlborough/Chelmsford, MA or Hillsboro, OR **Target Compensation:** $116,500 \- $140,000 \+ annual bonus **Schedule:** Monday – Friday \| 8am\-5pm (Hybrid) **Who We Are:** **What makes First Tech different? Click** **here** **to learn more!** Every great journey begins with a bold idea—and ours is no different. First Tech and DCU were founded on the belief that financial solutions should put people first. That belief has fueled decades of innovation and service, rooted in the tech sector and expanding to support members from all walks of life. **Employees are eligible for:** * Traditional medical, dental, and vision coverage * Generous 401(k) match * Paid Time Off: You'll accrue up to 15 days in your first year. In addition, you'll receive 40 hours of sick time and 3 personal days, which refresh annually * Paid federal holidays * Special employee pricing on lending products such as mortgage, auto, and personal loans (eligibility subject to standard account requirements and underwriting criteria) **Employment Statements:** First Tech is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity, inclusion, and equity at our company. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. *If you're applying for a job and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an email to recruiters@firsttechfed.com and let us know the nature of your request and contact information. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.* ***First Tech is not currently offering Visa transfer/sponsorship for this position.***

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Location: Lancaster, PA – Onsite, 5 Days/Week** **Reports to: Maintenance \& Engineering Manager** **Employment Type: Full\-Time** **Position Overview** Trillium Foods is seeking a hands\-on Electrical Engineer to support capital projects, automation, controls, and electrical systems within our food and beverage manufacturing operations. This role will be actively involved in the design, development, installation, and improvement of electrical and automation systems supporting food processing, production, packaging, and facility operations. The Electrical Engineer will work directly with equipment and systems on the manufacturing floor, providing technical expertise from initial project concept and equipment specification through programming, installation, commissioning, startup, and ongoing optimization. The ideal candidate will bring hands\-on electrical engineering, automation, and controls experience within the food and beverage manufacturing industry, along with experience supporting capital projects from concept through commissioning and startup. This is not a role focused solely on coordinating or delegating engineering work. We are looking for someone who enjoys being directly involved in the technical work, solving problems, developing practical solutions, and taking ownership of projects and assignments. The Electrical Engineer will work closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, EHS, OEMs, contractors, and external engineering partners while maintaining direct technical involvement throughout projects. **Key Responsibilities** **Capital Projects \& Project Ownership*** Take ownership of assigned capital projects supporting food processing, production, packaging, utilities, and facility operations. * Develop project scopes, budgets, schedules, equipment specifications, technical requirements, and implementation plans. * Provide hands\-on electrical and controls engineering throughout project design, installation, commissioning, and startup. * Evaluate new equipment and technologies and ensure electrical and controls requirements are appropriately incorporated into equipment specifications. * Work directly with OEMs, vendors, contractors, integrators, and external engineering partners while maintaining internal ownership of technical requirements and project execution. * Review and challenge technical recommendations, drawings, specifications, and proposed solutions to ensure they meet operational, engineering, food safety, and reliability requirements. * Support equipment installation, testing, commissioning, validation, and production startup directly on the manufacturing floor. * Track project costs, schedules, risks, and performance while minimizing disruption to production. * Identify opportunities to improve safety, food quality, equipment reliability, efficiency, capacity, and overall manufacturing performance. **Automation \& Controls*** Design, program, troubleshoot, modify, and optimize PLC and HMI systems supporting food and beverage manufacturing equipment and processes. * Develop and implement automation solutions using PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, VFDs, industrial networks, instrumentation, and process controls. * Support automation associated with processing, batching, mixing, filling, material handling, packaging, conveying, and other production systems. * Troubleshoot controls and automation issues directly on production equipment and develop sustainable corrective solutions. * Support integration between production equipment, controls, instrumentation, and related systems. * Lead or support commissioning and startup of new and modified automated equipment. * Develop and maintain control narratives, functional specifications, I/O documentation, electrical drawings, and other technical documentation. **Electrical Engineering*** Design, specify, troubleshoot, and support industrial electrical systems, including low\- and medium\-voltage distribution. * Develop and review one\-line diagrams, load calculations, panel schedules, electrical drawings, and equipment specifications. * Support motor control centers (MCCs), switchgear, transformers, generators, backup power systems, motors, drives, and other electrical infrastructure supporting plant operations. * Support arc flash studies, short\-circuit analysis, electrical coordination studies, energy efficiency initiatives, and electrical reliability improvements. * Ensure electrical systems and work comply with NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA, and applicable electrical and safety requirements. **Food \& Beverage Manufacturing Support*** Maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor and provide hands\-on technical support to Operations and Maintenance. * Troubleshoot complex electrical, automation, controls, and equipment issues affecting production. * Partner with Operations and Maintenance on root cause analysis, corrective actions, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement. * Develop engineering solutions that cons egulatory compliance. * Participate in Process Hazard Analysis (PHA), Lockout/Tagout improvements, machine safety initiatives, and other applicable safety programs. * Support compliance with GMPs and applicable FDA, USDA, SQF, BRC, and other food manufacturing requirements. **Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. * 3\+ years of electrical engineering, controls, automation, or related engineering experience within a food or beverage manufacturing environment. * Hands\-on experience with electrical systems, automation, controls, and production equipment within a food or beverage manufacturing facility. * Experience supporting capital projects from technical design and equipment specification through installation, commissioning, and startup. * Hands\-on PLC programming and troubleshooting experience. * Experience working directly on the manufacturing floor with Operations and Maintenance to troubleshoot equipment and process issues. * Understanding of engineering considerations related to food safety, sanitary design, GMPs, sanitation, and product quality. * Strong understanding of industrial electrical distribution systems and automation/process controls. * Knowledge of industrial communication networks such as Ethernet/IP, Modbus, DeviceNet, and Profinet. * Experience with AutoCAD Electrical or similar design software. * Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA, and electrical safety practices. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to think creatively and develop practical technical solutions. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with plant employees, leadership, technical professionals, vendors, contractors, and external engineering partners. * Ability to independently take ownership of assignments and projects while collaborating effectively and knowing when to seek additional expertise. * Desire to continue developing technical knowledge and project leadership capabilities. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience supporting food processing, batching, mixing, filling, packaging, conveying, or related processing equipment. * Experience with sanitary processing equipment and sanitary design principles. * Experience with Rockwell Automation/Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, or Schneider Electric control platforms. * Experience with Wonderware, Ignition, FactoryTalk, or similar SCADA systems. * Knowledge of ISA standards and machine safety standards. * Familiarity with FDA, USDA, SQF, BRC, or similar food safety and regulatory requirements. * Experience independently leading capital or automation projects. **What We're Looking For** We are looking for a hands\-on engineer who wants to be directly involved in the work. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between the manufacturing floor and project work—troubleshooting equipment, programming and optimizing controls, developing technical specifications, working with vendors and contractors, and taking projects through installation and startup. This individual should bring strong technical fundamentals and food and beverage manufacturing experience while also demonstrating curiosity, humility, strong communication skills, and the ability to think outside the box and develop solutions. We are looking for someone who wants to continue learning, take increasing ownership, and grow their technical and project leadership capabilities over time. **Work Environment** This position is based onsite at our Lancaster, PA food manufacturing facility five days per week. The Electrical Engineer will spend time in active food processing, production, packaging, utility, and equipment areas and must be comfortable working directly around manufacturing equipment. ***Trillium Foods provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind, in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.***

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack & Cloud Engineer (Contract - 6 months)
jobs.description: **City:** Chicago **Department:** IT \& Engineering **Recruiter:** Nichole Gorham We are seeking a hands\-on ***Senior Full\-Stack \& Cloud Engineer*** to take technical ownership of an internally developed web application and transition it into a secure, reliable, and maintainable production solution. The application was rapidly developed using Claude Code and VS Code and will initially support approximately 100 internal employees. The successful candidate will assess and strengthen the existing codebase, establish appropriate engineering and security standards, implement a sustainable hosting and deployment model, and provide ongoing technical support and enhancements. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who is comfortable working with AI\-assisted development while bringing the engineering judgment required to ensure production applications are secure, maintainable, and reliable. ### **About the Role** * Take technical ownership of the existing application, including reviewing and understanding the AI\-generated codebase. * Identify technical debt, security vulnerabilities, and architectural risks, and refactor where appropriate without unnecessarily rebuilding working parts. * Develop and maintain front\-end, back\-end, API, and database functionality, and build new features as business needs evolve. * Establish coding, documentation, testing, and code\-review standards. * Design and maintain simple, secure, cost\-effective hosting with separate development/test and production environments. * Implement automated CI/CD pipelines with a documented deployment and rollback process. * Manage configuration, secrets, certificates, and domains, and establish backup and recovery processes. * Implement monitoring, logging, error tracking, and alerting, and track reliability, performance, and cost. * Implement SSO\-based authentication, role\-based access control, least\-privilege permissions, and audit logging. * Conduct a production\-readiness assessment, execute a prioritized remediation plan, and partner with IT/security to meet organizational requirements. ### **About You** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience owning production applications. * Strong full\-stack development capabilities using modern web technologies. * Experience inheriting, evaluating, and improving existing codebases. * Experience deploying and supporting applications in a major cloud or managed hosting environment. * Strong understanding of Git\-based software\-development workflows. * Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments. * Working knowledge of relational databases, database security, migrations, and backups. * Experience implementing authentication, authorization, SSO, OAuth and/or OpenID Connect. * Strong understanding of application\-security fundamentals, secrets management, and least\-privilege access. * Experience implementing production logging, monitoring, alerting, and error tracking. * Ability to independently troubleshoot production issues across the application and infrastructure stack. **Preferred Experience** * Experience supporting internal enterprise applications. * Experience integrating applications with Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, Okta, Google Workspace, or similar enterprise identity platforms. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or Pulumi. *Hourly Pay Range: $50\.00 \-$60\.00 USD* We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! **Why Join Flix?** At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path. As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work. If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you! \#LI\-REMOTE

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer II
jobs.description: **Purpose:** The Senior AI Engineer will design, build, and operate the framework and platform capabilities that enable agentic solutions across Floor \& Decor — and will build flagship agentic products on that platform to prove it out. The role covers the full delivery lifecycle: planning, designing, configuring, testing, implementing, documenting, and maintaining AI solutions deployed on Microsoft Azure and integrated with the company’s operational systems. The mandate is durable capability, not a single product. Individual agentic solutions will come and go — some will graduate to other teams, some will be retired — but the substrate they are built on is what this team owns: the tool and integration layer, context and memory management, evaluation and observability, guardrails, and the paved road that lets the next agentic workflow ship in weeks rather than quarters. This is a hands\-on senior individual contributor role. This is not a research or data science position. We are looking for an engineer with first\-principles command of backend systems who has moved into AI engineering — someone who treats LLMs and agents as components in a well\-architected distributed system, and holds them to the same standards of reliability, observability, security, and cost control as any other production dependency. Technical leadership here is exercised through architecture, code quality, and influence rather than through direct reports. **Minimum Eligibility Requirements:** * **Engineering Foundation** * **7–10 years** of professional software engineering experience, with increasing scope and ownership. * **Deep proficiency in backend engineering** in at least one of C\#/.NET, Java, Node.js/TypeScript, or Python. We care about first\-principles understanding of backend systems, not a specific language — the ability to pick up a new stack quickly matters more than which one you arrived with. Python is a plus, not a requirement. * **Service\-based and microservice architectures**, RESTful API design, and asynchronous service communication — including API versioning, contract design, error semantics, and backward compatibility. * **Cloud\-based serverless microservices in production** (Azure Functions, Container Apps, or equivalent). * **Event\-driven architecture**: queues, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, and dead\-letter handling. * **Solid data fundamentals**: relational and NoSQL data modeling, query performance, and transactional correctness. * **Demonstrated ownership of code quality** — automated testing, code review, and CI/CD as normal practice, not overhead. * **AI Engineering** * **Designed and deployed agentic solutions** — shipped and operated in production, not prototypes or POCs. We are interested in depth of agent delivery experience; retrieval\-augmented generation is one tool in that kit, not the definition of the job. * **Harness engineering** — practical command of the scaffolding that surrounds a model and determines whether an agent actually works in production: context construction and management, tool and function\-call interfaces, multi\-step planning and control flow, memory and state, structured output, guardrails and validation, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and graceful failure and fallback behavior. * **Azure OpenAI services** — LLM APIs, Azure AI Search (vector/index), and associated Azure infrastructure. Azure AI Foundry or AWS Bedrock experience also applies. * **Agent and LLM orchestration frameworks** (LangChain, LangGraph, or similar). * **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** or other tool\-calling/function\-calling patterns for LLM\-to\-system integrations. * **AI\-specific failure and risk modes** — hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, non\-determinism, runaway tool loops — and concrete techniques for mitigating them. * **Sound judgment** on when an LLM or agent is and is not the right tool, and how to bound and validate its output. * **AI\-Augmented Development** * **Daily working fluency with agentic coding tools** (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Devin, or equivalent). Claude Code is our standard. * **A credible, specific point of view** on where these tools accelerate delivery, where they do not, and how to review and test model\-generated code responsibly. * **Able to speak to measurable impact** on their own or their team’s throughput and quality. * **Cloud, Security, and Delivery** * **Cloud environments** (Azure preferred) including compute, storage, networking, and IAM fundamentals. * **Cloud security fundamentals**: identity and access management, secrets management, and network boundaries. * **Agile/scrum methodologies** — sprint ceremonies, story estimation, backlog grooming. * **Angular or comparable modern front\-end frameworks** — working knowledge. * **Clear written and verbal communication** with both technical and non\-technical partners; comfortable with ambiguity and able to move from a vague business problem to a scoped, specified, shippable increm d space for focused engineering work. * The role involves regular in\-person collaboration with product managers, business stakeholders, and your engineering team. * Occasional visits to retail store locations may be required to gather associate feedback and observe how the product is used in context. * Some extended hours may be needed around major releases or on\-call rotations for production incidents. * Standard physical requirements of a professional office environment apply — prolonged sitting, use of a computer workstation, and participation in in\-person and video meetings. **Why Join Our AI Center of Excellence** * Build the foundation, not just the feature. You will design the framework that every agentic workflow at Floor \& Decor is built on — the decisions you make will shape how this company builds with AI for years. * Ship production agentic products used by thousands of associates across a national retail footprint, and see the impact of your work in real stores. * Greenfield scope in a mature company: the platform is being defined now, with real budget, real users, and real operational systems to integrate with. * Work in an AI\-augmented engineering environment where agentic development tooling is the standard, not an experiment. * Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a culture that values curiosity and continuous improvement. * Opportunities to grow into broader AI architecture and engineering leadership as the Center of Excellence scales. **Working Conditions (travel \& environment)** * Travel may be required including air and car travel * The noise level in the work environment is typically quiet to moderate. **PHYSICAL/SENSORY REQUIREMENTS** Sedentary Work – Ability to exert 10 \- 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or negligible amount of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. **Note:** *Floor \& Decor considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital or familial status, veteran status, or based on any other class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Floor \& Decor also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.* *This job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and the employee and is subject to change by the employer at its sole discretion.* **Benefits \& Rewards** Bonus opportunities \& career advancement opportunities at every level Programs that help you reach your financial goals: 401k with company match, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and Referral Bonus Program Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and other Insurance Plans (subject to eligibility criteria) Work\-life balance, including: * Paid vacation and sick time for eligible associates * Paid holidays plus a personal holiday * Paid Volunteer Time Off that starts on Day 1 **Equal Employment Opportunity** Floor \& Decor provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants without regard to age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other category protected by law. This policy applies to all areas of employment, including recruitment, testing, screening, hiring, selection for training, upgrading, transfer, demotion, layoff, discipline, termination, compensation, benefits and all other privileges, terms and conditions of employment. This policy and the law prohibit employment discrimination against any associate or applicant on the basis of any legally protected status outlined above.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer, Energy Management
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Development **Compensation** ---------------- * $200K – $250K • Offers Equity *To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US\-based job postings. Our compensation package includes base salary, equity for all full time roles, benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans.* *This range reflects a good\-faith estimate based on the applicable pay scale, the range previously established for this role, the compensation of individuals currently in equivalent positions, and/or the budgeted amount for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and other factors.* *We welcome compensation discussions if this range doesn't meet your requirements. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.* *Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.* **About Fluidstack** ==================== We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI. **We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!** **How We Operate** ================== * **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. * **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible. * **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. * **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. * **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. **The Facility Controls Team** ============================== The Facility Controls team builds the control systems behind Fluidstack's data centers: real\-time load control, MEP and behind\-the\-meter integration, automated commissioning, and autonomous deployment. **Examples of key problems the team is working on** * Deliver the controls behind gigawatt\-scale data centers this decade. * Own real\-time load control and MEP and behind\-the\-meter integration. * Automate Level 4 and Level 5 commissioning. * Drive autonomous, robotic deployment. **Role Scope** ============== * **Own the control and data contract between our facility energy controller and third\-party power plant controllers.** Define the objects, fields, units, update rates and staleness behavior that cross the boundary in each direction. * **Define the sequences of operation our controller executes.** Normal operation, generation shortfall, source transitions, blackstart and emergency shed, along with the degradation behavior for each. * **Specify the point maps, interlocks and constraint classes that vendors build against.** Then hold them to it through factory and site acceptance. * **Translate between electrical and software.** Turn electrical and generation constraints into requirements our software team can build, and turn software and data constraints back into terms a plant vendor and an engineer of record will accept. * **Prove the interface in simulation before energization.** Every constraint class and every mode transition, then carry that work into automated commissioning **What We're Looking For** ========================== **The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would.** * You have worked in the protocols that move data between machines and between systems (MQTT, OPC UA, REST APIs) and you can say why you would pick one over another for a given job rather than reaching for whichever one you used last. * You write and read code in at least one language well enough to prototype an integration, test a point map against a live device, and review what the software team ships. Python or Go preferred. * You read a one\-line and a panel schedule and can say what the protection, the breakers and the sources will actually do under a fault. * You have designed a data contract between two systems: the objects, the fields, the units, the update rates, and what a consumer does when a value goes stale. You held both sides to it. * You have written the control narrative for a system where two controllers had to agree, and you owned what happened when they disagreed. * You sit between the controls world and the software world and you are fluent in both. You have taken a control requirement from an electrical engineer and turned it into something a software team could actually build, and you have pushed back on a software design because it would not survive the field. * You have pushed back on a vendor's scope, or on your own company's assumption, with a number rather than an opinion. * **Bonus:** Microgrid and behind\-the\-meter control (grid\-forming BESS, PV plant controllers, turbine and genset dispatch). Utility and industrial protocols (DNP3, IEC 61850 GOOSE, IEC 60870\-5\-104, Modbus TCP). Schema\-driven contracts (OpenAPI, JSON Schema). Automated Level 4 and Level 5 commissioning. We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: CTO
jobs.description: The poultry industry has always struggled to get high\-quality commercial data, and nothing is harder to measure than welfare. Most of what we think we know about welfare technology rests on small university studies that don't look like commercial production and take years to run. The data that actually matters has simply been too hard to capture at scale. But that’s changing: new AI tools around continuous sensing, machine vision, and robotics are giving us the ability to measure welfare at the level of the individual bird, and to run rigorous experiments against those measurements. Your job is to build a new, AI\-native technology stack for observing and understanding animal welfare under real production conditions. This is a full\-time exempt remote position, requiring travel within the United States. Responsibilities: * Own the technology strategy: the AI\-native monitoring and data infrastructure (cameras, sensors, bird\-level tracking, environmental telemetry) that is the backbone for every trial we run. * Make build/buy/partner decisions across the tech stack — including for hardware that can survive real barn conditions — and integrate components into one coherent, reusable system rather than a pile of point solutions. * Work with the Program Team to build the pipeline of external technologies we test (robotics, computer vision, vaccines, feed additives, etc.). — assess readiness, design the integration, and render clear go/no\-go judgments. * Build the data platform and standards so results are clean, comparable, and reusable across trials. * Build the technical team. Make the first engineering and data hires, decide what we hold in\-house versus contract or partner for, and convene the outside expertise we don't have. * Understand and interface with the systems already in a working barn (control units, feed lines, ventilation) and lead the technical side of infrastructure upgrades. * Own our IP strategy on the technology side: identify genuinely novel inventions and file patents opportunistically, and manage licensing and ownership terms with technology partners. About You * **A technical generalist.** Broad working knowledge across AI/ML, computer vision, sensing, data infrastructure, and hardware, rather than deep specialization in one. You're comfortable being the person who understands how the whole system fits together, and you know how and when to bring in a specialist. * **You use AI to put structure on messy things.** The core of this job is taking something complicated and poorly measured (a barn full of animals) and turning it into clean, quantitative, decision\-grade data. * **A 0\-to\-1 builder.** You've developed a technical roadmap and built a working system from nothing. * **AI\-native.** You design from the assumption that AI and data are the foundation, not an add\-on. You keep up with the latest developments in AI and physical AI. You can look at the current generation of precision livestock farming tools and see how to do better. * **Physical\-world experience is a plus.** Ideally you've built systems that were commercially deployed in physical, uncontrolled environments like farms, factories, or field hardware. * **A team builder** . You've hired and led small technical teams, and you know how to keep the bar high. * **A fast learner** of new domains, who wants to be on the farm. You don't need a poultry background, but you do need to get up to speed on broiler production and welfare quickly, and earn the trust of people who've spent their careers in it. * **Mission\-aligned** . You care about animal welfare and want to spend your effort improving it — drawn to an evidence\-first, industry\-facing approach. * **A translator** . You can talk to a barn manager, a machine\-learning engineer, a startup founder, and a philanthropic funder in the same week — and convene people who don't normally talk to each other.

This role requires both strategic leadership and technical depth. You will shape architecture roadmaps, evaluate emerging technologies, guide solution implementation, and help engineering teams solve complex business and technical challenges. You will work across supply chain domains including Supplier Collaboration, Material Planning, Inventory Management, Logistics, Manufacturing Integration, Supply Chain Visibility, and AI\-enabled decision support. You will help establish the future\-state architecture that connects business capabilities, data, analytics, AI, and operational systems to create an intelligent supply chain capable of anticipating disruptions, optimizing decisions, and accelerating business outcomes. **Enterprise Architecture \& Business Transformation** * Develop and maintain enterprise architecture strategies aligned to Supply Chain business objectives and transformation priorities. * Define future\-state business capabilities, operating models, information architectures, and technology roadmaps. * Lead architecture governance and solution reviews to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and strategic direction. * Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for modernization, simplification, automation, and innovation. * Serve as a trusted advisor on technology investments, architecture decisions, and transformation initiatives. **AI\-Enabled Supply Chain Architecture** * Architect intelligent supply chain solutions that enable sensing, prediction, recommendation, and autonomous action across supply chain operations. * Design architectures that integrate operational systems, enterprise data platforms, analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI capabilities. * Define approaches for AI\-powered planning, inventory optimization, logistics visibility, supplier collaboration, risk management, and operational decision support. * Guide adoption of emerging technologies including Generative AI, Agentic AI, digital assistants, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation. **Data, Analytics \& Integration Strategy** * Lead architecture for enterprise data products, semantic models, integration platforms, APIs, event\-driven architectures, and analytical ecosystems. * Establish scalable patterns for connecting SAP S/4HANA, Blue Yonder and other supply chain platforms, manufacturing systems, cloud services, and enterprise data platforms. * Drive strategies that improve end\-to\-end visibility, data quality, governance, and business insights. * Collaborate with engineering teams to enable real\-time and near real\-time decision\-making capabilities. **Technical Leadership \& Solution Delivery Support** * Partner directly with product, engineering, data, analytics, and platform teams to solve complex business and technical challenges. * Lead architecture reviews and technical decision\-making, balancing tradeoffs across scalability, performance, maintainability, security, and cost. * Prototype and evaluate emerging technologies and architecture patterns to accelerate innovation. * Provide technical leadership throughout the solution lifecycle, from concept and proof of value through production deployment. * Mentor architects and engineers through design reviews, coaching, and collaborative problem\-solving. **Cloud \& Platform Architecture** * Define cloud\-native architecture strategies leveraging Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and modern platform capabilities. * Establish architectural patterns for APIs, microservices, event\-driven solutions, data pipelines, analytics platforms, and AI workloads. * Collaborate with platform teams to improve engineering productivity, operational resilience, and deployment velocity. * Promote modern engineering practices, automation, and DevSecOps principles. **Security, Compliance \& Governance** * Ensure architecture decisions align with enterprise security, privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements. * Embed security\-by\-design and responsible AI principles into solution architectures. * Promote architecture standards, governance processes, and reusable patterns across the organization. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Chain Technologies and processes * 5\+ years proven experience in Enterprise Architecture, Consulting Architecture, Solution Architecture, or Technology Strategy leadership roles. * Experience leading large\-scale business and technology transformation initiatives. * Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and methodologies. * Deep knowledge of integration architecture, APIs, event\-driven architectures, cloud\-native design, and distributed systems. * Experience with SAP S/4HANA and supply chain business processes. * Experience designing data and analytics architectures using modern enterprise platforms. * Experience architecting AI, machine learning, generative AI, or intelligent automation solutions in enterprise environments. * Familiarity with modern AI engineering ecosystems, cloud AI services, and data science platforms. * Ability to influence executive, business, and technical audiences. * Strong facilitation, negotiation, and organizational jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: **About Freckle** Freckle is the data and workflow layer for GTM teams. Users tell an agent in Claude, Codex or our app what they want, and Freckle builds and runs it: pulling lists, enriching them across dozens of data providers, scoring with AI agents, and writing results back to the CRM. We compete head to head with Clay and win, and Series A\+ teams like Bolt.new run their GTM on us. **The role** You own the engine that runs every customer workflow: scheduling, queues, retries, provider integrations, and cost and reliability at scale. When a paying customer's run fails, it's your system and your fix. You'll be one of the first engineers and shape how the platform is built from here. **What you'll do** * Own the workflow engine: scheduling, batching, idempotency, cancelling and retrying runs * Build and harden integrations with dozens of data providers: rate limits, concurrency, failures, cost per call * Make failures visible and cheap to fix: observability, alerting, cost per run * Scale Postgres and Redis as volume grows * Use coding agents heavily and own the judgment on what they produce **You might be a fit if you** * Have built job systems, queues or data pipelines that ran in production at real volume * Treat reliability and cost as product features * Are pragmatic and autonomous, and don't need a curated task board Bonus: Effect or functional TypeScript, high\-volume data infrastructure, or an early\-stage startup behind you. **Stack:** TypeScript and Effect end to end, Postgres, Redis, React with Vite and TanStack, ElectricSQL sync **Benefits:** generous equity; health benefits for you and dependents Freckle is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Assistant Chief Engineer - Bridge Department
jobs.description: **Assistant Chief Engineer – Structural (Bridge)****Wall Township, NJ** French \& Parrello Associates (FPA) is seeking an experienced and highly respected Assistant Chief Engineer – Bridge to provide technical leadership and strategic direction for our growing Bridge Department at our headquarters in Wall Township, NJ. This is a unique opportunity for a senior transportation engineering professional who wants to make a significant impact by leading complex bridge projects, mentoring talented engineers, advancing technical excellence, and helping shape the continued growth of one of the Northeast’s fastest\-growing engineering consulting firms. Recognized year after year as one of NJBIZ’s Best Places to Work in New Jersey, FPA is committed to creating a culture where talented professionals are empowered to grow, collaborate, and lead. In 2026, FPA was ranked \#49 on Zweig’s Hot Firm List, recognizing the firm among the 100 fastest\-growing AEC firms in the United States and Canada. Our continued growth is driven by our investment in our people, technical expertise, and commitment to delivering innovative infrastructure solutions for the communities we serve. The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader within FPA’s Bridge Department, providing oversight and guidance on complex bridge design, rehabilitation, and transportation infrastructure projects throughout New Jersey and the region. This individual will work closely with project managers, engineers, and multidisciplinary teams to ensure the successful delivery of high\-quality engineering solutions while advancing the department’s technical capabilities and reputation. This role is ideal for a recognized bridge engineering professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, developing engineering talent, collaborating with clients and agencies, and contributing to the strategic growth of a multidisciplinary engineering firm. Unlike larger organizations where senior technical professionals can become disconnected from project teams and decision\-making, FPA provides the opportunity to directly influence projects, mentor future leaders, and play a key role in shaping the future of our Bridge practice. **Bridge Engineering Expertise \& Project Experience** FPA’s Bridge Department has a long\-standing reputation for delivering innovative solutions for complex transportation infrastructure projects throughout New Jersey and the Northeast. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: GCC \& Associates LLC is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) based in Irvine, California that specializes in delivering projects for the built environment. The firm provides program, project and construction management, project controls, executive alignment, and partnering and facilitation services certified by the International Partnering Institute. GCC serves federal clients including the Department of Veterans Affairs, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, GSA, Department of State, Department of Justice and U.S. Air Force, as well as state and local governments and private developers. Its experience covers healthcare, education, ports, airports, transit and international work, with projects such as VA medical centers, U.S. embassies, the LAX expansion program and the Giant Magellan Telescope in Chile. GCC's stated mission is the "safe, sustainable, and successful delivery of projects and programs that enhance communities worldwide." Sources: * GCC \& Associates LLC home page GCC provides construction management, project management and commissioning support for a portfolio of Non\-Recurring Maintenance (NRM) projects at the Central Alabama Veterans Health Care System (CAVHCS), covering its VA Medical Center campuses in Montgomery and Tuskegee, Alabama. The work includes replacing the aging central boiler plant with a new boiler system and its supporting infrastructure, along with a building renovation and the renovation of pathology space. Other projects replace fire alarm systems in several buildings, correct failing plumbing conditions, and mitigate critical electrical hazards through site lighting improvements, which together address deficiencies found in facility condition assessments. On\-site mechanical engineers, electrical engineers and staff architects are each assigned to a specific project, providing project management, scheduling, cost and change order control, and review of submittals and requests for information. The team also runs quality assurance inspections, constructability and phasing reviews, and safety and code compliance monitoring. It coordinates closely with facility staff so construction doesn't disrupt ongoing hospital operations, utilities or patient access. The team oversees commissioning and startup of new systems, so each project is fully tested, documented and ready for turnover to the VA over the next five years. **Requirements** The Electrical Engineer (EE) shall be a licensed professional with a degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution of higher learning. The individual shall have a minimum of six (6\) years of experience in both design and construction. The EE shall be able to quickly understand and master the requirements of the local state and federal jurisdictions and the requirements of each considering the Requirements of the Project. The EE must possess Communication, Language, and Software Skills with the ability to utilize a variety of software programs to monitor, update, and produce work products by applying knowledge of computer literacy **Benefits** * Annual Salary $165,000 * 401K Matching * Health Insurance * Vision \& Dental Insurance * Life insurance * Paid Time Off * Referral Program * 40 Work Hours Only per Week

This includes, amongst others, Protection relays, control systems, cyber security solutions, device management, asset performance, and many more. Grid Automation Software operates at the boundaries of Grid technologies, embedded software and advanced analytics solutions. If you’re passionate about Software and want to work on improving Grid resilience through Software, this is the job for you. We are looking for a Deployment and Site Reliability Engineer to join the GridBeats™ team. The GridBeats™ Software Portfolio aggregates all Grid Automation applications which monitor, optimize and manage grid connected devices. It is a very complex and exciting portfolio which is setting the basis for grid connected devices management for the future. The Deployment and Site Reliability Engineer takes GridBeats™ software into customer operation and keeps it running there. The role deploys, commissions, and upgrades our software at customer sites and remotely, and is the technical escalation point when something critical breaks in a live installation. It is the engineer customers and Regional Operations rely on when a deployment has to succeed inside a maintenance window, and when a production issue has to be understood and resolved rather than merely logged. The portfolio runs on Kubernetes, so deep Kubernetes skill is the central technical requirement for this position. This is a customer\-facing, hands\-on role, and it is not a product engineering role. The software is built by the product teams; this role gets it installed, proven, and supported in real substation and utility environments, and feeds what it learns in the field back into the products. jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer – Retail Data
jobs.description: **Job Description** ***At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human\-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next\-generation safety and entertainment features.*** ***Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.*** **The Role** The AV Fleet Data Engineering team is responsible for the end\-to\-end design, requirements, integration, validation, and execution of AV/ADAS data\-collection capabilities. As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will lead the definition and delivery of Retail AV Data Collection solutions that support ADAS and automated\-driving development, fleet monitoring, machine\-learning data collection, regulatory compliance, and product improvement. You will translate stakeholder and customer use cases into system\-level strategies, feature\-level requirements, functional specifications, architecture concepts, and verification plans. This role will lead hands\-on systems engineering across vehicles, benches, simulation and playback environments, cloud/data pipelines, and connected fleet campaigns. The engineer will work closely with software, platform, vehicle integration, quality, data engineering, ADAS, AV, product, legal, and regulatory teams to deliver scalable and reliable data\-recording solutions. **What You'll Do** * Gather and analyze stakeholder, customer, ADAS, AV, regulatory, privacy, and machine\-learning use cases. * Decompose product requirements into stakeholder use cases, feature\-level specifications, system requirements, interfaces, constraints, and verification criteria. * Define system strategies for recording triggers, signals, topics, recording durations, data quality, compute and storage budgets, data offload, privacy, consent, geofencing, and vehicle compatibility. * Develop system\-level test strategies, use cases, test cases, functional checks, and validation plans for new functionality. * Coordinate with software and platform teams to communicate requirements, defects, dependencies, risks, and release impacts. * Ensure system designs account for customer consent, privacy, legal constraints, geofencing, regional requirements, and regulatory data\-recording needs. * Support data\-collection request intake by clarifying use cases, identifying available signals, defining trigger logic, assessing pipeline limitations, and determining required software or architecture changes. * Identify opportunities to improve requirements quality, systems engineering processes, test automation, configuration management, release readiness, and stakeholder communication. * Make technical recommendations based on analysis, communicate lessons learned, and keep engineering leadership informed of assignment status, timing, risks, and technical issues. Mentor engineers and contribute to reusable systems\-engineering standard work, documentation, and technical training. * **Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications)** * 5\+ years of systems engineering, requirements engineering, embedded systems, automotive software, or related engineering experience. * Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline. * Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional technical activities involving multiple engineering disciplines. * Experience translating customer or stakeholder needs into system requirements, functional specifications, interfaces, and verification criteria. * Experience with requirements management and traceability tools, preferably DNG. * Strong understanding of complex electrical, mechanical, software, and vehicle system concepts. * High level of analytical ability and demonstrated success solving unusual or complex technical problems. * Experience defining and executing system\-level test cases and validation strategies. * Strong written and oral communication skills, including technical presentations and requirements reviews. jobs.description: G\+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We create trust in the digital age with integrated security technologies in three business areas: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our co\-operation within G\+D. The whole world trusts us when it comes to physical or digital currencies. We increase the security and efficiency of the cash cycle in collaboration with central banks and the entire currency industry. As the market leader in advanced currency management, would you like to join us in shaping the future of payments? **Summary** ----------- A Level III Field Service Technician will utilize their technical expertise and independent judgment to provide on\-site servicing, installation, and repair of complex electromechanical equipment. This role is crucial in maintaining high customer satisfaction through data\-driven tools, proactive attention to customer needs, and positive interactions. Responsibilities include supporting customers with operational or maintenance issues, addressing escalated technical and service\-related concerns, diagnosing failures in mechanical, hardware, software, and systems, implementing effective repairs to minimize downtime, and preparing reports for analyzing product failure trends and serviceability issues. Additionally, this role will also assist with the on\-site training and development of less experienced field service technicians and acts as a key communication link between technical support, management, and the customer on technical matters and projects. Flexibility for long hours and travel is required. **Duties/Responsibilities** --------------------------- Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions. * Apply company policies and procedures to complete routine tasks effectively. * Respond promptly to service calls, perform equipment maintenance at customer sites, and assist operators with operational issues. * Represent the company professionally at all times. * Handle administrative tasks, including record\-keeping, reporting, and inventory management, with accuracy and timeliness. * Develop and maintain technical competence through formal training programs, on\-site training, and hands\-on experience. * Comply with company policies regarding confidentiality and customer procedures, including Custody and Control Procedures. * Manage parts inventory, coordinate shipments for repair and replenishment, and oversee the inventory of tools and test equipment. * Record maintenance activities using approved methods and procedures. * Follow escalation procedures to resolve issues promptly and ensure timely communication with designated company personnel and customer management. * Promote high customer satisfaction by maintaining open communication and providing proactive attention to customer needs. * Assist with the on\-site training of less experienced field service technicians. * Show flexibility to travel as required to support business needs, including providing coverage for other Field Engineers during vacations or illnesses. Travel may be within the home territory or to other areas. * Perform all activities safely and adhere to company safety policies and procedures. * Complete other duties as assigned. **Required Skills/Knowledge** ----------------------------- * Hands\-on experience with electromechanical equipment is preferred. * Proficiency in electromechanical troubleshooting, understanding electronic principles, and working knowledge of computer systems, PCs, and networking is required. * Experience with solenoids, belts, rollers, bearings, pneumatics, and guides is a plus. * Strong oral and written communication skills are essential. * Ability to use a laptop/tablet for administrative and diagnostic tasks. * Willingness to provide personal information and obtain Gaming Licenses in required jurisdictions (for Commercial Field Service Technicians). * Work may be home office\-based or customer site\-based. * Personal vehicle use may be required depending on business needs. * Potential responsibility for a company fleet vehicle may be required depending on business needs. * Shift work may be required. **Required Education and Experience** ------------------------------------- * High school diploma or GED required. * An Associate degree or trade/technical school certificate/diploma preferred. * Minimum of four (4\) years of relevant work experience, including at least two years in a field service environment. * Hands\-on experience with electromechanical equipment is essential. * Previous experience in customer\-facing roles is required. **Salary** ---------- $68,000\-$75,000 **Other duties** ---------------- Please note that this job description is not intended to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee.
