jobs.title: Product Director - Personalization & Customer Insight
jobs.description: **JOB DESCRIPTION** You lead by building: teams, products, and the strategy that connects them. Join us to shape how the bank turns customer data into intelligence people can act on, and to grow the product leaders who make it real. As a Product Director in Personalization \& Customer Insights (Intelligence) team, you own the product vision and strategy for a portfolio of AI\-powered intelligence products, and you lead the product managers who deliver it. You set direction, develop your team, and stay close enough to the work to pressure\-test model design, evaluation, and experiment tradeoffs yourself. You act as the voice of the customer, translate research and analytics into a clear multi\-year plan, and drive execution across a highly matrixed organization, aligning Data Scientists, ML Engineers, partner teams, and business stakeholders around a shared roadmap. You are accountable for what the team ships, on time and at quality, not just for setting direction. You own the products that give a clear, 1:1 understanding of each customer, built for customers and for the bankers who serve them. You make sure that intelligence is tested and validated before it reaches customers, and you drive the personalization strategy with the lines of business. You partner closely with the platform and modeling teams that build and serve the models, but your portfolio is the intelligence itself and how the business puts it to work. At its core, this work is about personalization that makes every interaction feel built around the individual: the sense that the bank knows them and is working for them. Delivering that at scale takes more than one great product; it takes a product organization with a clear strategy and the leadership to execute it. This role sets that vision, builds the team that delivers it, and drives it to reality across the organization. **Job responsibilities*** Oversees the product roadmap, vision, development, execution, risk management, and business growth targets * Leads the entire product life cycle through planning, execution, and future development by continuously adapting, developing new products and methodologies, managing risks, and achieving business targets like cost, features, reusability, and reliability to support growth * Coaches and mentors the product team on best practices, such as solution generation, market research, storyboarding, mind\-mapping, prototyping methods, product adoption strategies, and product delivery, enabling them to effectively deliver on objectives * Owns product performance and is accountable for investing in enhancements to achieve business objectives * Monitors market trends, conducts competitive analysis, and identifies opportunities for product differentiation * Stay hands\-on across the model lifecycle with Data Scientists and ML Engineers: model design, evaluation, and iteration for LLM/ML\-based solutions. * Frame hypotheses and run experiments (e.g., A/B testing) to validate impact and measure outcomes, and raise the experimentation bar across your team. * Define and track product KPIs for engagement, quality, cost, risk posture, reliability, and business outcomes. * Align with partner teams on contracts, SLAs, and guardrails so intelligence is delivered safely and consistently across surfaces. * Be accountable for responsible AI and data practices across your portfolio, including consent management and fairness, in partnership with Risk, Privacy, and Compliance. * Drive execution across a highly matrixed organization and represent the Intelligence space to executive stakeholders. **Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** 8\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise delivering products, cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management * Experience driving change within organizations and managing stakeholders across multiple functions * Proven success delivering AI/ML\-powered products to production in customer\-facing environments, in close partnership with Data Science and ML Engineering across the model lifecycle. * Demonstrated success with ML\-driven personalization and/or next\-best\-action, including experimentation and rigorous outcome measurement. * Strong data literacy, able to turn research and metrics into decisions and roadmaps that deliver on time, cost, and quality. * Hands\-on data fluency: able to explore and query data yourself (SQL/Python, or AI\-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude) to frame problems, sanity\-check models, and move quickly. This role does not lead from a distance; familiarity with these tools is expected. * Accountable for delivery, not just direction: a track record of owning a product through to production and prioritizing under real constraints, balancing new work against operational stability, reliability, controls/regulatory needs, and technical debt. * Comfort with ambiguity and breadth: a track record of stepping into unfamiliar problem spaces and, in a space that is still forming, helping define it. * Proven ability to set product vision and drive execution across a highly matrixed organization; excellent executive stakeholder management and clear, structured written and verbal communication. **Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Recognized thought leader within a related field * Experience leading a product team through a period of growth or ambiguity, standing up new areas, not just running established ones. * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML and LLMs in production (agentic assistants, personalization, recommendations, or representation/embedding\-based systems), including model evaluation and iteration. * Experience shipping data or platform products that support model developers or agentic assistants (context, signals, evaluation, or self\-service tooling). * BS or MS in Engineering, Data Science, or a comparable field. **ABOUT US** Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. mindset and willingness to learn new processes, technologies, and machining techniques. * Focus on precision, consistency, and meeting manufacturing schedules without compromising quality. **Why KARL jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: Karman is a fast\-growing NVIDIA\-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid — bringing real\-time visibility and power\-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them. We are seeking an Embedded Firmware Engineer to develop production\-grade firmware for power grid edge computing platforms. You will work alongside a diverse team of experts across hardware, cloud infrastructure, and AI/algorithms to design, implement, and deploy embedded systems running on mission\-critical power infrastructure. This role focuses on hands\-on development across multiple hardware variants — writing firmware features, extending our CI/CD and test infrastructure, building logging and diagnostic tooling, and supporting hardware bring\-up under the guidance of senior engineers. We are looking for an early\-career engineer who is eager to learn from experienced mentors to develop production\-grade firmware. **Responsibilities*** Develop, test, and deploy firmware features across multiple hardware platforms, contributing scalable and fault\-tolerant components * Assist with hardware bring\-up efforts and collaborate directly with hardware engineering teams during development cycles * Write and debug real\-time embedded software in C/C\+\+ on resource\-constrained microcontrollers, using the RTOS and bare\-metal patterns established by the team * Implement and debug communication protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, LTE, WiFi) for IoT device connectivity * Uphold firmware engineering standards, including coding conventions, testing protocols, and documentation requirements * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, HIL (hardware\-in\-the\-loop) test infrastructure, and automated release tooling using Python, Docker, and GitHub Actions * Extend logging, telemetry, and diagnostic subsystems, including dissectors and lab tooling * Collaborate cross\-functionally with external contractors, cloud infrastructure, AI/algorithms, and product teams to deliver integrated solutions **Minimum Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience * 0–3 jobs.title: Customer Operations Associate
jobs.description: **About Kairon Health** ======================= Kairon is the execution layer for healthcare. We turn fragmented claims and clinical data into workflows that help ACOs and health networks actually capture their shared savings — not just measure them after the fact. We are a seed\-stage team of under 10, working with live customers managing real patient populations, and we are AI\-native by construction. Our early customers are getting real value; now we are solving the most interesting operational puzzle in a startup — how do we do this 10x without breaking? **The Opportunity** =================== You are the daily engine of Customer Operations, reporting to the Director of Customer Operations. Where the Director designs and leads how we onboard, retain, and grow customers, you make it run — turning customer needs into clear, scoped work, keeping account workstreams on track across teams, and closing every loop back to the customer. You live in the seam between customers and engineering, and you’re also the person who spots where a customer could be getting more value from the platform and surfaces it. When a customer says “our numbers look wrong,” you are the one who figures out whether it is a real bug or a misread before an engineer ever touches it. **Location: Remote (DC \- NYC Corridor)** **Responsibilities** ==================== * **Daily support triage:** Turn every customer message into clear, owned, and due\-dated work using our internal scoping process; keep the “waiting on us” queue moving toward zero. * **First\-line troubleshooting:** Reproduce data and metric issues, gather evidence, and resolve directly when possible or hand Engineering a clean, actionable ticket. * **Customer health \& adoption monitoring:** Track account KPIs, product usage, and trends; identify low engagement, risks, and opportunities and surface them to your Director for proactive follow\-up. * **Customer value analysis:** Analyze how accounts use the platform and translate findings into clear insights and recommendations for your Director and client stakeholders. * **Proactive communications support:** Leverage usage analytics, support trends, and recurring customer needs to identify opportunities for proactive customer education, communications, and outreach. * **Renewal \& growth support:** Maintain a working understanding of account performance and contribute analysis and materials to renewal and expansion conversations led by your Director and Enterprise Growth. * **Operational coordination:** Keep account workstreams moving day\-to\-day across Engineering, Product, and Sales, ensuring requirements are clearly scoped and nothing stalls between teams. * **Client meeting support:** Support with preparation of materials, join client calls, capture follow\-ups; your Director will lead or co\-lead the majority of key\-account meetings. * **Onboarding execution:** Support with onboarding checklists, roster and configuration validation, user setup, and training materials to keep implementations on track. * **Voice of the customer:** Bring customer feedback, recurring themes, and support trends into internal discussions to inform product improvements and customer strategy. * **Knowledge base management:** Continuously improve customer\-facing resources based on user analytics, support trends, and customer feedback—identifying opportunities to create new content or optimize existing resources. * **Weekly operating cadence:** Run the high\-priority requirements report and proactively prepare for bug blitzes and other internal/external meetings; support customer health reporting and ensure product release workflows enable proactive customer communications ahead of launches. **Qualifications** ================== * 2\-4 years in operations, implementation, technical support, or consulting where you owned execution and outcomes. * Strong written communication — a diplomatic customer email and a crisp engineering handoff, and you know the difference. * Highly organized; energized, not overwhelmed, by juggling many small, important things at once. * Data fluency: comfortable in spreadsheets and structured data; can spot a duplicate row, a bad identifier, or a metric that jumped for the wrong reason. * Daily AI\-tool user — because you found it makes you faster, not because you were told to. * Systems\-thinker: your instinct on a recurring problem is to fix the process, not just the instance. **Nice\-to\-haves** =================== * Healthcare, value\-based care, or ACO exposure — or genuine eagerness to learn the vocabulary of shared savings, quality measures, and AWVs. * SQL, Snowflake, or dashboard and analytics familiarity. * Experience supporting software implementations or customer onboarding. **What success looks like in the first 90 days** ================================================ * **Days 1–30:** Own daily support triage end\-to\-end—every inbound is clearly scoped, assigned, and due\-dated within the day—and build fluency in each account’s setup, configuration, and data. * **Days 31–60:** Keep account workplans and requirements current and moving; independently run the weekly high\-priority report and health scorecards; and begin contributing meaningful analysis and insights to account and renewal conversations. * **Days 61–90:** Resolve or cleanly scope the majority of first\-line data and metric issues before they reach Engineering; proactively surface customer health, adoption, and value insights; identify opportunities for proactive customer communications; and maintain active follow\-up plans for low\-adoption accounts—freeing the Director to focus on strategy and key customer relationships. **Why Join?** ============= * Proven Impact: A platform already driving measurable results — \~$30M in financial value and \~7,000 additional preventive visits across a single customer’s network in 2025 — and winning seven\-figure enterprise contracts. * Category Credibility: NCQA PHM\-prevalidated Care Operations module; founding team from Aledade and Redesign Health / Vault Health. * AI\-Native Product: Built with Claude, automated transcription, and intelligent workflows as core infrastructure — a genuinely differentiated product to sell. * Mission\-Driven Culture: Work with a small team of talented, passionate problem\-solvers making a measurable difference in healthcare. **Compensation** ================ * Base salary: $85,000 \- $110,000 * Full benefits (health, dental, vision, 401k); remote\-friendly with true startup flexibility Compensation Range: $85K \- $110K

jobs.title: AI Operations Lead
jobs.description: **About Karbon** Karbon is the global leader in AI\-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award\-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well\-funded, ranked \#1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people\-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List. Karbon is further ahead on AI adoption than most companies our size. Every department is running AI daily. Hundreds of skills and workflows have been built by our own team. Fourteen department champions drive adoption and share knowledge across the business. The foundation is real and it works. The next phase is scale. We need one person whose entire job is extending what we have built, measuring what it returns, and adding the next layer of capability. Not a strategy deck. A working system, the governance that makes it trustworthy, and the numbers that prove it. You will report into the CEO and work across every department. You will have the access and sponsorship to make changes stick. #### **About the Role** #### **Build the Tooling** * Ship internal automations and agents that remove repeated manual work across Sales, CS, Implementation, Support, and Operations. Connect AI to the systems we already run, through APIs and MCP servers. * The first build is the data gateway. Karbon runs its own MCP server. You extend it into a routing proxy that sits between Claude and every internal data source teams need. Authentication via Okta. RBAC enforcement by department. Request logging for spend attribution and audit. Once the gateway is approved by Security, new connectors plug into a config entry instead of triggering a full review each time. That is your first thirty days. * After that: CS gets a renewal risk signal. Sales gets a proposal draft automation. Implementation gets a SOW generator with scope\-creep flags. Support gets a ticket triage router. * Prototype fast. Harden what people use. Delete what they ignore. Hand every tool to an owner in the team that uses it. You build it. They run it. #### **Own Governance and Visibility** * Manage the Claude access and provisioning workflow — seat requests, model and tool access, connector approvals — and the Slack workflows that support it. Run the connector security review pipeline in partnership with Security. * Own the spend dashboard across all AI tools, not just Claude. Cursor, Codex, Linear AI, and anything else the org is running sit alongside Claude in one view. Department leaders see their own number weekly without asking you to pull it. Bad trends surface before they become invoice surprises. * Extend that visibility into an ROI framework: adoption rate, hours saved, cost per seat, project\-level impact. Partner with Finance on budget accountability. * Run the AI champions program. Fourteen department champions, organized into pods, own peer enablement and skill submissions within their teams. You run the cadences, maintain the hub pages, and hold champions accountable for engagement. When people leave Karbon, their projects and skills do not leave with them. You own the offboarding flow that captures and reassigns that work. * Build and maintain the AI wiki — per\-department documentation of tools, active use cases, and skills in use. Keep it current as tools evolve. #### **Train Teams and Set the Standard** * Work with each department lead to agree how their team uses AI, then hold that standard. * Run practical training. Short, specific, and repeatable. Teach people the efficient way to get the same answer. Most cost problems are habit problems. After month one, you know what each team's workflows look like because you built them. That makes you a better trainer than anyone who has not. * Build and maintain a shared library of prompts, skills, and patterns so knowledge stays when a person leaves. Own the pipeline that moves skills from intake through review to the shared library — and automate the parts of it that should not require a human. #### **Measure and Report the Return** * Define the small set of metrics that show whether AI is working: cost, adoption, delivery, and quality. * Build the data pipelines behind those metrics. Expect the source data to be messy. Publish a regular report to the executive team. Same format every time. Bad news included. * Delete any metric that has not changed a decision in a quarter. #### **About You!** * You shipped production software in the last two years, as the person writing the code. Python or TypeScript, SQL, and REST APIs. * You built something real on top of a large language model. Not a demo. Something with users, error handling, and a cost you had to control. * You worked directly with non\-technical teams as the technical person in the room. Forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer, GTM engineer, internal tools engineer, or similar. You know what a CS renewal motion looks like and what implementation scoping feels like. You do not need to have worked in those roles. You need to have built something those teams actually used. * You can build a number out of messy data and defend it to a CFO. * You have run a cross\-functional program where the participants did not report to you — a champion network, an ambassador program, an adoption initiative. You know how to create accountability without authority. * You write clearly, and you can say no to work that will not pay off. **Bonus Points:** Accounting, professional services, or B2B software market experience. Familiarity with MCP server development, Claude API, or agent frameworks. Experience with Okta or similar identity providers. #### **What Success Looks Like!** **By month six:** Three automations run in production, each owned by the team that uses it. Every department leader can see their own AI usage and cost, including spend outside Claude. The spend dashboard is live and trusted. Your first report to the executive team is argued with, not just acknowledged. The gateway has Security sign\-off and every new connector goes through it. **By month twelve:** Cost per unit of work delivered is moving in the right direction, and everyone agrees on how it is calculated. jobs.title: Civil Designer - Kiewit Infrastructure Engineers
jobs.description: **Requisition ID:** 182518 **Job Level:** Entry Level **Home District/Group:** Kiewit Infrastructure Engineers **Department:** Drafting \& Design **Market:** Transportation Employment Type: Full Time **Position Overview** --------------------- Kiewit Infrastructure Engineers (KIE) is seeking an early career Civil/Structural CAD Designer in our Engineering Services During Construction (ESDC) Production group in the KIE Omaha, NE office. The successful candidate will perform a variety of civil, geotechnical, and structural CAD / Modeling tasks using Autodesk or Bentley related software to update contract drawings to support construction operations As\-Built/Record Drawing requirements. They will also lead coordination efforts with key construction and client staff to resolve any question or concerns during the As\-Built process. Our ESDC Production group provides value to the success of our clients’ projects by managing post design change resolution which is critical to quality project design, cost control, and construction excellence. We assist Kiewit infrastructure districts in the process of managing released for construction drawing changes through construction operation excellence. KIE tasks our ESDC Production department to help Kiewit build projects which includes integrated As\-Built/Record drawing oversight and management, train construction personnel on documenting accurate redline/markups, capturing accurate redline/markup information from construction, and incorporating into contract CAD design drawings. **District Overview** --------------------- Kiewit Infrastructure Engineering's Design\-Build team is driving clients to turn to Kiewit during all stages of complex projects. Through our integrated design and construction approach, our multi\-disciplinary team works together to improve schedule, control costs, and minimize risk. Our construction\-focused engineers work collaboratively with our estimators and builders to design solutions that are innovative, constructible, and designed with a focus on safety. Clients benefit from the proven processes and tools used by Kiewit to minimize project risk. We are an in\-house resource that supports projects throughout the company. Our staff shares experiences gained, innovative concepts, and best practices for all projects that we support. Kiewit's management and implementation of this process lead to safe, cost\-effective, and innovative designs that exceed client expectations and further Kiewit's legacy of excellence. On our team, you'll have the opportunity to see more, touch more, and do more than you ever imagined. Working hard will not only bring you satisfaction from a job well done, but it will help propel your career forward faster than you might expect. We will train you, develop your skills, and allow you to take on projects that impact millions across North America. With top\-notch health benefits, a wealth\-building 401k plan, and unbeatable growth opportunities, by joining Kiewit, you're ensuring a lifetime of success. **Location** ------------ This position is located in downtown Omaha, NE at our Kiewit Headquarters. This role requires regular, onsite attendance. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Work with our engineering teams and Clients to provide latest As\-Built design drawings to construction team * Virtual plan set support, with emphasis on training personnel on construction team * Coordinate with Document Control specialists to manage accurate redline/markup changes in virtual plan set * Review of client As\-Built/Record Drawing requirements and develop As\-Built/Record Drawing plan * Work with construction team and assisting them in documentation of redline/markup changes made in the field * Coordinate effective meetings with construction/client teams and track down answers * Participate in change documentation reviews to evaluate and make recommendations * Work with construction team to provide the Client with As\-Built/Record Drawing submittals **Qualifications** ------------------ * Associate degree or High School diploma \+ 2 years’ experience as a minimum. * 0\-2 years' minimum relevant experience. * Proficiency in Autodesk AutoCAD * Additional proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D, MicroStation, or Revit is a plus * Infrastructure project design or construction experience is a plus * General knowledge of engineering principles for civil / structural work * Read and understand civil / structural construction documents •Strong and Effective oral and written communication skills contributing to team\-based collaboration environment •Critical thinking skills necessary with the ability to plan and conceptualize * Capable of recognizing conflicts and discrepancies with strong attention to detail •Self\-motivation and drive to provide and excellent work product •Basic skills in Microsoft Office products (Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint) * Travel expectation for this role is 10\-15% **Working Conditions** ---------------------- Other Requirements: * Regular, reliable attendance * Work productively and meet deadlines timely * Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment. * Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies. * Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required. * May work at various different locations and conditions may vary. We offer our fulltime staff employees a comprehensive benefits package that’s among the best in our industry, including top\-tier medical, dental and vision plans covering eligible employees and dependents, voluntary wellness and employee assistance programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with matching, and generous paid time off. Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Network Control Technician
jobs.description: Overview: PRIMARY PURPOSE: For the Company’s nationwide telecommunications network, proactively monitor and maintain the network’s maximum availability and integrity at all times. Responsibilities: ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES: * Monitor and maintain the integrity of Kinder Morgan’s telecommunication network (including but not limited to digital/analog microwave, MPLS, VSAT, PL) * Utilize software and hardware tools (including but not limited to Solar Winds, Zabbix, Cisco, Juniper ) to identify, diagnose, and drive resolution of problems and factors affecting network integrity * On a regular basis, perform complex testing and analysis of all elements of the telecommunications network, including data, voice, video, and SCADA * Apply problem\-solving skills and break down complex problems into solvable segments * Regular and direct interface with customers, vendors, field technicians, and network engineers (internal and external) * Accurately and effectively document network troubles utilizing the current problem resolution (ticketing) system * Ensure smooth transition of shift turnovers through verbal and written communication * Ensure ongoing improvement through evaluation of current processes * Maintain accurate and current contact information with supervisor and department members * Deal with a wide variety of people and personalities with tact, courtesy, and professionalism * Speak clearly, both in person and by telephone, using a high level of verbal skills, and listen carefully * Maintain a regular, dependable attendance and a high level of performance * Maintain a high regard for personal safety, the safety of company assets and employees, and the general public * Will work non\-traditional hours (shift rotation is required to maintain a 24x7x365 operation); shift change may occur with little advance notice * May be required to carry a company\-provided cell phone/pager and be available to respond during working hours and occasionally during non\-working hours * Other daily, weekly, and monthly duties, and special projects as assigned. Other responsibilities: The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed. This position may perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: EDUCATION: * High school diploma or equivalent experience is required * An associate or bachelor’s degree in a telecommunications field is desirable EXPERIENCE/SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE: * Minimum 1 to 3 years direct work experience in network operations or telecommunications with proven troubleshooting skills in the area of telecommunications and data networks * Working knowledge of data, voice, video, and SCADA network components * Proficient with incident tracking systems * Proficient in Microsoft applications (Word, Excel, Outlook) for the purpose of word processing, spreadsheets, and information retrieval * Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license and a driving record satisfactory to the Company and its insurers * Must be jobs.description: Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. The EIR will be an integral part of our innovation team, focusing on identifying, developing, and launching new software\-driven healthcare tech ventures in collaboration with startup partners. During this time, the EIR will work closely with LG NOVA to validate, build, and advance a new venture with the goal of developing it toward spinout. **Location:** this can be a hybrid position working out of our office in Santa Clara, CA. \#LI\-JH1 \#HYBRID **Benefits Offered Full\-Time Employees:** * No\-cost employee premiums for you and your eligible dependents for competitive medical, dental, vision and prescription benefits. * Auto enrollment with immediate vesting of competitive company matching contributions in a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with several investment options. * Generous Paid Time Off program that includes company holidays and a combined bank of paid sick and vacation time. * Performance based Short\-Term Incentives (varies by role). * Access to confidential mental health resources to help you and your loved ones improve your quality of life. Personal fitness goal incentives. * Family orientated benefits such as paid parental leave and support for families raising children with learning, social, behavioral challenges, or developmental disabilities. * Group Rate Life and Disability Insurance. **Benefits Offered Temporary/Contractors:** * Eligible for the relevant benefit programs offered through our partner agencies. This email and phone number will only reply to accommodation requests and is not intended for general employment inquiries. jobs.title: Civil/ Environmental Engineer
jobs.description: Landau Associates is recognized for excellence in the environmental consulting industry. With nine offices in the Pacific Northwest and Gulf Coast, we have demonstrated that our focus on collaboration, responsiveness, and quality results in client satisfaction and long\-term relationships. As employees, we own the Company, and our ownership culture promotes individual accountability to our clients, each other, and our community. We are seeking a Civil/Environmental Engineering Project Manager to support our existing Permitting and Design practice area, including industrial stormwater and wastewater permit compliance support and treatment system design. This role offers a flexible hybrid work schedule in any one of the following office locations: **Seattle, Washington or Portland, Oregon**. **Key Responsibilities Include:** * Leading design and construction engineering tasks involving: * + Preparing written engineering reports to support facility construction and permitting. + Implementing the engineering requirements of environmental permits, including preparing and certifying permit applications, designing corrective actions, and certifying construction completion. + Designing site environmental infrastructure including utilities, drainage, industrial stormwater and wastewater treatment, landfill and other environmental barriers, and monitoring systems. + Preparing civil engineering plans and specifications to support environmental permitting, in coordination with other professional engineers. + Guiding construction observation and responding to contractor RFIs and change orders. * Managing key aspects of project delivery, including proposals, contracts, budgets, invoicing, and change management. * Coordinating with project teams, clients, and regulatory agencies and providing project administration support as needed. * Building and maintaining strong client relationships while identifying opportunities to support existing and prospective clients. * Training and mentoring junior staff to support these engineering tasks. **This position is available for the candidate who has:** * Bachelor's degree in civil, environmental, or chemical engineering. * 5 to 10\+ years of consulting experience in major job duties listed above. * Minimum 3\-5 years’ experience using Autodesk Civil 3D or similar software for engineering design. * PE license, or ability to obtain registration in WA and/or OR within 6 months of hire. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in a collaborative project\-team environment, interchangeably supporting co\-workers and engaging co\-workers’ support to meet the specific needs of a wide range of projects. Landau Associates is committed to quality, collaboration, and responsiveness, and seeks candidates who share the same values. Landau Associates offers an excellent compensation and benefits package in an environment that promotes personal growth and professional advancement. The salary range for this position is $105,500 – $140,000\. Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including education, experience, performance, location, and internal equity. As part of our compensation program, we review and update our salary ranges at least annually. We provide a wide variety of benefits to support our employees and their families. Details can be found on the Careers page of our website. Qualified applicants please visit our Careers page at http://www.landauinc.com/careers/ to apply online. Landau Associates is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Site Development Coordinator
jobs.description: **About the Role** Lars Andersen \& Associates is seeking an organized, proactive Site Development Coordinator to guide commercial development projects from preliminary site review and due diligence through entitlement approval and design\-team handoff. This person will serve as the central point of coordination among the client, internal team, governmental agencies, and specialty consultants, keeping decisions, deliverables, risks, and deadlines moving across multiple projects. **Key Responsibilities** * Coordinate preliminary site feasibility and due diligence, including zoning and land\-use requirements, site access and circulation, utilities, drainage, floodplain and environmental constraints, title and survey matters, easements, development standards, and agency approval pathways. * Develop and maintain a project\-specific tracking schedule. Update it weekly to identify each task, responsible party, deadline, dependency, current status, critical\-path concern, and required client decision. * Lead multidisciplinary coordination with environmental and geotechnical consultants, traffic engineers, civil and structural engineers, surveyors, architects, landscape architects, electrical and utility consultants, fire and life\-safety consultants, and other specialists required by the jurisdiction or site. * Organize and conduct consultant and client meetings; prepare focused agendas, document decisions and action items, distribute meeting summaries, and follow through until assigned items are completed. * Research and confirm entitlement, permitting, public\-notice, and submittal requirements; coordinate pre\-application meetings and agency reviews; maintain complete records of correspondence, comments, approvals, and commitments. * Prepare and coordinate applications and supporting materials for site plan review, variances, conditional or special use permits, planned unit developments, rezoning, platting, design review, and other location\-specific approvals. * Attend governmental staff meetings, neighborhood meetings, planning commission and governing\-body hearings, and other public proceedings as required; coordinate presentation materials and consultant testimony. Travel is Required. * Review consultant scopes, proposals, schedules, and deliverables for completeness and alignment with project objectives; identify gaps, conflicts, long\-lead approvals, and emerging risks early and recommend practical next steps. * Provide concise ongoing project summaries and conduct twice\-monthly client status meetings covering progress, decisions, agency and consultant dependencies, upcoming deadlines, budget or scope concerns, and recovery plans for delayed items. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, urban planning, architecture, construction management, real estate development, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. * Three or more years of commercial site development, due diligence, entitlement, civil engineering, planning, architecture, or development project coordination experience preferred. * Working knowledge of zoning, entitlements, site plans, plats, surveys, easements, utilities, access, drainage, and multidisciplinary design coordination; ability to read and interpret technical plans and agency comments. * Strong scheduling, organization, follow\-up, meeting facilitation, writing, and client\-service skills, with the judgment to manage multiple active projects and elevate risks promptly. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project\-tracking or scheduling software; willingness to travel for site visits, agency meetings, client meetings, and public hearings. Professional licensure is not required. **What We Offer** Competitive compensation and comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life\-insurance benefits; direct involvement in high\-impact commercial development projects; and a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth. Location: 101 and Olive Compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and skill level Benefits: * Dental insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: System Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** Join a team that is helping modernize the future of air traffic management while supporting one of the nation's most critical transportation missions. Leidos is seeking a Systems Integration Engineer to join the Terminal Flight Data Manager (TFDM) program supporting the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). In this role, you will be responsible for integrating, validating, and deploying mission\-critical capabilities that improve the safety, efficiency, and reliability of the National Airspace System (NAS). TFDM is the FAA's NextGen surface management solution that enhances airport surface and terminal airspace operations through an integrated traffic control and management system. As part of this team, you'll collaborate with software engineers, system engineers, and FAA stakeholders to deliver capabilities that directly support air traffic controllers and airport operations across the country. This position offers more than a traditional integration and test role. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with FAA customers during system deployments, formal test events, and customer acceptance activities at airports nationwide. You'll see your work transition from the lab into live operational environments while helping deliver technology that supports one of the world's most complex aviation systems. Location: This position is based in our **Egg Harbor, NJ** office with a hybrid schedule of three days per week in the office and two days working remotely. Travel: Up to 50% travel is required and is a key part of this role. You'll travel to FAA airport locations throughout the United States to support system integration, customer demonstrations, formal testing, and operational deployments. Working alongside FAA personnel in live airport environments provides a unique opportunity to gain firsthand operational experience, build strong customer relationships, and see the direct impact of your work as TFDM is deployed across the National Airspace System. Travel is typically one to two weeks per trip. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Primary Responsibilities As a member of a highly collaborative engineering team, you will: * Integrate, configure, and validate TFDM capabilities within both physical and virtual integration laboratories. * Execute system integration, verification, and validation activities to ensure the system is properly configured and operating within the National Airspace System. * Support formal customer demonstrations, verification events, and customer acceptance testing with FAA stakeholders. * Collaborate with software, systems engineering, networking, and infrastructure teams to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex system\-level issues. * Analyze integration and test results, identify root causes, and provide detailed technical documentation supporting issue resolution. * Support deployment and integration activities at FAA operational facilities, including Air Traffic Control Towers (ATCTs). * Execute system interface testing and validate communications across internal and external NAS interfaces. * Coordinate integration activities with FAA personnel and cross\-functional Leidos engineering teams. * Develop automated tools, scripts, and AI\-assisted solutions that improve testing efficiency, reduce manual effort, and streamline repetitive tasks. * Support remote deployment activities by coordinating with infrastructure, networking, and installation teams. * Learn and maintain a deep understanding of TFDM architecture, system functionality, interfaces, and operational workflows. * Partner with Systems Engineering to develop integration and test strategies for new capabilities and system enhancements. * Integrate services with databases, messaging systems, and external APIs. * Troubleshoot XML messaging, JMS queue jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***\*PLEASE NOTE: this position is located in Denver, CO or Seattle, WA and requires attendance in office up to three days a week.\**** ***Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates ("LendingTree") will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future.*** #### **The Opportunity** LendingTree is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Insurance technology team and help build, enhance, and support web applications used by our customers and internal teams. You will contribute to new capabilities while also making thoughtful improvements within existing and greenfield codebases, including applications that integrate with third\-party services and databases. You will partner with teammates and the business to understand requirements, solve technical problems, and deliver reliable, maintainable software. Our team primarily works in C\#/.NET and modern web technologies, but we are open to engineers from other technical backgrounds who bring strong software engineering fundamentals, are eager to learn, and can ramp quickly. #### **How You'll Make an Impact** * Develop and enhance scalable, maintainable web applications that support LendingTree's Insurance business, including solutions that integrate with third\-party web services, databases, and user\-facing interfaces. * Support existing applications through troubleshooting, bug fixes, required upgrades, performance improvements, and changes to existing functionality. * Break down business and technical problems and contribute to solutions that are reliable, practical, and maintainable over time. * Translate business requirements and acceptance criteria into well\-designed technical solutions, and demonstrate completed features against agreed\-upon outcomes. * Contribute to strong engineering practices through code reviews, testing, documentation, design discussions, and continuous improvement of the development process. * Collaborate with teammates and business partners on shared initiatives, communicating technical ideas, questions, and tradeoffs clearly. #### **Who You'll Work With** You will be part of the technology team supporting LendingTree's Insurance business, working closely with other engineers and business partners to build and enhance applications that support our customers and internal teams. This is a collaborative environment where engineers are encouraged to understand the business context behind the work, ask questions, share ideas, participate in code review and technical discussions, and learn from one another while delivering high\-quality software. #### **What You'll Bring** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting web applications. * Experience with a modern object\-oriented programming language and web development framework. Our team primarily uses C\# and .NET/ASP.NET, but experience with comparable technologies is welcome if you have strong fundamentals and can ramp quickly. * Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and modern front\-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue, or demonstrated ability to learn new frameworks quickly. * Experience building business applications using relational databases such as SQL Server and familiarity with database design and data access patterns; exposure to NoSQL databases is helpful. * Experience building and integrating with service\-oriented and event\-driven systems, including APIs and third\-party integrations. * Understanding of software engineering best practices, including maintainable design, SOLID principles, design patterns, code review, and unit testing. * Experience working in an Agile development environment and delivering work against defined requirements and acceptance criteria. * Exposure to AI technologies and tools, with an understanding of how AI can be applied to support technical processes, workflows, and business outcomes. * Ability to understand business logic and project requirements and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical partners. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. #### **What Will Help You Thrive** * You are curious and willing to learn new languages, frameworks, technologies, and business domains rather than being tied to one specific stack. * You are comfortable working in an established codebase and can make thoughtful changes while balancing quality, maintainability, and risk. * You care about code quality and view code review and feedback as tools for learning, improving the product, and making the team stronger. * You enjoy collaborating with other developers, sharing what you know, asking questions, and learning from others. * You are willing to question assumptions constructively and voice your point of view when you see an opportunity to improve the work. * Exposure to cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP is helpful. Azure experience, including provisioning, monitoring, performance management, or Application Insights, is a plus. * Knowledge of current web development practices using HTML5, CSS, and TypeScript is helpful. #### **What Success Looks Like** * You build a strong understanding of the Insurance applications, integrations, and business processes you support and become a dependable contributor to the team. * You become productive in the team's technology stack, applying your existing engineering fundamentals while learning unfamiliar tools or frameworks as needed. * New features and enhancements are delivered against clear requirements and acceptance criteria with maintainability, reliability, and testability in mind. * Existing applications are supported and improved through thoughtful fixes, upgrades, and engineering improvements. * Business partners and teammates can rely on you to communicate clearly, ask the right questions, and collaborate effectively on shared work. * You contribute to a strong engineering environment through quality code, constructive code review, documentation, and continuous learning. **Life at LendingTree** We're a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that's curious, creative, and always ready to roll up our sleeves and get things done. You'll work alongside smart, driven people who care about doing great work — and about helping each other succeed. We believe the best ideas come from different perspectives, and we're committed to creating a workplace where people feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to make an impact. You'll have the trust and flexibility to do your best work, the opportunity to take ownership and try new things, and teammates who genuinely enjoy working together. And while we work hard, we don't take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate wins, recognize great work (our GSD — Get Stuff Done — Award is a fan favorite), and make time to have some fun along the way. Come grow with us, make an impact, and help us build what's next. **What We Offer** We want you to feel supported at work and beyond. Our benefits and programs are designed to help you stay healthy, recharge, plan for the future, and bring your best to whatever matters most to you. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) matching * Generous time off * Wellness programs and resources * Annual performance bonus eligibility **The Details** **Base Pay:** $100,000\-130,000 The base pay offered may vary based on internal factors, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. **Incentive Compensation:** This position is eligible for an annual performance bonus. **Work Authorization:** This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. Please do not apply for this role if you will need employer sponsorship now or in the future to begin or continue employment. **Everyone Belongs Here** LendingTree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion (or creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an application, please email us at humanresources@lendingtree.com. Qualified candidates must be able to perform the essential functions of this position satisfactorily with or without a reasonable accommodation. This job post is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all essential responsibilities, skills, tasks, or requirements associated with this position. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the position posted, LendingTree reserves the right to modify or change the essential functions of the job based on business necessity. CCPA Disclosure

jobs.description: **We are Lennar** Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States. **A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future** We are seeking a talented Lead Software Engineer to join our team. This role involves designing, developing, testing, and deploying software applications. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. **Your Responsibilities on the Team** * Collaborate with project stakeholders (product owners, UX researchers, data team, QA team, project managers, cross team leads and designers) to understand functional and non\-functional requirements. * Promote a collaborative team environment and work closely with colleagues to achieve business objectives. * Responsible for planning work estimation and forecasting. * Adhere to architecture, design, implementation, security standards and best practices. * Investigate and propose solutions to development and design problems. * Conduct analysis to determine integration needs, and design and plan integrations. * Prepare technical documentation, including software design evaluation plans and test results. * Write high\-quality code that satisfies customer needs and strives for simplicity, clarity, and testability. * Implement unit and integration tests and conduct functional and performance testing where appropriate. * Participate in code reviews or use collaborative programming techniques to promote high quality business outcomes. * Develop reusable software building blocks to enable faster delivery. * Improve performance of existing software by diagnosing and resolving critical issues. * Establish development practices and processes. * Manage and mentor software engineers Lead full\-stack delivery across Python and FastAPI backend services and TypeScript and React frontend applications, including AWS infrastructure deployed via Terraform and GitHub Actions. * Direct AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude, or similar) to accelerate development while owning code quality and review standards. **Your Toolbox** * Master’s degree in computer science and worked at a company for 5\+ years with web technology stack and web standards. OR * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer information systems or equivalent degree and worked at a company for 7\+ years with web technology stack and web standards * Growth mindset and a willingness to learn new skills, technologies, and frameworks. * Excellent problem solving and analytical skills. * Proven track record for managing a team of developers to achieve company goals. * Proven track record for architecting, scaling and implementing complex technical solutions. * Proven track record of leadership in Agile environments, with excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a passion for mentoring and empowering team members. * Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical information in a condensed manner to various stakeholders verbally and in writing. * Strong expertise in JavaScript (7\+ years) with deep understanding of advanced principles of client\-side and server\-side development. * High proficiency in React.js (5\+ years), with a solid background in building performant UI components with modern hooks and design patterns. * Strong command of semantic HTML and modern CSS, including CSS\-in\-JS with a focus on accessibility, SEO, and responsive design principles. * Proficiency in Next.js, TypeScript, and GraphQL, demonstrating the ability to architect and implement robust front\-end solutions. * Knowledge in building and tooling processes such as CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and package managers, coupled with extensive experience in debugging and troubleshooting complex issues. * Demonstrated use of AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude, or similar) in daily development with strong judgment on when to trust, verify, or override their output and ownership of code quality. * Track record of setting and enforcing a CI quality gate across multiple repositories (typecheck, lint, format, test, build) and working in issue\-driven GitHub workflows. Preferred * Headless CMS (Content Management System) * E\-commerce * A/B testing * Backend development * High\-traffic websites * Content Delivery Network * Cloud platforms * 3rd\-party integrations (frontend) * Data analytics **Physical \& Office/Site Presence Requirements:** **This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.** This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Associates. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.** **Life at Lennar** At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well\-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits. Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview \| LinkedIn\< https://www.linkedin.com/company/lennar/ \> for the latest job opportunities. **Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Frontend
jobs.description: **LUZID** **Software Engineer, Frontend** San Francisco, in\-person 4x/week **About Luzid** Luzid is building the operating system for SAP delivery — the infrastructure layer underneath the most complex and expensive IT projects companies run. SAP implementations move billions of dollars and thousands of consultants, but the knowledge generated in these projects is never captured: it lives in people's heads, disappears when the project ends, and gets rebuilt from scratch on every new engagement. Luzid solves this with an agentic orchestration platform that coordinates every phase of SAP transformation, capturing decisions, tests, and context as a byproduct of work already underway — building an organizational memory that accumulates across projects instead of resetting. We're a team based in San Francisco and São Paulo, moving fast and already deployed with some of the largest SAP integrators in the world, including delaware Consulting, KPMG, and NTT Data. We have reached \>$3M ARR in 11 months and raised $21M in funding. The team comes from Stanford, Meta, Two Sigma, Microsoft, and NASA. **The Opportunity** You'll build the interfaces consultants and enterprise teams use to navigate complex implementations and work with AI agents. These workflows involve substantial information, interconnected decisions, and work that unfolds over time. Your job is to make that complexity understandable and manageable through thoughtful, responsive software. You'll work closely with design and other engineers, and talk directly to customers to understand where they're encountering friction. You'll help shape what we build, prototype alternatives, ship improvements, and follow through on how they perform in production. Your primary focus will be the frontend: both the experiences users interact with and the foundations that help our team build them well. You'll have room to make consequential technical decisions and the responsibility to keep them practical — using AI\-assisted development tools to explore and iterate, while applying your own judgment to the quality and simplicity of what we ship. **What You'll Do** * **Own product outcomes.** Take ambiguous problems from customer conversations through implementation, deployment, and iteration. * **Build the core interfaces.** Ship the experiences consultants and enterprise teams use to navigate complex implementations and work with AI agents. * **Reason from UX back into implementation.** Decide which interactions need to feel instantaneous, how state and data should flow, and when a problem calls for a better component, a different loading strategy, or a change to an API. * **Design for real usage.** Think through loading, empty, error, and recovery states; collaborate closely with design; treat accessibility as part of a complete experience. * **Build durable foundations.** Recognize reusable interaction patterns, design clear component APIs, and use composition and shared primitives to keep the product consistent as it grows. * **Make the product feel fast.** Reason about rendering, network requests, caching, prefetching, and feedback during longer operations — and measure whether changes actually help. * **Work across boundaries.** Reason about APIs, data models, and backend behavior when they affect the frontend, and make pragmatic build\-vs\-use calls. * **Raise the team's bar.** Work independently, communicate decisions clearly, and improve the experience of engineers building alongside you — including how the team uses AI\-assisted workflows. **What We're Looking For** * **Deep frontend fundamentals.** You've shipped and maintained complex interactive applications, and understand JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS, browser behavior, rendering, state management, and asynchronous data flow. * **Strong UX judgment.** You think in terms of how people will actually use a feature, not just whether it works. * **Evidence\-driven.** You combine customer feedback with analytics, performance monitoring, and session replay to identify friction and evaluate the impact of changes. * **Ownership.** You ask questions, challenge assumptions, and care whether what you shipped actually helped, not just whether it shipped. * **Pragmatism.** You know when to use an existing library, when custom implementation is worthwhile, and how to balance immediate delivery with longer\-term maintainability. * **Curiosity and judgment.** Above all, you understand problems deeply, explore possible solutions, and make thoughtful trade\-offs between user experience, engineering quality, speed, and complexity. **Nice to have** * Experience building interfaces for AI\-powered products, including workflows where users review, guide, or approve agent actions. * Experience evolving a component library or design system while continuing to ship product features. * Experience on a small team where you helped shape product and design decisions alongside engineering. * Familiarity with complex enterprise workflows or ecosystems such as SAP, Salesforce, ERP, or CRM. **Why Join Luzid Now** * Shape the interfaces for a product with proven traction inside the largest SAP integrators in the world — delaware Consulting, KPMG, and NTT Data — in Experience managing projects from planning and design through permitting and construction. Strong knowledge of applicable Texas, municipal, state, and federal engineering standards and permitting requirements. jobs.title: Maintenance Tech II
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Under minimal supervision, set up, adjust, perform preventative maintenance, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain assigned equipment with responsibility for production and quality. **Job Description** **MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Perform preventive maintenance, routine inspections, and ad\-hoc repairs on assigned conveyors, automation, robotics and ancillary equipment as needed. * Perform routine troubleshooting of assigned out of service equipment and correct issues, act as an escalation point for lower level technicians, and escalate to leadership and/or more senior technicians as needed. Record all maintenance issues in maintenance log for each line. * Document all work in the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) and ticketing systems as appropriate and maintain accurate records of all operating logs for fire pumps, generators, HVAC equipment, and other facility systems that are tested on a routine basis. * Mentor all maintenance personnel in developing appropriate skillsets and knowledge of equipment. * Assist maintenance mechanics in work that requires two people or when operational needs demand. * Perform facility/building project work as assigned. Tasks include, but are not limited to, light bulb/ballast replacement, door repairs, furniture installation, ceiling tile replacement, carpentry duties, plumbing repairs and maintaining operation logs. * Assemble and test equipment to verify correct operation and production. Analyze and record cause of roduction delays on daily production reports and initiate procedures to solve equipment malfunctions. Examine defects and analyze spoilage causes and, where possible, take corrective action and verify the corrective action has eliminated the problems. * Ability to certify on all industrial lift equipment. Pickers, Reaches, Skates, Booms, Scissor lifts, etc. * Oversee projects as assigned. Projects will include minor space renovations, inventory management, contractor oversight, and building efficiency improvements. Oversee, inspect, and monitor the routine maintenance provided by junior engineers. Will also provide guidance and training as needed. * **MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:** **Education:** * High school diploma or equivalent **Certification / Licensure:** * None **Work Experience:** * 5 year of experience with a forklift, conveyor and general equipment repair and maintenance * Experience troubleshooting complex equipment. **Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:** None * **PREFERRED JOB REQUIREMENTS:** **Education:** * Associates Degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering Technology, HVAC, orequivalent. **Certification / Licensure:** * Graduate of an apprenticeship program or hold current trade certification. **Work Experience:** * None **Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:** * Fundamental understanding of machinery/equipment * Basic skill level in multiple computer software packages including Microsoft Excel * Experience working with inputs, outputs, and PLC logic systems and ability to troubleshoot these systems * Willing to travel at least/up to 10% of the time for business purposes (within state and out of state). * Must be willing to learn new equipment as it is brought on\-line. * Physical activities necessary to perform one or more essential functions of the position. * Ability to bend, twist, reach, push, lift for extended periods daily * Frequently move, lift, carry supplies/equipment up to 50 lbs and may have to occasionally lift up to 75 lbs * Must be able to stand for minimum of 8 hours and up to 12 hours for up to 6 days a week * Ability to continuously ascend and descend from ladders and stairs, work at heights and/or from a ladder, work from a lying down position, work with your hands above your head. * Willing to operate material handling equipment (i.e. fork truck). * Write documents and reports using writing instruments and computers * Read information, often in small print (drawings) * Follow appropriate safety procedures such as Lock Out/Tag Out, Arc Flash, etc. and use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) while maintaining equipment, and ensure a safe work environment by eliminating potential equipment safety hazards * Ability to work overtime and must be available for on\-call requests jobs.title: ASIC Engineer, Power
jobs.description: Meta is building custom silicon to power the infrastructure that underlies its family of products and services. As an ASIC Engineer specializing in power on the EDA Infrastructure team, you will develop and maintain power analysis and optimization flows that enable silicon engineers across the organization to accurately model, estimate, and reduce power consumption in custom ASIC designs. In this role, you will work at the intersection of EDA tooling, physical design, and power methodology, helping to define the infrastructure that shapes how Meta's next\-generation chips are designed and verified. ### **ASIC Engineer, Power Responsibilities:** * Develop and maintain power analysis flows including dynamic and static power estimation, vectorless analysis, and power intent verification using industry\-standard EDA tools * Define and implement power methodology guidelines for RTL, synthesis, and physical design stages of the ASIC development flow * Collaborate with RTL design, physical design, and verification teams to identify and resolve power hotspots and inefficiencies across custom ASIC designs * Build and optimize EDA infrastructure scripts and automation frameworks to improve power signoff accuracy and turnaround time * Evaluate and integrate commercial and internally developed EDA tools into the power analysis flow, providing technical assessments and recommendations * Develop power intent specifications using UPF or CPF and ensure consistent application across design and implementation stages * Establish power budgets and track power metrics across design milestones, communicating results and risks to cross\-functional stakeholders * Drive continuous improvement of power closure methodologies by analyzing results across multiple tape\-outs and identifying systemic opportunities * Provide technical guidance to other engineers on power analysis best practices, flow usage, and debug techniques * Partner with EDA tool vendors to evaluate new capabilities and influence tool roadmaps to meet Meta silicon design requirements ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * 6\+ years of experience in ASIC design or physical design with a focus on power analysis, power optimization, or power signoff * Experience developing or maintaining EDA flows for power analysis using tools such as Synopsys PrimePower, Cadence Voltus, or equivalent * Experience with power intent specification languages such as UPF or CPF and their application across RTL\-to\-GDSII flows * Experience scripting in Python, Tcl, or shell to build and automate EDA infrastructure workflows * Experience collaborating across RTL design, physical design, and verification disciplines to drive power closure on complex ASIC designs ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience evaluating and qualifying new EDA tools or methodologies in a production silicon environment * Familiarity with custom or semi\-custom design flows for high\-performance computing or data center silicon * Experience with low\-power design techniques including clock gating, power gating, multi\-voltage domain design, and dynamic voltage and frequency scaling * Background in developing internal EDA infrastructure tooling or flow automation at scale across multiple concurrent design projects ### **About Meta:** Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics. Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-ext@meta.com. $114,000/year to $172,000/year \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. jobs.title: Network Engineer, Foundation & Support
jobs.description: Meta is seeking a Network Engineer to join the Site Services Foundation team, supporting the design, deployment, and operational readiness of enterprise network infrastructure across Meta's global data center and campus environments. In this role, you will work at the intersection of network engineering and site services, collaborating with cross\-functional partners in facilities, site operations, hardware engineering, and infrastructure teams to ensure that network technologies are deployed reliably and managed at scale. You will contribute to new product introduction workflows, operational documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives that enable Meta's network infrastructure to evolve alongside the demands of AI, compute, and connectivity at a global scale. ### **Network Engineer, Foundation \& Support Responsibilities:** * Drive initiatives to enhance efficiency through tooling improvements in the pre\-deployment domain for Backbone, Edge, and Optical * Collaborate with internal and cross\-functional partner teams to define and automate optimal workflows for network pre\-deployment activities * Automation and integration into existing tooling ecosystem which involves planning and pre\-deployment activities (such as design bootstrapping, engineering design package generation, bill of materials (BOM) creation etc) * Proactively find gaps that impact multiple teams/orgs, come up with the execution plan, drive the project, and influence other teams to implement initiatives * Work with partner teams, understand their challenges, help them find a solution natively or lead effort working with cross functional teams to deliver systems/platforms/tooling * Work with developers and program managers to design and prioritize tooling enhancements and fixes * Help with roadmapping to identify and address key challenges * Help with recruiting and onboarding of new members to the team. Help them by mentoring and ensuring their quick ramp\-up within our environment * Perform detailed troubleshooting and engage with cross\-functional teams to fix system/tooling issues * Drive requirements with cross\-functional teams to align tooling development efforts * Help make the people around you move faster by identifying issues that are slowing the team down and driving changes to
