jobs.title: Sr Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** Under limited direction, responsible for design and implementation of core technologies associated with the organizations data analysis and analytics technical infrastructure. As a core member of a high\-performance team, ensure data pipelines are consistently and reliably maintained and analytics capabilities are delivered at an optimum level, helping the organization identify insights from a large number of diverse datasets. This position reports to the Director, Enterprise Data Integration and Solution Architecture. **Principal Responsibilities and Tasks** The following statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. These are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all job duties performed by personnel so classified. Ensure analytics infrastructure and associated systems meet business requirements and industry best practices. Gather and process raw data from multiple disparate sources (including writing scripts, calling APIs, write SQL queries, etc.) into a form suitable for analysis. Gathers, analyzes, documents and translates application requirements into data models. Builds data models. Enables big data, batch and real\-time analytical processing solutions leveraging emerging technologies. Researches and proposes opportunities for data acquisition and new uses for existing data. Codes, tests, and documents new or modified data systems to create robust and scalable applications for analytics. Translates complex functional and technical requirements into detailed architecture, design and high performance software. Builds and architects next\-generation Big Data analytics framework Expands and grows data platform capabilities to solve new data problems and challenges. Creates data flow diagrams for business systems. Builds automation tools; ensures all automated processes preserve data by managing the alignment of data availability and integration processes. Performs technology and product research to better define requirements, resolve important issues and improve the overall capability of the technology stack. Contributes to the design and direction of enterprise\-wide data architecture as well as design documentation deliverables. Supports standardization of documentation and the adoption of standards and practices related to data and applications. Develops Relational Data Models, Dimensional Data Models, Data Dictionary and Metadata. Develop data set processes for data mining and production. Working both independently and in collaboration with our data integration developers, data scientists, designs and builds high\-performance algorithms, prototypes, predictive models and proof of concepts. Works closely with our developer team to integrate innovative algorithms into our production systems. Supports business decisions with ad hoc analysis as needed. Assesses and provides recommendations on business relevance, appropriate timing and deployment. **Work Experience** **Education and Experience** Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Systems, Engineering, Physical Sciences, Life Sciences or closely related field or equivalent related professional experience is required. Additional certifications are preferred. Seven or more (7\+) years’ experience designing, implementing and supporting systems in a large scale analytics or data engineering environment containing many disparate application systems and multiple data sources. Strong knowledge in programming or scripting languages (e.g., C/C\+\+, Python, Ruby). Experience with agile or other rapid application development methods. Experience with object\-oriented design, coding and testing patterns as well as experience in engineering software platforms and large\-scale data infrastructures. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** Knowledge of data analysis, end user requirements analysis, and business requirements analysis to develop a clear understanding of the business needs and to incorporate these needs into technical solutions. Strong knowledge of and experience with statistics or advanced mathematics. Significant knowledge of data modeling and understanding of different data structures and their benefits and limitations under particular use cases. Working knowledge of relational, document oriented or object oriented databases, such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Cache, SQL, MongoDB. Deep knowledge in data mining, machine learning or natural language processing. Strong programming experience to clean and scrub noisy datasets; Experience building algorithms. Experience with Hortonworks or the Hadoop ecosystem in general, including HDSF and such tools as Spark, MapReduce, Pig and Hive. Experience with Ranger / Atlas and /or Falcon. Experience with various messaging systems, such as ActiveMQ or RabbitMQ. Experience with Big Data machine learning toolkits, such as Mahout, SparkML or TensorFlow. Must work well in a high\-performance team environment. Capability to architect highly scalable distributed systems using non\-proprietary tools. Expert knowledge of data modeling and understanding of different data structures and their benefits and limitations under particular use cases. **Patient Safety** Ensures patient safety in the performance of job functions and through participation in hospital, department or unit patient safety initiatives. Takes action to correct observed risks to patient safety Reports adverse events and near misses to appropriate management authority. Identifies possible risks in processes, procedures, devices and communicates the same to those in charge. **Benefits** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Compensation: * Pay Range: $57\.87 \- $92\.40 * Other Compensation (if applicable): * Review the 2025\-2026 UMMS Benefits Guide

jobs.title: Research Associate II
jobs.description: **Current Employees:** If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet . The Cooperative Institute for Marine and Atmospheric Studies (CIMAS) of the University of Miami invites applications for a Research Associate II position in support of the Physical Oceanography Division (PhOD) at the Atlantic Oceanographic and Meteorological Laboratory (AOML). The position is concerned with observational studies designed to improve our understanding of interannual to multidecadal ocean variability and its influence on climate. The position will involve close collaboration with scientists, engineers, and technicians at Rosenstiel School and AOML. The position will provide direct, hands\-on technical support by troubleshooting, repairing, and assembling electromechanical systems and electronics, particularly while preparing for and executing field campaigns. This role involves general electronics and mechanical maintenance, basic fabrication, and executing the physical staging of equipment. The incumbent will be responsible for supporting operational logistics for maritime deployments. A critical responsibility of this role includes collecting observational data during long\-duration international research cruises. This position also requires flexibility to occasionally support operations during unusual schedules as needed. The applicant must have a bachelor’s degree or higher in a technical field and 2 years of related experience, along with demonstrated experience in the following qualifications: Electromechanical assembly \& Maintenance General technical skills for repairing, troubleshooting, and assembling electromechanical systems and electronics. Skillful in using a variety of tools and fabrication devices such as drills, saws, and other hand and power tools to create and modify field hardware. Software, Electronics Assembly \& Troubleshooting Basic knowledge or experience with general electronics and software troubleshooting utilizing standard bench instruments like multimeters, power supplies, etc., alongside practical assembly skills such as soldering and wiring. General computer proficiency across Windows and Linux environments, familiarity with programming languages and basic software development. Field Operations, Logistics \& Data Collection Willingness to travel and conduct fieldwork both on land and at sea. Support loading, unloading, and setting up equipment platforms on both research and merchant vessels. Required to support project logistics, including driving pickup and box trucks to and from ports to transport equipment. A valid Florida driver's license is required. Capable of collecting high\-quality scientific data aboard merchant and research vessels on deployments that can last up to 60 continuous days. Preferred Qualifications (not required) Previous knowledge and experience with oceanographic instrumentation including CTD (Conductivity\-Temperature\-Depth), moorings, autonomous underwater vehicles, etc. Experience with 3D printers. Previous experience in SCUBA diving. Basic proficiency in Spanish. The applicant must be willing and physically able to spend up to 120 cumulative days per year at sea on oceanographic research vessels and merchant ships assisting in collecting scientific data. Most cruises will range from 1\-14 days, but cruises of up to 60 continuous days will be required. Such work requires a degree of physical mobility, and the incumbent must be able to lift and move items of up to 60 lbs. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. The University of Miami is recognized as one of the nation’s premier research institutions and academic health systems and is among the largest employers in South Florida. With more than 20,000 faculty and staff, the University is committed to excellence and guided by a mission to positively impact the lives of students, patients, and communities locally and globally. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where every individual feels valued and empowered to contribute meaningfully. United by shared values, the University community works together to build an environment defined by purpose, collaboration, and service. The University of Miami is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are protected from discrimination based on certain categories protected by Federal law. Click here for additional information. **Job Status:** Full time **Employee Type:** Staff

jobs.title: Health AI Engineer
jobs.description: Required Qualifications: * B.A/B.S. in Biomedical/Health Informatics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative or technical discipline plus at least five years of relevant experience or a combination of education and relevant work experience to equal at least nine years * Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, software engineering principles, and computational methods. * Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java; experience with SQL and familiarity with C/C\+\+ or other programming languages. Candidates should be able to demonstrate programming proficiency through prior projects or sample code. * Understanding of healthcare data, biomedical data, and common health AI and informatics applications. * Experience developing, implementing, testing, and evaluating data science, machine learning, or AI solutions. * Ability to work independently, manage assigned research and engineering tasks, and adapt to a rapidly evolving scientific and technical environment. Preferred Qualifications: * Research or applied experience in health data science, biomedical informatics, artificial intelligence, and real\-world health data analytics. * Experience working with electronic health record (EHR) data, clinical text, or other large\-scale biomedical datasets. * Knowledge of medical terminologies and ontologies, such as UMLS, SNOMED CT, ICD, RxNorm, or related standards. * Experience with natural language processing, large language models (LLMs), generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and/or agentic AI systems. * Experience evaluating AI systems, including model performance, robustness, generalizability, and reliability in healthcare applications. * Experience contributing to scientific publications, conference presentations, technical reports, or research proposals. * Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams of faculty, clinicians, research scientists, engineers, students, and other research professionals. Duties/Responsibilities: Health AI Research and Engineering – 50% * Design, implement, test, and evaluate AI, machine learning, NLP, generative AI, and data science methods for healthcare and biomedical research projects. * Conduct computational experiments using EHR data, clinical text, and other structured and unstructured biomedical datasets. * Develop reproducible research pipelines, software tools, and AI systems to support research studies and translation of research methods into usable solutions. Research Development and Evaluation – 25% * Contribute to new research projects through literature reviews, study design, data preparation, experimental design, and selection of appropriate analytical and AI methods. * Evaluate AI systems using appropriate quantitative and qualitative methods, including assessment of accuracy, robustness, generalizability, reliability, and potential limitations. * Analyze experimental results, troubleshoot technical issues, and recommend methodological or engineering improvements. Scientific Communication and Collaboration – 15% * Summarize research findings and contribute to manuscripts, technical reports, presentations, posters, grant proposals, and other scientific products. * Communicate analytical and technical results to faculty investigators, clinicians, research scientists, engineers, students, sponsors, and other collaborators. * Work collaboratively within multidisciplinary research teams while independently managing assigned projects and deliverables. Project and Technical Responsibilities – 10% * Work under general supervision with substantial latitude to determine appropriate technical approaches, prioritize assigned activities, and make decisions within areas of responsibility. * Maintain high\-quality research code, documentation, data analysis workflows, and experimental records to support reproducibility and collaboration. * Stay current with emerging developments in health AI, generative AI, agentic systems, biomedical informatics, and related technologies, and assess their potential application to ongoing research. About the Department and Program The Division of Computational Health Science (CHS, https://med.umn.edu/surgery/divisions/computational\-health\-sciences) at the University of Minnesota is seeking master’s level data scientist to join a multidisciplinary team conducting research in health data science, artificial intelligence, and biomedical informatics. The position is an annually renewable professional academic appointment. CHS develops and applies innovative data science and AI methods to analyze complex biomedical and healthcare data, with the goal of advancing biomedical research, clinical care, and learning health systems. The Natural Language Processing / Information Extraction (NLP/IE) Program (https://healthinformatics.umn.edu/natural\-language\-processing) brings together faculty investigators, research scientists, engineers, postdoctoral researchers, programmers, and students to develop and evaluate NLP and AI methods for a broad range of clinical and biomedical applications. Current and emerging areas include clinical NLP, large language models, generative AI, agentic AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, real\-world data analytics, and trustworthy health AI. Applications must be submitted online. To be considered for this position, please click the Apply button and follow the instructions. You will be given the opportunity to complete an online application for the position and attach a cover letter and resume. Additional documents may be attached after application by accessing your "My Job Applications" page and uploading documents in the "My Cover Letters and Attachments" section. To request an accommodation during the application process, please e\-mail jobcentr@umn.edu. The University recognizes and values the importance of diversity and inclusion in enriching the employment experience of its employees and in supporting the academic mission. The University is committed to attracting and retaining employees with varying identities and backgrounds. The University of Minnesota provides equal access to and opportunity in its programs, facilities, and employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, gender, age, marital status, disability, public assistance status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. To learn more about diversity at the U: http://diversity.umn.edu Any offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. jobs.title: Distinguished AI and Data Security Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you'll be doing:** Verizon’s Exposure and Vulnerability Management (EVM) Engineering and Reporting team is seeking a Sr. AI and Data Engineer to lead the development of our security data architecture, web infrastructure, and artificial intelligence models. In this role, you will be the hands\-on driving force building scalable data pipelines, managing the web infrastructure that hosts our reporting solutions, and developing AI models to predict and prioritize cybersecurity vulnerabilities. While you will build AI and predictive analytics solutions, your primary focus will be engineering the robust data pipelines, databases, and web services that make those intelligent insights possible. You will have the opportunity to influence the blueprint of how diverse asset data is structured, securely hosted, and meaningfully delivered to the security organization. By engineering scalable data models, reliable web infrastructure, and intelligent AI pipelines, you will help ensure our infrastructure is ready for predictive analytics and that our reporting solutions provide proactive, automated insights rather than just historical data. Key Responsibilities include: * Data Pipeline \& Architecture: Design, construct, and maintain highly scalable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that ingest, transform, and centralize complex security data from numerous Systems of Record (SoR) into the Cyber Data Hub. * Web Infrastructure \& API Management: Build, maintain, and optimize the backend web infrastructure required to securely serve data dashboards, reporting portals, and AI model endpoints to end\-users. * Database Engineering: Engineer comprehensive data models (conceptual, logical, physical) and optimize relational and non\-relational database architectures for both high\-volume transactional processing and BI/analytics workloads. * AI \& Predictive Analytics: Develop and deploy machine learning models and intelligent automation to enhance vulnerability risk scoring, utilizing the data foundations and infrastructure you have built. * Frameworks \& Automation: Create reusable, automated frameworks and CI/CD workflows for data processing, web deployments, and model training to ensure low\-touch, sustainable operations. * Data Integrity \& Governance: Implement strict data quality checks, schema validations, and compliance safeguards to ensure the absolute integrity of downstream reporting and AI inputs. * Environment Management: Maintain and monitor our web servers, databases, ML staging, and UAT reporting environments to ensure high availability and reliable, secure deployment of EVM products. * Technical Leadership: Translate complex security program needs into concrete data and infrastructure tasks, guiding junior engineers and serving as a key technical liaison between security operations and core engineering. ### **What We’re Looking For:** We need a builder with a vision—someone who views complex security problems through the lens of data architecture, scalable web infrastructure, and intelligent automation. You should be deeply analytical, thrilled by processing massive datasets, capable of maintaining the web services that deliver those insights, and eager to leverage AI to stay ahead of emerging threats. You flourish in fast\-paced environments and possess the technical credibility to guide both infrastructure execution and architectural direction. You'll need to have: * Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience. * Eight or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of job\-related work experience, military experience, or specialized training or education (non\-collegiate). * Experience in Python and SQL for complex data manipulation, ETL processes, and algorithmic development. * Advanced expertise in writing, optimizing, and debugging complex queries and schemas for relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and non\-relational (MongoDB, Elasticsearch) databases, as well as modern Data Warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery). * Proven experience deploying, securing, and maintaining web infrastructure, REST APIs, and backend frameworks, as well as working with web servers/proxies. * Hands\-on experience developing predictive models and integrating ML libraries into production web environments. * Prior experience engineering within a Vulnerability Management program or Cyber Security organization. Even Better if You Have: * Exceptional ability to translate client needs into achievable technical requirements and present infrastructure/data roadmaps to executive leadership. * Advanced experience with cloud\-native web hosting, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architecture. * Experience fine\-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) or building Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks to run on top of your data infrastructure. * Understanding of security frameworks (NIST, SOX, FISMA) and the full IT stack (OS, Network, Cloud, SDLC). If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

jobs.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you'll be doing…** As a Senior Agentic AI Engineer within our team, you will be at the forefront of Verizon's transformation toward centralized intelligence and enterprise\-grade AI agents that drive action. Our team manages a broad portfolio of business processes underpinned by analytics, and you will lead the evolution from reactive reporting to autonomous, intelligent execution. You will architect and deploy multi\-agent systems capable of reasoning, planning, and collaborating across complex business domains—closing the loop between AI investment and measurable business outcomes. Responsibilities include: * Architecting and deploying scalable multi\-agent AI systems—designing agent workflows, communication protocols (A2A), and task delegation hierarchies for fleets of cooperative AI agents. * Integrating LLMs with enterprise systems via APIs, function calling, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable agents that can reason, plan, use tools, and act autonomously. * Building and operating enterprise Agent Factory pipelines—moving from reactive, episodic analytics to autonomous, continuously executing intelligent workflows. * Designing and implementing retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems with ONNX\-based embeddings and vector databases to power context\-aware, hyper\-personalized outputs at scale. * Managing agent memory and state architecture—implementing short\-term, medium\-term, and long\-term memory using tools like LangGraph for reliable multi\-step task execution. * Owning the full agent and model lifecycle: feature engineering, training, production deployment (Cloud Run, Vertex AI), and continuous monitoring with observability tooling. * Establishing security guardrails, permission boundaries, short\-lived agent identity tokens, and safety constraints for production agentic systems. * Developing and maintaining propensity models, classification systems, and forecasting solutions that feed downstream agent decision\-making. * Translating complex agentic AI outputs into clear operational strategies and presenting findings to senior leadership and cross\-functional business partners. * Performing advanced AI\-augmented analytics and generative AI model validation to ensure accuracy, reliability, and measurable business performance. ### **What we're looking for…** You are a senior AI engineer who has moved beyond building models into building agents—systems that reason, plan, and act. You have a strong foundation in data science and machine learning, and you've extended that into LLM orchestration, multi\-agent architecture, and production agentic systems. You have the strategic vision to evaluate when an autonomous agent is the right solution, and the communication skills to explain complex, probabilistic AI behaviors clearly to executive, security, and business stakeholders. ### **You'll need to have:** * Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Four or more years of relevant work experience, with two or more years focused specifically on Generative AI, LLMs, and autonomous agent systems. * Four or more years of experience developing and implementing analytical or AI solutions to complex business problems. * Hands\-on proficiency with multi\-agent orchestration frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LlamaIndex, or AutoGen. * Experience designing agent\-to\-agent (A2A) communication protocols, task delegation hierarchies, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for enterprise tool integration. * Experience with agent memory and state management: short\-term context, long\-term storage, context window optimization, and stateful workflow execution. * Demonstrated knowledge of retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), ONNX\-based embeddings, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), and semantic search. * Demonstrated knowledge of cloud\-scale data engineering: BigQuery pipelines and GCP (Cloud Run, Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, or Azure equivalent). * Experience with Python and SQL for statistical modeling, prompt engineering, token management, and large\-scale data extraction. ### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * A Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or Operations Research. * Familiarity with ML/LLM monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Arize Phoenix, Galileo) for tracking model drift, accuracy degradation, and agent output quality over time. * Experience with generative AI\-augmented analytics: AI testing frameworks, model validation pipelines, and LLMOps tooling including observability and token management. * Experience with AI governance, security, compliance, and financial ROI modeling for AI agent deployments. * jobs.title: Data Engineer - Sr. Consultant level
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** A Senior Data Engineer at Visa plays a pivotal role within a cross\-disciplined agile team, contributing to the product backlog and delivering critical features to enhance data presentation for customers and engineering teams. This position involves driving improvements to processes and practices, providing technical leadership, and mentoring others. The role requires dedication to technical excellence in code writing, team collaboration, testing, and documentation. Senior Data Engineers work alongside intermediate and senior engineers, agile team members, and consultants, demonstrating strong communication skills and a willingness to collaborate across disciplines as needed. All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. Key Responsibilities: * Collaborate with stakeholders to determine requirements for product components and incorporate feedback into future designs or solution fixes. * Translate functional requirements into system designs and communicate component interactions. * Design and develop product components, refine code plans for architecture, and lead design reviews. * Participate in project estimation and review product estimations, considering delivery costs and escalating issues as needed. * Lead by example and mentor others in creating extensible, maintainable, and reusable code. * Apply debugging tools to address moderately complex issues and identify opportunities for automation. * Lead code reviews to ensure coding standards and best practices are followed. * Create complex test plans, identify tools, prioritize tests, and interpret test results to inform planning. * Proactively identify and contain defects in software code to minimize customer impact and share findings with stakeholders across product features. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. **Qualifications** Basic Qualifications: * 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD Preferred Qualifications: * 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD * Expert\-level experience with the Spark framework, Hive\-based technologies, and broader Big Data development tools and platforms. * 5\+ years of hands\-on programming experience in Java, Scala, or Python, with the ability to quickly develop clean, production\-quality prototypes and core application components. * Practical experience applying Generative AI and Large Language Models in data engineering, including leading initiatives that leverage GenAI to improve team productivity and operational efficiency. * Strong working knowledge of SQL, NoSQL, graph databases, and RESTful APIs. * Demonstrated success leading large\-scale, end\-to\-end projects that deliver measurable business impact, from initial concept through production delivery. * Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and core computer science fundamentals. * Practical experience with data modeling for both relational and non\-relational database systems. * Experience collaborating with data scientists and machine learning teams, with the ability to discuss major machine learning paradigms, algorithms, and common software tools. * Hands\-on experience designing, building, and managing reliable data pipelines that move data across systems using tools such as Apache Airflow. * Proficiency with version control systems such as Git, along with experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment, and release management. * Demonstrated leadership behaviors, including a positive mindset, quick learning ability, collaboration, courage in leadership, and strong customer obsession. * Experience in mentoring junior engineers and providing technical leadership. * Experience in refining code plans for architecture and sharing learnings with the team. * Experience in driving security assessment processes to ensure code quality. * Experience in collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver solutions. * Ability to manage multiple, competing priorities effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. * Experience supporting data quality, data lineage, data governance, compliance, and security requirements within data engineering environments. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $180,600\.00 to $ 289,300\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. jobs.title: Technical Business Development Manager
jobs.description: **Location:** North America, Remote *(Cupertino, CA preferred)* ***Reports To:*** *SVP of Sales \& Marketing* **About Vital** Vital is a global leader in advanced materials, semiconductor technologies, and critical material recycling. We partner with the world's leading manufacturers, equipment suppliers, and research organizations to develop materials and solutions supporting current\- and next\-generation technologies. **Position Summary** Vital is seeking a Technical Business Development Manager to grow our business in optical coating services and capital equipment markets. This role is ideal for an engineer or technical professional with \>5 years of experience with advanced materials and capital equipment who is interested in transitioning into a customer\-facing commercial role. The successful candidate will leverage their technical knowledge to develop new business opportunities, build customer relationships, and support capital equipment and materials in optical coatings and coating services. **Responsibilities** * Develop new business opportunities across capital equipment and optical coatings supply chain for coating complex electronic components. * Build relationships with AI/AR Glass and companies requiring high volume coating services, equipment suppliers, material suppliers, and research organizations. * Support customer qualification programs from initial engagement through commercialization. * Coordinate technical and commercial discussions between customers and Vital's global engineering and manufacturing teams. * Prepare quotations, forecasts, and customer presentations. * Monitor industry trends, competitive activity and advise management. * Represent Vital at customer visits, conferences, and industry events. * Collaborate with the marketing team to properly advertise technical solutions. * Travel approximately 25–40%, including international travel. **Qualifications** **Required** * PhD's degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline. * \>**5 years of experience** with capital equipment used for optical coating. * Strong technical aptitude with an interest in business development and customer engagement. * Excellent communication and presentation skills. * Self\-motivated, organized, and comfortable working with global teams. **Preferred Experience** Experience with one or more of the following: * Capital equipment (PECVD, ALD) * Optics \& AR/VR coatings * Optical coating services, 3D functional coatings **Who You Are** You're naturally curious, enjoy working with people, and are energized by solving customer challenges. You have a solid technical foundation and understand the semiconductor industry, but you're looking for an opportunity to apply that knowledge in a commercial role where you can help shape business strategy, build customer relationships, and drive growth. **Why Vital?** * Join a global leader in advanced materials, critical metals and full solutions. * Work directly with the companies developing the next generation semiconductor technologies. * Be part of a fast\-growing business supporting compound semiconductors, silicon photonics and imaging technologies. * Build a long\-term career with opportunities to grow into broader commercial leadership roles.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** =========== Vital Services is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our growing Information Technology team. This is an extraordinary opportunity to be a part of, and play an integral role in, the development of our Data \& Reports team! As a Senior Data Engineer, you will work closely with our customer's department leads and project coordinators to evaluate business needs and develop reports and dashboards to support strategic goals. The core focus of this role is to architect, build, and optimize robust data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure secure, high\-performance data delivery, reporting accuracy, and seamless data synchronization across multiple core systems. You will also collaborate with other members of the Data and Information Technology teams to plan, design, develop, test, and deploy business intelligence data solutions. The core focus of this role is to architect, build, and optimize robust data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure secure, high\-performance data delivery, reporting accuracy, and seamless data synchronization across multiple core systems. A successful candidate will understand and fulfil their responsibility to develop and support databases, data structures, and data flow, with a focus on data integrity and reliability. **Responsibilities of the Senior Data Engineer Include:** ========================================================= In our organization, success in this seat means own\-and\-deliver execution on these five core areas: * **Pipeline Architecture \& ETL/ELT Execution:** Design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and automated pipelines to ingest, transform, and move high\-volume data securely. * **Database \& Schema Modeling:** Define and optimize data models, relational/non\-relational database structures, and query performance to support reporting and operational applications. * **Data Integrity \& Governance:** Own the monitoring and validation of data flows to ensure complete accuracy, quality, and compliance. * **Complexity \& Integration Management:** Map out and resolve data dependencies across disparate external APIs, legacy databases, and cloud infrastructure, translating data "unknowns" into structured execution plans. * **Operational Discipline \& Reporting Support:** Partner with the data and development teams to ensure pristine task estimating, technical documentation, and delivery data updates. **Skills \& Experience of the Senior Data Engineer Include:** ============================================================= * **Experience:** 5\+ years of dedicated data engineering experience working with large\-scale production databases and high\-compliance distributed data environments. * **Data \& API Engineering:** Proven mastery in building complex data pipelines, working with heavy data orchestration tools, and extracting data from complex third\-party API networks. * **Advanced Database Knowledge:** Deep expertise in SQL/NoSQL query tuning, data warehousing principles, schema evolution, and index optimization. * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Hands\-on experience with cloud data storage architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure) and modern practices for data pipelines. * **Problem\-Solving under Complexity:** A clear track record of debugging mismatched data architectures, handling breaking schema changes, and optimizing slow, multi\-system data jobs. **Measurables of the Senior Data Engineer:** ============================================ To give you complete transparency, here are the numbers this role is accountable for keeping "in the green": * **Pipeline Success Rate:** Greater than 99% uptime and successful execution on automated core data pipelines. * **Sprint Say/Do Ratio:** Greater than 80% predictability on committed sprint tasks and complexity points. * **Internal Team Unblock Rate:** Ensure \>\= 90% of mid\-level escalation requests are actively responded to within 30 minutes and fully unblocked (via resolution, delegation, or architectural decision) within 1 business day. * **Jira \& Documentation Hygiene:** 100% weekly compliance on task logging, estimation, and database schema documentation in Confluence. **Qualifications of the Senior Data Engineer:** =============================================== * A minimum of 5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics, or reporting roles. * At least 3 years of work experience in Business Intelligence is preferred. * Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or other quantitative degrees preferred. * Strong knowledge of SQL, SSRS, MS Excel, Power BI, Oracle, Tableau, and other Business Intelligence tools. * Knowledgeable and experienced with different data sources, such as, MS SQL, Excel files, Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, AS400, DB2, and Cloud Data Sources. * Deep understanding of SQL databases and query language. * Advanced Excel skills. * Familiarity with data storage, retrieval, and manipulation methods within both relational and non\-relational database architectures. * Knowledge and experience in the Commercial (P\&C) Insurance industry is a plus. **Compensation \& Culture** =========================== * **Salary Range:** **$110,000 – $130,000** * + *Final offer will be commensurate with experience and technical assessment results.* * **Hybrid Flexibility:** We value our in\-office culture, but offer a flexible hybrid schedule based on team project needs rather than a rigid "clock\-in" or “in\-office” requirement. * **Growth Path:** This position was opened due to new client projects and initiatives. As we provide white\-glove MSP and SaaS services to our clients, this allows their businesses to grow and in turn allows us to grow. We invest in our employees and our client relationships, which has allowed us to continue to scale up and increase our capacity and growth trajectory.

jobs.title: Electrical Design Engineer III, New Product Development
jobs.description: **Woodstream is the largest independent pest \& animal control platform in North America, offering innovative brands with industry\-leading efficacy and safety.** **Join a team of innovators where your electrical design expertise will shape new products, solve complex challenges, and drive technological advancement! We have an immediate opportunity for an Electrical Design Engineer III, New Product Development, in Lancaster, PA.** **At Woodstream, our values drive everything we do:** * **Consumer is the Boss** – We are committed to listening to and understanding our customers’ needs! * **Invent the Future** – Challenge the status quo: Think boldly and creatively! * **Execution is Everything** – We are committed to deliver with excellence, speed, and accuracy. * **Collaborate Confidently** – We trust, respect, and empower each other to win together. * **Play to Win** – We’re bold, ambitious, and relentless in our pursuit of success. **Benefits of Working for Woodstream:** * Competitive benefits package including: + 401k with Company Match, eligible on First Day of Employment + Health, Dental \& Vision Insurance Effective on **First Day of Employment** + Access to Company Paid Penn Medicine Health Clinics + Company General Bonus Program + Company Paid Parental Leave + Adoption Assistance + Company Paid Basic Life \& Disability Insurance + Accident, Critical Illness, \& Hospital Insurance Options + Company Paid ID Theft + Legal Assistance Plan Options + Paid Vacation and Holidays + Pet Insurance * Stable, growing working environment with a history of 150 years of doing business. * Opportunity to advance within the company. **Overview of the Role:** The Electrical Design Engineer III, New Product Development, is responsible for moderate to complex electrical engineering design projects within the new product development team. This role involves performing technical research, leading the design and development of electrical components and products, sourcing cutting\-edge electronics, and managing advanced prototyping and testing efforts. The Electrical Design Engineer III will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure designs meet business and technical requirements and will support manufacturing to ensure successful production. Key responsibilities include, but not limited to: * **Electrical Design Leadership:** Lead the design and development of electrical components and products for moderate to complex scale projects, ensuring compliance with technical, safety, and regulatory standards. * **Advanced Prototyping, Testing, \& Validation:** Oversee the creation, testing, and refinement of advanced electrical prototypes, ensuring performance, safety, and cost objectives are achieved. Must maintain external focus – among suppliers, academic advancements, competitors, industry events – to proactively identify and recommend technologies that could be integrated into Woodstream. * **Collaboration \& Manufacturing Support:** Collaborate with sourcing teams to select advanced electronic components, provide final electrical specifications, and support the transition from design to production, ensuring seamless execution. The Electrical Design Engineer III will work closely with the Director of Engineering to ensure that the technical vision is executed efficiently across the product development lifecycle. This individual will be responsible for finalizing electrical specifications and supporting the manufacturing process to ensure smooth production transitions, contributing to the company’s long\-term growth and innovation objectives. **Essential Functions \& Responsibilities:** * Lead the design, development, and refinement of electrical components and advanced prototypes for moderate to complex new product development projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards, performance, safety, and cost objectives. * Collaborate with Sourcing and Manufacturing Teams to identify, integrate, and manage electronic components that meet project specifications and quality standards, providing final electrical specifications and overseeing the transition from design to production. * Design new electronics hardware and firmware, modify existing schematics and layouts, and maintain existing products, addressing component obsolescence and adding new functionality as required. * Develop and conduct testing techniques that meet regulatory and functional requirements, ensuring designs incorporate manufacturing limitations and performance attributes, while defining tolerances for critical components. * Benchmark competitive products and maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of product designs and capabilities to identify Woodstream’s competitive advantages and areas for improvement. * Collaborate with the Director of Engineering, New Product Development to prepare and present technical developments within Woodstream. Develop compelling product demonstrations, technical specifications, and other support materials that clearly communicate Woodstream’s innovation capabilities. * Display perseverance and flexibility in overcoming technical challenges. Approach setbacks as opportunities to find alternative solutions, maintaining a proactive, growth\-oriented mindset to drive project success. * Regular attendance and punctuality are required. **This position has several primary objectives which are critical to the overall success of Woodstream:** * Lead the design, development, and refinement of electrical components and prototypes, ensuring compliance with industry standards and project goals. * Collaborate with sourcing and manufacturing teams to integrate components, oversee production transitions, and meet quality standards. * Drive innovation through testing, benchmarking, and continuous improvement to maintain Woodstream’s competitive advantage. **Other Functions:** * Performs other duties as assigned * Position could include up to 5\-10% travel for project meetings, supplier visits, and production assessments. **Successful Candidate Profile:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field. * At least 5 years’ experience in consumer product development, PCB level product design, IC selection, BOM development and other related EE engineering activities * This position requires expertise in appropriate computer design software and/or hardware (i.e., OrCAD, Altium, EagleCAD, DipTrace, KiCAD, UpVerter, Fritzing, CircuitMaker, ZenitPCB) * Experience writing embedded firmware code is required. * Experience in RF (radio frequency) product design is highly desirable. * Expertise in IOT and machine learning is highly desirable * Strong problem solving and organizational skills. * Strong communication and presentation skills. *Woodstream is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to recruit, hire, train and promote without regard to race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, national origin, marital status, union affiliation, disability, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic*. *Note: If hired, Employment Eligibility Verification will be carried out upon selection. Applicants must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer.* *We retain employment applications for a minimum of 2 years from date of receipt for non\-hire applicants or from date of termination for employees/contractors and possibly longer if legally required.*

Come make an impact every day at Zebra. **What We're Looking For:** Designs, develops, modifies and evaluates components, PCB assemblies and processes used in development of RFID Products. Determines design approaches and parameters. Analyzes equipment to establish operating data and conducts experiments. This role is a hybrid position and requires a minimum of three days per week in our Holtsville, NY office. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: * Designs, develops, and tests on a variety of electrical engineering assignments that constitute a portion of a larger project. * Develops and tests documentation which describes the specific electrical functionality.– Participates and provides some input in project code reviews. * Runs tests designed by more experienced engineers. * Reviews test results and perform root cause analyses to identify problems. * Provides recommendations and implements solutions to complex issues. Enhances and improves existing technologies to apply to new solutions. * Makes and implements recommendations to immediate team to enhance performance and improve productivity. * Seeks out new tools to analyze and solve problems. * Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. * Receives general instructions on routine work, new projects or assignments. * May provide guidance to non\-exempt personnel. * Builds productive working relationships internally and externally. jobs.title: Director, Marketing AI & Automation
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ Zillow Group is seeking a Director, Marketing AI \& Automation to lead a new team within Marketing, Technology \& Operations. This role will be accountable for delivering Marketing AI big bets, responsible for the roadmap, the platform, the governance, and the path that carries use cases into scaled production. This role is responsible for shepherding AI big bets from strategy development to scaled implementation, including the platform and integration work they depend on, the measurement that proves impact, the change management that makes them stick, and the handoff to the teams who will run them day to day. The role also owns what comes next: sourcing and shaping the next generation of bets as the technology and the business shift, building the case for what to invest behind, and deciding what to retire. This role will be responsible for building and leading a multidisciplinary team responsible for scaling AI use cases. The team is expected to have a mix of strategic, technical and operational skills. **About the role** ------------------ **Key Responsibilities** Own the Marketing AI roadmap: Setting and defending the use\-case portfolio, including what gets built, in what order, and for whom, prioritized against reclaimed capacity and business impact * Run the path from idea to production: Building and operating the intake stage\-gate from idea to pilot to production to owned, including the handoff model that transfers run\-state to the team accountable for the outcome * Stand up the agent and orchestration platform: Owning the shared layer, reusable components, and the data and vendor integration that AI use cases depend on, focused on integration and orchestration rather than model building * Own AI governance for Marketing: Running agent audits, brand\-risk scoring, and exclusion zones in partnership with Legal and Brand, aligned to Zillow's AI Principles and to external standards * Drive adoption across the org: Running the adoption program and the network of embedded AI liaisons so that capability is embedded in day\-to\-day workflows rather than sitting unused * Build and lead the team: Hiring into net\-new technical and strategic roles, integrating talent redeployed from across Marketing, and setting the performance bar for a newly formed team * * Report value to leadership: Owning the measurement of capacity gained, speed to market, and business impact, including a clear account of what did not work This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $231,000\.00 \- $369,000\.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $219,500\.00 \- $350,600\.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. **Who you are** --------------- 10\+ years in marketing technology, growth engineering, applied AI, or technical product, including 4\+ years leading teams. * Production track record: Has moved AI use cases from proof of concept to scaled operation, and can speak specifically to what was built, what broke along the way, and what the measured impact was * Marketing fluency: Strong understanding of how Marketing operate, with enough depth to hold a substantive conversation with a channel leader about where AI helps and where it does not * Technically credible: Able to go deep with engineers on agent orchestration, data integration, and evaluation, and to distinguish a serious architecture from a demo, without needing to build models directly. Familiarity with a modern composable stack (CDP, reverse ETL, cloud data platform, enterprise LLM tooling) highly valued * Enablement mindset: Track record running a center\-led function that transferred capability outward as it matured, rather than accumulating ownership. Experience standing up a center of excellence or platform team from zero a plus * Governance judgment: Experience managing brand, legal, and privacy risk in AI systems, and building the review mechanisms rather than resisting them * Influence without authority: Able to drive outcomes that land inside other teams, on other roadmaps, without direct control * Build\-versus\-buy judgment: Experience evaluating and managing AI and martech vendors, with a clear view of when a platform partner beats an internal build * * Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in a technical or business field (MBA, Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics) a plus **Get to know us** ------------------ At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together. *Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.* *Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.* *Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

complex software, integration, and environment issues. * Experience working in Agile software development environments. * Ability to develop maintainable, well\-documented, and testable software. * performance engineering. * Experience integrating applications with observability and monitoring platforms. * Experience with GitLab and GitLab CI/CD. * Experience with Datadog or comparable jobs.title: Junior Electrical & Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: Aescape is a New York\-based physical AI and robotics company redefining human recovery through intelligent, precision bodywork, elevating it into a consistent, outcomes\-driven practice. Powered by real\-time body mapping, advanced robotics, and proprietary software, Aescape delivers deeply personalized bodywork that continuously adapts to the individual. This creates a superior way for members to move with greater ease, recover more efficiently, and optimize how they feel every single day. Aescape is building a defining brand for recovery, shifting behavior from a sporadic experience into a progressive, measurable routine, unlocking compounding benefits that build lasting resilience and laying the groundwork for an entirely new category of proactive human health and performance. Aescape powers recovery across leading fitness, hospitality, and wellness environments, including Equinox, Life Time, Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, Pause Studios, and Remedy Place, and is backed by Valor Equity Partners, BroadLight Capital, and Mecha Ventures. **Aescape** is looking for a **Junior Electrical \& Firmware Engineer** to join our hardware team and work across the electronics and embedded software that make our robot move and sense. You will support schematic and PCB design, write and debug firmware on our embedded platforms, and spend significant time on the bench bringing boards up, instrumenting them, and fault finding across hardware and firmware. This is a hands\-on early\-career role on a small, senior team: you will be mentored closely by experienced engineers, given ownership of meaningful subsystems early, and you will ship hardware that real people experience with their bodies. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you! **This role is based out of our NYC office in Chelsea, onsite 5 days per week.** **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Electrical Design Support:** Support schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout review for motor drive, sensing, power, and control electronics. Read datasheets closely, run the calculations behind a part choice, and help carry boards from design through fabrication and assembly. * **Firmware Development:** Write, test, and debug embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ on our microcontroller platforms: peripheral drivers, communication interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN), sensor integration, and device control. Work within our version control, code review, and release practices. * **Board Bring\-Up \& Debug:** Bring up new hardware on the bench, and debug across the electrical and firmware boundary using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, power supplies, and debuggers. Solder, rework, and instrument your own test setups. * **Test \& Characterization:** Build bench test setups, collect and analyze characterization data, and report what the data shows. Drive decisions from measured data and physics. * **Manufacturing \& Supplier Support:** Support production test fixtures, design for testability, and electrical builds with our contract manufacturer and suppliers. Help triage and root\-cause issues found in manufacturing and in the field. * **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Partner with Mechanical, Controls, Software, and Operations on motor selection, drivers, sensors, and system bring\-up, and communicate what you find clearly to partners outside your discipline. * **Documentation:** Produce the documentation others need to use your work: schematics, BOMs, wiring diagrams, test plans, and test reports. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * **Education \& Experience:** BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline, with 0–3 years of professional experience. Internships, co\-ops, research, competition teams, or substantial personal projects count. * **Circuit Fundamentals:** Solid grounding in analog and digital circuit design, power electronics basics, and schematic capture in a professional tool such as Altium. You can read a datasheet and justify a component choice with numbers. * **Embedded Firmware \& Python:** Working proficiency in C or C\+\+ on microcontrollers, bare\-metal or RTOS, with familiarity across common peripherals and communication protocols, and in Python for test automation and application\-level work. Comfortable with Git and code review. * **Lab Skills:** Hands\-on with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and bench power supplies, and comfortable soldering and reworking your own boards. * **Debugging Mindset:** You approach a failure with a clear question in mind: what is happening, why, and how would I prove it. You stay with a problem until you find the actual cause rather than a workaround. * **Cross\-Disciplinary Curiosity:** Interest in how electronics, firmware, and mechanics come together in a working machine, and comfort working with engineers outside your discipline. * **Communication:** Clear written and verbal skills. You document what you did and explain what you found so others can act on it. * **Adaptability:** A driven self\-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and able to pivot as priorities shift in a fast\-moving startup; willing to take on work outside your core role when required. * **Nice to Have:** Experience with brushless motor control or motor drivers, sensor signal conditioning, PCB layout, or robotics projects. * **Work Onsite:** Ability to work from our NYC office 5 days a week. **What’s In It For You** ------------------------ * Join a trailblazing robotics and AI company building the future of recovery * The chance to make a difference with a product that empowers healthier and happier living * Team culture driven by passion, ambition, empowerment, inclusion, curiosity, and fun! * 100% employer\-paid healthcare coverage for employees with generous coverage for eligible dependents * Flexible time off * Quarterly Wellness Days \- everyone fully unplugs * Generous parental leave * Complimentary OneMedical membership * 401(k) with employer matching * Home office budget * Annual stipend for professional development * Working late? Dinner is on us * Complimentary Aescape recovery sessions for yourself, friends \& family **Compensation**: Base salary range of **$95,000 \- $125,000** annually, plus discretionary annual bonus, plus equity grant commensurate with the role and company stage. Full\-time employees are also eligible for our comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, and paid parental leave. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Aescape is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. The salary range listed above is a good\-faith estimate provided in accordance with New York City's pay transparency law. **Begin Your Aescape Career Journey** ------------------------------------- At Aescape, we're on a mission to redefine self\-care for a better world, and we're seeking trailblazers to join us on this journey. We're inspired by individuals who are passionate, driven, and eager to learn. We value diverse perspectives and resourceful, determined individuals who are committed to making a difference. At Aescape, we empower people to reach their full potential, just as our product empowers better living. If you're ready to innovate, create, and make a meaningful impact, we want you on our team. **YOUR JOURNEY. YOUR AESCAPE.**
